chapters.title: Chapter 2501 Inside Primordial Chaos
paragraphs: Seeing Zi Xuan slaughter magical beasts left and right, the Demon Annihilation Sword refused to simply stand by and also rushed forward to kill some on her own, subconsciously feeling a sense of rivalry with Zi Xuan without even realizing it herself.
Although the Demon Annihilation Sword specialized in slaying demons, it was still a masterpiece whose sharpness rivaled even Celestial-grade treasures.
However, unlike Zi Xuan, who could wield Supreme Sword Aura as naturally as breathing, the Demon Annihilation Sword couldn't even use basic Sword Aura.
Yet, it did not lose to Zi Xuan and slayed magical beasts just as fast as her.
In just a few days, Yuan arrived at the second level of the Primordial Chaos.

While the first level had been mostly barren, filled with jagged mountains and rugged terrain, the second level began to show signs of vegetation. However, every tree there was dry, withered, and seemingly devoid of life.
Not only that, but the Chaotic Essence within the area had also become denser and far more abundant, while the magical beasts there had risen to the third level of God Ascension.
Of course, this wasn't a problem for Zi Xuan, who was at the peak of God Ascension.
That being said, even though Zi Xuan could easily defeat the magical beasts, it was not as though she could recklessly expend her spiritual energy without consequence.
At the end of the day, unlike Yuan, she did not possess a Chaotic Heart and therefore could not naturally replenish her spiritual energy within the Primordial Chaos.
"Dear, I'm running low on spiritual energy," Zi Xuan said to Yuan once she could no longer defeat the magical beasts with a single strike.
Without saying a word, Yuan transferred some of his spiritual energy to Zi Xuan, allowing her to continue fighting at full strength.
Meanwhile, the Demon Annihilation Sword continued slaughtering the magical beasts through pure raw power alone, showing no signs of slowing down.

Although Zi Xuan was fully capable of doing the same, she deliberately chose to fight in her spirit form while using Supreme Sword Aura instead, as it had been far too long since she'd been able to properly exercise herself like this.
With two powerful existences protecting him, Yuan was able to travel through the Primordial Chaos without needing to slow down, appearing completely at ease the entire time.
In the blink of an eye, they arrived at the third level, where the scenery finally began showing more noticeable signs of life.
Yuan stopped moving for a moment to examine the plants and trees in the area.
"I think I have seen them in the Primal Expanse before..." he mumbled in a low voice.
Suddenly, Yuan's eyebrows twitched as something else caught his attention, prompting him to turn his head toward the source.
"What's wrong?" Zi Xuan asked when she couldn't sense anything nearby.
A slight frown appeared on Yuan's face as he replied in a cautious voice, "I sense Eternal Essence. Someone is using Eternal Essence ahead of us."
"There's an Eternal nearby?!" Zi Xuan exclaimed in shock.

Yuan fell silent for a moment before responding, "Although it's a bit weak, it's definitely Eternal Essence. Now that I think about it, the Primordial Chaos is outside the Absolute Power's influence, so it wouldn't be impossible for an Eternal to show up here..."
"What should we do?" Zi Xuan then asked. "Go around them or confront them directly?"

Yuan pondered for a moment before replying, "Let's just keep moving forward. If it really is an Eternal, they most likely already know we're here, so trying to avoid them might actually draw their attention instead."
He then shrugged and added, "Besides, maybe they won't even care about us. To beings like them, we're nothing more than mere ants."
A short while later, they continued moving forward, albeit with heightened vigilance.
The closer Yuan got, the clearer he could sense the Eternal Essence radiating from the other party, and it gradually became apparent what this individual was doing there.

'They seem to be training their Eternal Essence against magical beasts... There's no way an actual Eternal would waste their time doing something like this, so who else could it be?' Yuan pondered inwardly.
Eventually, they arrived at the fourth level of the Primordial Chaos, where even the weakest magical beasts had reached at least the sixth level of God Ascension.
"I have always wondered this, but where in heaven's name are these magical beasts coming from?" Zi Xuan suddenly asked out loud.
"I initially thought they came from the Primal Expanse, but none of them possess a Chaotic Heart, which is a defining characteristic of beings from that place," Yuan remarked.
"Yet for some reason, they're still capable of cultivating with Chaotic Essence even without one. It's truly bizarre."
"Anyway, we're getting close to that individual using Eternal Essence."
A few hours after entering the fourth level, Yuan was finally close enough to observe the mysterious individual with his divine sense.
However, not wanting to provoke their attention, he chose not to investigate further and simply continued moving forward while pretending to ignore their presence.
'Just ignore us...' Yuan prayed inwardly as they drew closer.
Unfortunately, the moment they passed by the mysterious individual, their presence suddenly began moving toward them.
Realizing that a confrontation was practically unavoidable at this point, Yuan came to a complete stop and quietly waited for the other party to approach.
"Come back to me," Yuan said to Zi Xuan and the Demon Annihilation Sword.
Without hesitation, they reverted to their sword form and returned to his side.
Several tense minutes later, the mysterious individual finally arrived before Yuan.
"You..." They started speaking first, their voice full of surprise. "You are still alive?!"
"Hm?" Yuan raised his eyebrows as he focused his gaze on this individual's face.
His jaw dropped slightly upon recognizing her face.
"Mu Xuelian?"

The mysterious individual turned out to be none other than Mu Xuelian—the woman Yuan had met within White Hell who had followed him outside before the two were forced to separate during his clash with Saaruk.

chapters.title: Chapter 2502 Meeting Shiva Again
paragraphs: "Mu Xuelian? What are you doing here?" Yuan muttered after seeing her familiar face.
"I should be saying that to you! No, how are you—"
Mu Xuelian was abruptly cut off mid-sentence as the being possessing her body suddenly seized control.
The temperature in the surrounding area instantly plummeted, becoming so cold that frost crystals began forming in the air itself.
"Shiva," Yuan called out to the Eternal currently possessing Mu Xuelian's body.
Shiva narrowed her gaze at Yuan, her eyes flickering with doubt and confusion.
"Why are you still alive?" she eventually asked.
"That's the first thing you say after abandoning me during my fight with Saaruk? How cold..." Yuan remarked while pretending to shiver dramatically.

Shiva gritted her teeth for a bit before shouting angrily, "I had no choice! What else was I supposed to do?! Help you fight Saaruk with this body that cannot even use Eternal Essence properly?! I may owe you for breaking my seal, but I will not meaninglessly sacrifice my life for you!"

"Calm down a little," Yuan said while shaking his head. "It's not like I'm actually blaming you for leaving me behind. It was the correct decision, and if I were in your position, I probably would've done the same thing."
Despite Yuan claiming that he did not blame her, the frown on Shiva's face did not lessen in the slightest.

"So how did you survive? Did you somehow manage to escape? Or did Saaruk let you go... unlikely as that sounds?" Shiva asked again, unable to comprehend how Yuan had managed to survive the encounter, as she was certain that he would die at Saaruk's hands.

'There's no way a mere mortal like him could escape from an Eternal... But it's even more impossible for someone like Saaruk to spare his life...' Shiva thought inwardly while waiting for Yuan's explanation.
"Neither," Yuan eventually replied, a slow smile creeping onto his face.
"What would you say if I told you that I defeated him?
"No way!" Shiva instantly rejected the idea without even a second of hesitation, making it abundantly clear just how little faith she had in him.
However, one could hardly blame Shiva for underestimating Yuan. After all, she had spent her entire life viewing humans as little more than insignificant ants.
Yuan chuckled and said, "Well, you're right. I didn't defeat him, but he didn't kill me, either."
"Are you saying that he was incapable of killing you, so he backed off?" Shiva asked.
"It'd be more accurate to say that he was forced to back off because he used a little too much power trying to kill me."
"The Absolute Power!" Shiva's eyes widened as she started understanding the situation more and more.
Yuan proceeded to explain the whole situation in more detail.
"Unbelievable..." Shiva muttered as she began looking at Yuan in a new light.
'Not only was he able to survive a fight against Saaruk, but he'd even managed to chase Saaruk away...'
"So, what are you doing here?" It was Yuan's turn to ask. "From what I could tell, it looked like you were training."

"Because that is exactly what we were doing. Training." Shiva looked down at her own palms before continuing, "After our encounter with Saaruk, I realized just how powerless I was before other Eternals."

She then clenched her hand slightly and said, "There's a high chance I'll have to fight them in order to reclaim my body someday, so I've been training this body to withstand my Eternal Essence better."
"Does it actually work? Can a mortal body be tempered to withstand Eternal Essence?" Yuan asked with visible curiosity.

"An ordinary mortal body? No," Shiva replied. "However, this body was specifically created for that very purpose through countless generations of refinement. Still, the progression is pathetic. Even though we've been training for years nonstop, she can barely handle a hundred thousand years' worth of Eternal Essence. At this rate, it'll take tens of millions of years before she can wield even a decent amount."
Without warning, Yuan suddenly reached out and grabbed Shiva's arm—or more precisely, Mu Xuelian's body.
"What are you doing?" Shiva asked with a deep frown, clearly displeased by the fact that Yuan had touched her.

Yuan released a sigh and said, "I just examined her body, and as expected, it's a complete wreck. Forget tens of millions of years—I'd be surprised if she can even survive another hundred in this condition."
"As long as I continue possessing this body, she won't die, so there's no need for you to worry about that," Shiva remarked nonchalantly.
The moment Yuan heard those words, a surge of anger rose within him.
"I finally understand what it is about you Eternals that's been bothering me this whole time," Yuan muttered in a cold voice, his eyes burning with fury.
"The way you Eternals so naturally treat humans as nothing more than disposable tools to further your own goals... it disgusts me."
After a brief moment of silence, Shiva finally spoke, "Using others to achieve one's goals is not something exclusive to Eternals."
She narrowed her eyes at Yuan calmly and continued, "Humans do the exact same thing to their own kind as well."
Yuan closed his eyes and released a deep sigh.
"I won't deny that disgusting humans like that exist as well," he said in a low voice. "But that still doesn't make it acceptable."
"Then what else am I supposed to do?" Shiva asked.
"At this point, she is the only way for me to recover my true body. Or what? Are you going to take her place and help me recover it instead?"
"If it means you'll stop treating her body as though it belongs to you, then I don't mind helping you recover your true body," Yuan said calmly.
"Even if it only brings you more trouble? There's a very high chance you'll offend other Eternals by helping me," Shiva warned him.
Yuan casually shrugged and said, "Believe it or not, offending Eternals has basically become a lifestyle for me at this point."

chapters.title: Chapter 2503 What It Means To Be A Prime Eternal
paragraphs: Shiva silently stared at Yuan with disbelief written all over her face. Never in her life had she imagined meeting a mortal like him—someone who was not only unafraid of Eternals, but who seemingly went out of his way to offend them.
'Even as Eternals, we tend to avoid offending each other, but this crazy bastard...' she sighed inwardly.
"Fine," Shiva eventually spoke out loud. "If you're really going to help me recover my true body, I'll stop bothering her."
Yuan nodded, "I promise I will recover your body."
Without saying another word, Shiva relinquished control of the body back to Mu Xuelian.
After regaining control of her body, Mu Xuelian silently stared at Yuan with a confused expression on her face.
"Are you wondering why I'm doing this?" Yuan suddenly asked, as though he could read her mind.
Mu Xuelian quietly nodded in response.
"I don't have a special reason," he calmly said. "However, if I have to give a reason, it'd be that I pity you."
"You pity me...?" Mu Xuelian's eyes widened slightly, unsure how she should feel about being pitied by someone else, as she had never once considered herself pitiful.
"I don't understand," she said a moment later. "Why do you pity me?"
"You were born for the sole purpose of becoming a tool for someone else," Yuan replied calmly. "Nor do you have true free will. How is that not pitiful?"
"So what if I don't have free will? I'm perfectly satisfied serving Lady Shiva! That is my purpose in life!" Mu Xuelian exclaimed.
Yuan shook his head and sighed, "You're just brainwashed."
Mu Xuelian gritted her teeth and shouted, "Lady Shiva! There's no need to listen to him! I'm willing to continue training! Please... allow me to remain useful to you!"
Yuan then calmly said, "If you still want to continue training, then go ahead. However, I'm not going to let you die under my watch."
He then added, "After all, I promised your grandmother that I would take care of you."

"You heard him," Shiva spoke directly into Mu Xuelian's mind. "You may continue training at your own discretion. After all, there's no guarantee he'll truly be able to recover my body, so we may ultimately have to rely on ourselves in the end.
Some time later, Mu Xuelian asked Yuan, "Lord Shiva asked what you're doing in this place."
"I have somewhere I need to be. Want to tag along?"
"Of course," she immediately responded.
Thus, Yuan resumed his journey toward the fifth level, with Mu Xuelian following him.
"So, what's the real reason you're helping them?" Zi Xuan's voice suddenly echoed inside Yuan's head. "I highly doubt you'd help an Eternal just because you pity that little girl."

A subtle smile appeared on Yuan's face as he replied, "It's true that I pity her, but the real reason I'm helping them—helping Shiva—is because she can help me obtain an Eternal's blacksmithing techniques."
"Oh?"
"Actually, it's more like she knows someone who can help me. Unfortunately, we do not have the time for that right now."
"Then what about my upgrade? Are we not going to do it right now?"
"No, we'll do it right now, but it'll be a partial upgrade instead of a full one."
"What a pity... not that I am complaining," she said.
As they continued traveling together, Yuan decided to strike up a conversation with Shiva—or more accurately, use the opportunity to extract information from her.
"Hey, Shiva, what do you know about humans? And I don't mean the ones Eternals cloned for their selfish experiments."
The moment she heard those words, Mu Xuelian's body trembled slightly before Shiva abruptly took control once again.
"How do you know about that?!" she demanded in a shocked voice.
"How else? I learned about it from another Eternal."
"I don't believe you!" Shiva immediately retorted. "This is a sensitive subject that most Eternals avoid discussing altogether!"
Yuan raised an eyebrow after hearing that.
"Sensitive? I'm surprised you Eternals even understand the meaning of that word."
Since Eternals could experiment on humans and use them like disposable tools without batting an eye, Yuan was genuinely surprised to learn that there were topics even they considered sensitive.
"So, what do you know about them?" Yuan continued to ask.
"Then tell me what you know first," Shiva quickly responded.
"Well, I know that Eternals once cloned humans for their experiments, but something eventually happened that resulted in those humans being wiped out."
"Seriously... which idiot would reveal something like this to a mortal?" Shiva sighed aloud in disbelief.
"That would be Deemo," Yuan suddenly revealed.
"Huh?" Shiva immediately froze with a bewildered expression on her face.
"D-Did you just say Deemo? Prime Eternal Deemo?" Shiva asked in a nervous voice.

Even among Eternals, the strong were revered with awe and respect. However, what truly shocked Shiva was not the fact that Yuan had met a Prime Eternal, but that he somehow had connections to one of the most reclusive Prime Eternals in existence.
"That's right. Deemo, the Demon God. The creator of the Demonic Realm," Yuan confirmed.
"W-What is your relationship with Deemo? I cannot imagine someone like him being on friendly terms with a mortal."
Yuan shrugged, "It's a bit complicated. Although we're not friends, we're also not enemies."

"It's practically a miracle that you even managed to speak with him. Deemo is infamous for being extremely reclusive, always remaining within his own territory and almost never stepping outside of it," Shiva remarked. "Not only that, but for him to share such sensitive information with you... Honestly, I'm a bit envious."
"Envious? You are?" Yuan muttered with a surprised face.
"Do you even know what it means to be a Prime Eternal?" Shiva suddenly asked.
"Isn't it just a title for the strongest Eternals?" he replied.
Shiva shook her head and sighed, "You need more than just raw strength to acquire the title of 'Prime'."
"Care to elaborate?"
Shiva then said, "In order to become a 'Prime Eternal, ' one must satisfy three requirements."

"No, we'll do it right now, but it'll be a partial upgrade instead of a full one."
"What a pity... not that I am complaining," she said.
As they continued traveling together, Yuan decided to strike up a conversation with Shiva—or more accurately, use the opportunity to extract information from her.
"Hey, Shiva, what do you know about humans?
And I don't mean the ones Eternals cloned for their selfish experiments."
The moment she heard those words, Mu Xuelian's body trembled slightly before Shiva abruptly took control once again.
"How do you know about that?!" she demanded in a shocked voice.
"How else?
I learned about it from another Eternal."
"I don't believe you!" Shiva immediately retorted.
"This is a sensitive subject that most Eternals avoid discussing altogether!"
Yuan raised an eyebrow after hearing that.
"Sensitive?
I'm surprised you Eternals even understand the meaning of that word."
Since Eternals could experiment on humans and use them like disposable tools without batting an eye, Yuan was genuinely surprised to learn that there were topics even they considered sensitive.
"So, what do you know about them?" Yuan continued to ask.
"Then tell me what you know first," Shiva quickly responded.
"Well, I know that Eternals once cloned humans for their experiments, but something eventually happened that resulted in those humans being wiped out."
"Seriously... which idiot would reveal something like this to a mortal?" Shiva sighed aloud in disbelief.
"That would be Deemo," Yuan suddenly revealed.
"Huh?" Shiva immediately froze with a bewildered expression on her face.
"D-Did you just say Deemo?
Prime Eternal Deemo?" Shiva asked in a nervous voice.
Even among Eternals, the strong were revered with awe and respect.
However, what truly shocked Shiva was not the fact that Yuan had met a Prime Eternal, but that he somehow had connections to one of the most reclusive Prime Eternals in existence.
"That's right.
Deemo, the Demon God.
The creator of the Demonic Realm," Yuan confirmed.
"W-What is your relationship with Deemo?
I cannot imagine someone like him being on friendly terms with a mortal."
Yuan shrugged, "It's a bit complicated.
Although we're not friends, we're also not enemies."
"It's practically a miracle that you even managed to speak with him.
Deemo is infamous for being extremely reclusive, always remaining within his own territory and almost never stepping outside of it," Shiva remarked.
"Not only that, but for him to share such sensitive information with you...
Honestly, I'm a bit envious."
"Envious?
You are?" Yuan muttered with a surprised face.
"Do you even know what it means to be a Prime Eternal?" Shiva suddenly asked.
"Isn't it just a title for the strongest Eternals?" he replied.
Shiva shook her head and sighed, "You need more than just raw strength to acquire the title of 'Prime'."
"Care to elaborate?"
Shiva then said, "In order to become a 'Prime Eternal, ' one must satisfy three requirements."

chapters.title: Chapter 2504 Five Prime Eternals
paragraphs: "Three requirements, huh?" Yuan muttered.
"Let me guess—they need to possess enough power, have sufficient achievements, and have lived for a certain amount of time?"
"You've got one right," Shiva said. "Indeed, one must possess enough power... at least a hundred trillion years of Eternal Essence."

"A hundred trillion years?" Yuan's eyes widened at this number, as this meant that Prime Eternals have lived at least that amount, which was a hundred times more than the amount of Eternal Essence he can currently use.
'Does that mean Deemo is at least a hundred times stronger than me right now?' Yuan swallowed nervously when he realized just how vast the difference was between them.
'I guess it was true when he said that he could've killed me at any time during our fight...' he sighed inwardly.
He knew that he still had a lot of work to do before he could contest a Prime Eternal, but he could never have imagined how much work it truly was until today.
"Alright, what about the other two requirements?"
"The second requirement is to possess enough territory, which directly correlates to one's influence and status," Shiva revealed.
"Territory? How exactly does that work?" Yuan asked with a raised eyebrow.

"Just as you humans claim land as your territory, we Eternals do the same," Shiva explained. "However, our scale is far greater. Instead of claiming houses or continents, we claim the universe itself—the void."
"I can figure that much out on my own, but how does it actually work?" Yuan asked. "How do you determine who owns which part of the void?"
He then looked around him in the endless starry sky and continued, "The universe is practically boundless, so I can't even begin to imagine how something like that is measured or verified."

"We Eternals are capable of 'marking' our territory using Eternal Essence," she replied. "Although Eternal Essence itself cannot normally be distinguished the same way one identifies an aura or presence, there are methods that allow us to make it recognizable."
"Moreover, Eternals are able to sense everything that happens in their territory, even if they are light-years away, and unless invited, they all tend to stay away from each other's territories."
"And since we need Eternal Essence to mark our territory, this also means that we need sufficient prowess."
"How much territory do you have?" Yuan asked out of curiosity.
"...I do not have any right now, and I think you know why," she sighed.
"I see. What about the final requirement?"
"Sorry, but I can't tell you." Shiva shook her head.
"Huh? Why not?"
"Because, quite frankly, I don't want someone like you learning about it."
"Someone like me? What's that supposed to mean?" Yuan asked.
"Exactly what it sounds like," Shiva replied. "I can't believe I'm actually saying this, but you are a danger to us Eternals."
She then narrowed her eyes slightly and continued, "And if you were to learn about that... I don't even want to imagine the consequences."
"If you say something like that, it'll only make me want to learn about it more," Yuan said with a cold smile.
'This information might reveal a weakness of the Eternals... I have to learn it somehow!' Yuan thought inwardly.
Up until now, he had always viewed Eternals as godlike existences without flaws or weaknesses, but it seemed that might not entirely be the case.
However, since Shiva clearly had no intention of telling him, Yuan decided not to press the matter any further for now.
"How many Prime Eternals are there right now?" Yuan asked, changing the topic.
"There are five, as far as I am aware."
"I know about Deemo and someone named Morveth. Who are the other three?"
"Why do you want to know? So you can offend them later?" Shiva sneered.
"Of course not. Prime Eternals are far beyond my league right now, so I'd rather avoid offending them if possible," Yuan replied.
Shiva narrowed her eyes at him for a moment before finally answering, "Hilla, Alisher, and Kakos."
A serious look then appeared on her face as she added, "If you seriously value your life, do not offend Kakos. Even we Eternals avoid that individual like the plague."
"Is this Kakos the strongest Prime Eternal?" Yuan asked, looking intrigued.
"It's not his strength that makes him terrifying, but his nature," Shiva replied with a grim expression.

"As a matter of fact, Kakos is the only Eternal known to have truly killed another Eternal before." She paused for a moment before adding, "Or rather... he's the only one genuinely capable of killing us."
"Oh?" Yuan became even more intrigued upon hearing this.
But before he could ask more, Shiva said, "Forget about it. I don't want to speak about Kakos anymore."
At the same time, Zi Xuan spoke, "We'll arrive at our destination soon."
Zi Xuan then entered her spirit form and began leading the way.
"Who is that?" Mu Xuelian asked with raised eyebrows after witnessing Yuan's sword transform into a beautiful woman.
"My sword," Yuan calmly explained.
Mu Xuelian did not question further for some reason.
A few hours later, they finally arrived at the Apocalyptic Chasm, a region engulfed in scorching heat and overflowing with lava.
However, unlike ordinary lava, the lava there possessed a light blue hue, making the entire place resemble a vast ocean rather than a massive sea of molten rock.

Having spent most of her life within the freezing environment of White Hell, Mu Xuelian found the atmosphere there unbearably uncomfortable, as it was the complete opposite of everything she was accustomed to.
"What are we doing here?" Mu Xuelian asked while using her tribe's martial techniques to cool her overheated body.
"My home is somewhere around here," he calmly explained.
"You... live here?" Mu Xuelian wore a dumbfounded look on her face.
"My personal world," he elaborated.
"You created your personal world in the middle of the Primordial Chaos? Are you insane?"
Yuan merely shrugged and replied, "Insane or not, it's the perfect place for a hideout since almost nobody would dare come here."

chapters.title: Chapter 2505 Tian Qiyuan's World
paragraphs: Shortly after arriving at the Apocalyptic Chasm, Zi Xuan suddenly came to a stop above a massive lake of azure-colored lava.
"We're here," Zi Xuan said with a smile on her face.
An immense surge of excitement stirred within her soul, as it had been countless years since she had last returned to this place.
Yuan followed her gaze toward the surface below, and in the next moment, memories suddenly began surfacing within his mind—memories belonging to Tian Qiyuan.
"I remember now," he muttered with a dazed look on his face.
"A little too late if you ask me," Zi Xuan shook her head.
"Anyway, I'll go remove the seal."
Without offering any explanation, Zi Xuan suddenly reverted to her sword form before diving straight into the lava below, its temperature nearly comparable to True Primordial Fire.
Several minutes later, the surface of the lava lake suddenly began to tremble, and the molten lava started swirling as though a massive vortex had formed beneath it.
Moments later, the lake split open, revealing a massive hole that seemed to lead to another world.
"I am already on the other side," Zi Xuan's voice resounded in Yuan's head.
Yuan turned to look at Mu Xuelian and said, "Follow closely."
Then, the two of them flew directly into the portal, vanishing from the Primordial Chaos.
Upon stepping through the portal, Yuan and Mu Xuelian were instantly teleported to a floating island suspended within a boundless sky, almost as if they'd returned to the Nine Heavens.
"Welcome back home, my dear." Zi Xuan appeared before Yuan in her spirit form and greeted him with a beautiful smile on her face.
Yuan returned the smile and said, "I'm home."
Mu Xuelian surveyed her surroundings with awe written all over her face.
Although she was neither a blacksmith nor particularly knowledgeable about materials, even she could tell that everything in this place was priceless.

From the golden trees surrounding the shimmering golden lake to the multi-colored crystal mountains standing majestically, the entire scene felt almost surreal. Hell, when examined closely, even the clouds themselves were treasures.
Amidst all of those priceless treasures stood a simple wooden house.
Compared to the extravagant surroundings, the humble structure looked completely out of place, almost absurdly ordinary within a world overflowing with immeasurable wealth.
"You can look around if you'd like," Yuan suddenly said to Mu Xuelian. "There's something I need to do, so I will be gone for a bit."
"Alright," she nodded.
While Mu Xuelian wandered around the world, curiously examining the various materials scattered throughout the area, Yuan flew away from the island and disappeared into the distant horizon.
A few minutes later, he came to a stop after arriving before a certain hovering object.
A smile slowly appeared on his face as he gazed at the massive floating gates connected to a flight of stairs that seemed to be made for giants.
It was the Stairway to Heaven.
He placed his hand on the door and whispered to it, "You could've hidden anywhere in this world, but you decided to return home..."
Suddenly, the doors creaked open.
Without a word, Yuan entered the Stairway to Heaven.
"Master..."
A familiar voice echoed in the darkness, and before long, Tian'er appeared before Yuan like a ghost.
"Are you okay?" Yuan asked.
"Yes," she calmly nodded. "That level of attack can't harm me."
"Then do you know who attacked you?"
She shook her head.
After a brief pause, Tian'er continued, "Those people were using an energy that felt similar to Eternal Essence."
"You mentioned that before. Can you elaborate?" he asked, prompting her to elaborate further.
"It's hard to describe. It feels like Eternal Essence, but not at the same time."
Yuan pondered for a moment before muttering, "It sounds like fake Eternal Essence, but I can't be certain unless I see it for myself."
"In that case..." Tian'er suddenly made a grasping motion with her hand, summoning a wisp of mysterious energy before him.
"This is..." Yuan's eyes widened.
"I collected it when I was attacked," she said.
Yuan examined the Eternal Essence with a slight frown on his face.
"As I thought, it's similar to the energy Supreme Ruler Grant was using, though there are some noticeable differences," Yuan remarked.
Compared to Supreme Ruler Grant's Eternal Essence, this energy felt less refined—but not in the same manner as Supreme Ruler Dena's imitation Eternal Essence.
Supreme Ruler Grant's energy had felt complete and refined, whereas Supreme Ruler Dena's was incomplete and simplistic.
This energy, however, existed somewhere in between. It was complete, yet lacking refinement.
'If Supreme Ruler Grant acquired his ability from Deemo, it's very likely that these attackers were granted similar powers by another Eternal.' Yuan thought, quickly putting the pieces together.
'But why would an Eternal attack the Stairway to Heaven?'
He could not comprehend why an Eternal would take interest in the Stairway to Heaven, a treasure that primarily served as a convenience for the inhabitants of the Nine Heavens.
Although it also functioned as a storage treasure, nobody besides Yuan should know about that secret.
'Even if this Eternal somehow discovered it, there's no way they would be interested in a mortal treasure...'
The more he thought about it, the more incomprehensible the Eternal's actions became.
However, Yuan wasn't concerned about the Eternal's motives.
'If I put the Stairway to Heaven into commission again, it would only be attacked again...'
After some thought, he reached a conclusion.
"Sorry, but it looks like you'll have to hide a little longer—at least until I figure out why you're being attacked and deal with it," he said to Tian'er a moment later.
"Then what about the Nine Heavens? Without me, the people there won't be able to travel between the realms," Tian'er said with a perplexed expression.
After serving in such a role for countless years, she had long since come to view assisting the people of the Nine Heavens as her responsibility.
"I'll just make another treasure with the same function," Yuan calmly said, leaving Tian'er speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 2506 Crafting A New Stairway to Heaven
paragraphs: "You'll... make another treasure... to replace me...?" Tian'er muttered in a dazed voice after hearing Yuan's words.
"You... are going to replace me...?"
Tian'er's eyes trembled slightly, looking as though she were on the verge of tears.
Seeing her reaction, Yuan quickly waved his hands and said, "I'm not replacing you! It's only temporary!"
He then continued in a reassuring voice, "Once I deal with whoever attacked you, you can return to the Nine Heavens."
"You promise?"
"Of course," Yuan said, feeling surprised, as this was the first time he'd seen such a reaction from her.
"Okay." Tian'er nodded her head, quickly calming down.
'To think she's capable of crying now... she's really grown,' Yuan smiled inwardly.
In the past, Tian'er had never been the expressive type. Despite her youthful appearance, she always carried herself with a calm and mature demeanor, remaining composed no matter the situation.
In fact, this was the reason why Tian Qiyuan allowed her to manage the Stairway to Heaven by herself—to bear such massive responsibilities.
After talking with Tian'er for a little longer, as well as reassuring her that he'd never replace her, Yuan left the Stairway to Heaven and returned to the island.
"How was it?" Zi Xuan asked Yuan after his return.
"Everything is fine... for now," he replied. "Unfortunately, she won't be able to return to the Nine Heavens for a little longer."
Yuan proceeded to explain the entire situation to her.
"An Eternal targeting the Stairway to Heaven? That's definitely a first..." Zi Xuan muttered with a thoughtful expression.
However, just like Yuan, she could not come up with any reasonable explanation for such strange behavior.
"So, what are you planning to do now?" Zi Xuan then asked.

"I'm going to craft a new Stairway to Heaven," Yuan replied. "This is the only place that has enough materials and a proper blacksmithing environment, so since I'm already here, I might as well make it now."
"A new Stairway to Heaven?" Zi Xuan's eyes widened with surprise. "What about Tian'er? And if I recall correctly, it took you several thousand years to craft her."
"I'm only going to use it temporarily. Once I resolve the issue with the Eternal, Tian'er will be able to return to the Nine Heavens," Yuan explained again.
"Besides, this time I'm only crafting it with the traveling function, so it won't take nearly as long."

Compared to Tian'er, this new Stairway to Heaven would be extremely bare-bones. It would not possess storage capabilities or the numerous world-class defensive mechanisms integrated into Tian'er, which was precisely why it would require far less time to craft.
"Anyway, since it's been a while, I'll craft the new Stairway to Heaven first as a warm-up," Yuan said as he approached the nearby wooden house.

The interior of the building was just as humble and simple as its exterior. Aside from a single bed spacious enough to comfortably fit two people, the only other furnishings were basic necessities such as a table and a few chairs.
Yuan walked to the closet beside the bed and retrieved a set of blacksmithing attire, then changed out of his current clothes and into it. Unsurprisingly, it fitted him perfectly.
The moment Zi Xuan saw Yuan wearing Tian Qiyuan's blacksmithing attire, a chill ran down her spine, causing her body to tremble uncontrollably with excitement.
"What are you doing now?" Mu Xuelian suddenly returned and asked him.
"Crafting treasures."
"Oh? What kind?"
"The Stairway to Heaven... something like that."
Mu Xuelian raised her eyebrows and asked, "Could it be... are you trying to replace the one that disappeared?"
"That's right."
"Why bother? It's none of your business. Seems like a waste of time and effort. Or are you really that generous?"
Yuan smiled and said, "Actually, it is my business, since I was the one who created the original one."
"What?" Mu Xuelian's eyes widened in disbelief after hearing his words.
However, Yuan did not bother elaborating further and simply turned around and walked away.
Some time later, he arrived at a cave located at the foot of the multicolored crystal mountain before calmly stepping inside.

Although the cave appeared pitch-black from the outside, the moment Yuan stepped inside, the walls began emitting a faint glow that steadily grew brighter until the entire interior was fully illuminated.
The light revealed a long tunnel that stretched deeper into the mountain, leading toward a spacious chamber further within.
At the center of the chamber stood a massive anvil that appeared brand new, with not even a single scratch.

Meanwhile, hanging on a nearby wall was a black hammer radiating an overwhelming aura. Its presence was so immense that the gravity surrounding it had become several times heavier simply because it existed there.
Hanging beside the hammer was another object—a golden wheel that naturally emitted an overwhelming amount of heat.
The temperature surrounding it was so intense that anyone without strong fire immunity would likely combust simply by standing too close to it.
After taking a moment to reminisce about this place and the countless treasures he had forged in the past, Yuan walked toward the wall and grabbed the black hammer.
"Oh!" Yuan let out a startled sound when his entire arm suddenly dropped unnaturally, as though he had just picked up something far heavier than he anticipated.
However, he'd managed to adjust his strength right before the hammer touched the floor.
"I forgot how heavy you were..." Yuan muttered with a smile as he lifted it back up.
Meanwhile, Zi Xuan and Mu Xuelian had followed Yuan into the mountain, but the two of them stopped at the entrance of the chamber instead of entering it.
"You do not want to be inside once he starts working," Zi Xuan said as she suddenly raised her arm to stop Mu Xuelian, who had nearly stepped into the chamber.
"Especially not someone like you, who already struggles with heat," she added.
Some time later, Yuan spoke, "I'm going to do some mental training first."
He then took a seat on the ground and closed his eyes.

sentences.text: "You'll... make another treasure... to replace me...?" Tian'er muttered in a dazed voice after hearing Yuan's words.
"You... are going to replace me...?"
Tian'er's eyes trembled slightly, looking as though she were on the verge of tears.
Seeing her reaction, Yuan quickly waved his hands and said, "I'm not replacing you!
It's only temporary!"
He then continued in a reassuring voice, "Once I deal with whoever attacked you, you can return to the Nine Heavens."
"You promise?"
"Of course," Yuan said, feeling surprised, as this was the first time he'd seen such a reaction from her.
"Okay." Tian'er nodded her head, quickly calming down.
'To think she's capable of crying now... she's really grown,' Yuan smiled inwardly.
In the past, Tian'er had never been the expressive type.
Despite her youthful appearance, she always carried herself with a calm and mature demeanor, remaining composed no matter the situation.
In fact, this was the reason why Tian Qiyuan allowed her to manage the Stairway to Heaven by herself—to bear such massive responsibilities.
After talking with Tian'er for a little longer, as well as reassuring her that he'd never replace her, Yuan left the Stairway to Heaven and returned to the island.
"How was it?" Zi Xuan asked Yuan after his return.
"Everything is fine... for now," he replied.
"Unfortunately, she won't be able to return to the Nine Heavens for a little longer."
Yuan proceeded to explain the entire situation to her.
"An Eternal targeting the Stairway to Heaven?
That's definitely a first..." Zi Xuan muttered with a thoughtful expression.
However, just like Yuan, she could not come up with any reasonable explanation for such strange behavior.
"So, what are you planning to do now?" Zi Xuan then asked.
"I'm going to craft a new Stairway to Heaven," Yuan replied.
"This is the only place that has enough materials and a proper blacksmithing environment, so since I'm already here, I might as well make it now."
"A new Stairway to Heaven?" Zi Xuan's eyes widened with surprise.
"What about Tian'er?
And if I recall correctly, it took you several thousand years to craft her."
"I'm only going to use it temporarily.
Once I resolve the issue with the Eternal, Tian'er will be able to return to the Nine Heavens," Yuan explained again.
"Besides, this time I'm only crafting it with the traveling function, so it won't take nearly as long."
Compared to Tian'er, this new Stairway to Heaven would be extremely bare-bones.
It would not possess storage capabilities or the numerous world-class defensive mechanisms integrated into Tian'er, which was precisely why it would require far less time to craft.
"Anyway, since it's been a while, I'll craft the new Stairway to Heaven first as a warm-up," Yuan said as he approached the nearby wooden house.
The interior of the building was just as humble and simple as its exterior.
Aside from a single bed spacious enough to comfortably fit two people, the only other furnishings were basic necessities such as a table and a few chairs.
Yuan walked to the closet beside the bed and retrieved a set of blacksmithing attire, then changed out of his current clothes and into it.
Unsurprisingly, it fitted him perfectly.
The moment Zi Xuan saw Yuan wearing Tian Qiyuan's blacksmithing attire, a chill ran down her spine, causing her body to tremble uncontrollably with excitement.
"What are you doing now?" Mu Xuelian suddenly returned and asked him.
"Crafting treasures."
"Oh?
What kind?"
"The Stairway to Heaven... something like that."
Mu Xuelian raised her eyebrows and asked, "Could it be... are you trying to replace the one that disappeared?"
"That's right."
"Why bother?
It's none of your business.
Seems like a waste of time and effort.
Or are you really that generous?"
Yuan smiled and said, "Actually, it is my business, since I was the one who created the original one."
"What?" Mu Xuelian's eyes widened in disbelief after hearing his words.
However, Yuan did not bother elaborating further and simply turned around and walked away.
Some time later, he arrived at a cave located at the foot of the multicolored crystal mountain before calmly stepping inside.

Although the cave appeared pitch-black from the outside, the moment Yuan stepped inside, the walls began emitting a faint glow that steadily grew brighter until the entire interior was fully illuminated.
The light revealed a long tunnel that stretched deeper into the mountain, leading toward a spacious chamber further within.
At the center of the chamber stood a massive anvil that appeared brand new, with not even a single scratch.
Meanwhile, hanging on a nearby wall was a black hammer radiating an overwhelming aura.
Its presence was so immense that the gravity surrounding it had become several times heavier simply because it existed there.
Hanging beside the hammer was another object—a golden wheel that naturally emitted an overwhelming amount of heat.
The temperature surrounding it was so intense that anyone without strong fire immunity would likely combust simply by standing too close to it.
After taking a moment to reminisce about this place and the countless treasures he had forged in the past, Yuan walked toward the wall and grabbed the black hammer.
"Oh!" Yuan let out a startled sound when his entire arm suddenly dropped unnaturally, as though he had just picked up something far heavier than he anticipated.
However, he'd managed to adjust his strength right before the hammer touched the floor.
"I forgot how heavy you were..." Yuan muttered with a smile as he lifted it back up.
Meanwhile, Zi Xuan and Mu Xuelian had followed Yuan into the mountain, but the two of them stopped at the entrance of the chamber instead of entering it.
"You do not want to be inside once he starts working," Zi Xuan said as she suddenly raised her arm to stop Mu Xuelian, who had nearly stepped into the chamber.
"Especially not someone like you, who already struggles with heat," she added.
Some time later, Yuan spoke, "I'm going to do some mental training first."
He then took a seat on the ground and closed his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 2507 Upgrading Number One Under Heaven
paragraphs: After closing his eyes, Yuan immediately began his mental simulations, and for the next several hours, he'd craft the treasure again and again until he felt prepared.
He opened his eyes and stood up before approaching the anvil. He then reached underneath the anvil, retrieving an emerald-colored spatial ring.
Inside the spatial ring were countless priceless materials that Tian Qiyuan had collected over the years as the God of Creation.

Being one of the most experienced and skilled God of Creation in history, he'd easily racked up unfathomable wealth. However, he'd spent pretty much all of that wealth to purchase more materials and to create this world.
After confirming that he had plenty of materials to work with, even if he failed a few times, Yuan declared, "I am going to start now."
"How is he supposed to forge treasures without any fire?" Mu Xuelian asked with a puzzled expression.
Although she was not a blacksmith herself, she still understood the basics. Yet from the appearance of the chamber, there was neither a furnace nor even the slightest trace of flames.
"In the past, he had a helper produce the flames. Unfortunately, she's not available right now. That being said, he has his own ways..." Zi Xuan replied.
The next moment, Yuan gestured toward the golden wheel hanging on the wall, causing it to fly into the air and hover directly above the anvil.
Yuan then infused the golden wheel with his spiritual energy, causing it to slowly begin spinning.
At first, its rotation was sluggish, but it rapidly accelerated until it became nothing more than a golden blur.
At that moment, Yuan retrieved a material from his spatial ring and placed it atop the anvil.
He then raised the black hammer high into the air, and just before he brought it down, the spinning golden wheel suddenly erupted with flames.
Like a blazing waterfall, the fire poured down from above, engulfing the anvil and Yuan's entire figure.
"What the—?!" Mu Xuelian cried out loud after seeing this, startled by the unexpected turn of events.
Then, Yuan swung the hammer down and struck the material resting on the anvil.
A crisp 'ting' echoed throughout the chamber, while the surrounding flames exploded outward from the impact, scattering across the room like a fiery storm.
"Heavens!" Mu Xuelian shouted loudly as she instinctively jumped backward upon seeing the flames surge toward them. In contrast, Zi Xuan remained perfectly still.
Just as the raging fire reached the entrance of the chamber, it abruptly stopped, blocked by an invisible barrier.
"I stopped you from going inside for a reason," Zi Xuan remarked without looking away from the scene.
Clang! Ting! Clang!
Yuan moved with a rhythmic flow, each strike of his hammer producing sounds that blended together like a mesmerizing piece of music.
After refining the first material, Yuan retrieved another from his spatial ring and fused it together with the refined piece.
All the while, he remained constantly engulfed in the blazing flames pouring down from above. Fortunately, due to his Fire Harmony, the flames could not harm him in the slightest.
In the past, Tian Qiyuan had acquired his Fire Immunity purely through blacksmithing, having spent countless years working amidst unbearable heat day and night.
Two days later, the golden wheel suddenly started spinning in the opposite direction, and instead of producing flames, it collected them instead.
Soon, it cleared all the fire in the room, allowing Mu Xuelian and Zi Xuan to see inside the chamber clearly.
<Congratulations! You have crafted a Celestial-grade treasure!>
Meanwhile, Yuan picked up the fist-sized object on the anvil and inspected it.
<Give a name to your newly crafted treasure?>
"Let's just call it Nameless Stairway," he muttered with a satisfied smile on his face, and he tossed it into his spatial ring.
"Are we done now?" Mu Xuelian asked him.
Yuan shook his head and said, "No, we're just getting started."
"What do you mean?" she raised her eyebrows in a puzzled manner.
"I still need to be upgraded," Zi Xuan said as she entered the chamber.
However, Yuan quickly said, "Not yet. I am going to craft several more treasures before I work on you."
"Huh?" Zi Xuan halted in her steps, looking dumbfounded.
"What else do you need to make?" she then asked.
"Some treasures for a few friends," he replied with a smile.
Since he was in the perfect situation and had plenty of materials, he might as well craft some treasures for Meixiu and the other members of the Demon Sealing Faction.
"Oh... Okay..."
Without wasting another moment, Yuan immediately returned to crafting more treasures.
A few days later, a small mountain of Celestial-grade treasures appeared beside Yuan.
"Alright, this should be enough," he muttered as he casually tossed them into his spatial ring.
"Is it finally time for my upgrade?" Zi Xuan asked.
Yuan looked at her and nodded with a smile.
"Finally!"
Zi Xuan immediately flew into the chamber and sat on top of the anvil.
"Do I need to leave the sword while you work on it? Or can I remain inside while you upgrade it?"
"Of course you'll need to leave," Yuan replied with a sigh. "There's a chance it might damage your soul if you remained, and I am not going to risk that."
"Fine..." Zi Xuan replied with a reluctant look on her face.
A moment later, she reverted to her sword form before emerging from it.
"This is my first time leaving the sword after becoming its spirit," she said in a saddened voice before leaving the chamber.
Yuan retrieved the material he planned on using to upgrade Number One Under Heaven and examined it.
"Infinite Obisidian... I will need to study this material a little before I use it," he mumbled to himself.

The material Yuan intended to use to upgrade Number One Under Heaven was none other than Infinite Obsidian, a mysterious material he had obtained from the Refined Obsidian Dragon during his visit to the Primal Expanse.

chapters.title: Chapter 2508 Upgrading Number One Under Heaven(2)
paragraphs: Yuan moved Number One Under Heaven to the side before placing the Infinite Obsidian onto the anvil.
He then lightly tapped it with his hammer to gauge its toughness, only to be surprised by the result.
He proceeded to stare at the Infinite Obsidian in silence for a moment before suddenly raising the hammer high into the air and bringing it down with his full strength.
CLANG!
The entire chamber trembled violently from the overwhelming pressure generated by the impact.
"Wow..." Yuan muttered in a surprised voice after seeing the results.
Despite using his full strength, the Infinite Obisdian remained unscathed.
"Is this thing indestructible or something?" he wondered aloud, as he'd never seen a material this durable before.
Suddenly, Mu Xuelian approached the chamber and said, "Lord Shiva has something to say."
"Hm?"
By the time Yuan turned to look at her, Shiva had already taken control of Mu Xuelian's body and was slowly approaching him.
However, her attention was not on Yuan at all, but on the piece of Infinite Obsidian resting atop the anvil.
"Do you recognize it?" he asked her.
She nodded and said, "We call it Void Fragment, and it's commonly used for crafting treasures by Eternals who are into that."
"Where does it come from?" Yuan then asked.
"From inside black holes," she calmly replied.
"What?" Yuan raised his eyebrows, doubting whether he had heard her correctly.

"As black holes continuously consume matter over time, everything inside them becomes compressed beyond logic," Shiva explained in a calm voice. "We simply harvest the remnants whenever we need them, since materials like these are actually quite abundant there."
After a moment of silence, Yuan asked, "Then how do they refine something like this?
"How would I know?" Shiva shrugged. "Very few Eternals are actually interested in crafting treasures."
She then continued, "However, since we're talking about Eternals, they most likely use Eternal Essence. After all, Eternal Essence is capable of cutting through even the supposedly indestructible."
"Oh? Using Eternal Essence to forge treasures? Why didn't I think of that sooner?"
A flicker of excitement appeared within Yuan's eyes the moment he realized the possibility.
Yuan immediately infused some Eternal Essence into his hammer before striking the Void Fragment once again, though this time he deliberately held back his strength.
Ding!
Even though he had only used a few billion years' worth of Eternal Essence, Yuan finally managed to make progress on the material, slightly flattening the previously unmoving Void Fragment.
"It... actually worked?" Yuan muttered in a somewhat dazed voice.
He could've never imagined the solution would be so simple.
"In my eyes, you're doing too much," Shiva suddenly said.
"What do you mean?"
Without saying a word, Shiva suddenly reached toward the Void Fragment with her bare hands.
The moment she grabbed it, she wrapped her hand in Eternal Essence and began stretching and molding the material as though it were nothing more than ordinary clay.
Seeing this absurd scene unfold before him, Yuan was left utterly speechless.
"I have seen an Eternal crafting treasure once, and this is what they did," she said as she placed the material back on the anvil, now shaped like a rod.
Yuan fell silent.
A few moments later, he turned to look at Number One Under Heaven, and then Zi Xuan.
"What's the matter?" Zi Xuan asked.

Yuan released a deep sigh and said, "Because of the refinement method required for this material, I won't be able to upgrade Number One Under Heaven using my usual methods. There's a high chance I'll have to completely melt it down and recreate it from scratch."
"What?!" Zi Xuan exclaimed in shock. "At that point, it's not even an upgrade anymore—it's a complete reconstruction!"
"That's right. Which is why I want to know how you feel about it," Yuan said.
After all, Number One Under Heaven was not solely his treasure, but something the two of them shared together. If he was going to make such a drastic decision, he needed Zi Xuan's approval first.
Zi Xuan fell silent, a contemplative expression appearing on her beautiful face.

Eventually, she parted her lips and softly spoke, "Although this is incredibly sudden, it's not all that different from how people in life are sometimes forced to leave behind their old homes and move into new ones."
"Some end up with better lives afterward, but most end up worse off."
She then looked at Yuan with a faint smile and continued, "But since it's you, I don't have to worry about it turning out worse."
"I'll do my best not to disappoint your expectations," Yuan said with a serious expression on his face.

After a brief pause, he continued, "However, since this is my first time working with a material like this—not to mention using a completely new forging method—I'll need to experiment with it first through a few practice attempts."

Once Shiva left the chamber, Yuan immediately began forging several more treasures. However, rather than completing them entirely, he intentionally left them in a half-finished state, with the materials already fully refined and only the final shaping remaining.
He would then tear off a small piece from the Void Fragment and fuse it with the unfinished treasures.

Since the Void Fragment he possessed was fairly large, Yuan was not overly concerned about wasting a few small portions for his experiments, especially since it would lower the chances of him breaking Number One Under Heaven.
Over the next several days, Yuan would experiment with the Void Fragment using several techniques.
The first treasure Yuan forged using the Void Fragment turned out far more durable and powerful than he had anticipated, but he did not stop there and continued experimenting.
Over the following several days, he forged multiple treasures that clearly surpassed any Celestial-grade treasure he had ever created in the past.
Yet despite their astonishing quality, Yuan remained unsatisfied. It felt as though something crucial was still missing from his creations.
"What am I missing?" he mumbled as he stared at the scattered treasures before him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2509 Affinity
paragraphs: "Do you want to know what you're missing?" Shiva suddenly spoke.
"Hm?" Yuan turned to look at her with raised eyebrows. "I thought you didn't know much—if anything—about blacksmithing."

"I don't recall ever saying I know nothing about it," Shiva calmly replied. "While it's true that I've never personally forged a treasure before, I still understand the fundamentals, especially since I know someone who enjoys doing it and never stops yapping about it."
"What am I missing?" Yuan then asked. "Besides the obvious—a technique."

Shiva entered the chamber and said, "You may know how to use Eternal Essence, but your understanding is limited to the very basics. In fact, when it comes to utilizing Eternal Essence, you're no different from a newborn Eternal."

"Eternal Essence is the purest form of all existence. It is the true origin of everything. Whether it originates from water, fire, or anything else, once it becomes Eternal Essence, it all returns to the same source."
"I don't understand," Yuan said as he shook his head.
Without saying another word, Shiva raised both of her arms and revealed her open palms to him.
In the next moment, Eternal Essence gathered around both of her hands.
"What is the difference between the two?" she then asked.
Yuan examined the Eternal Essence on her palms for a moment before responding, "Nothing...? Or is this some sort of trick question?"
Without offering any explanation, Shiva suddenly clapped her hands, combining the Eternal Essence.
"Any difference?" she asked again.
"Nope."
Shiva separated her hands and closed her left hand.
A second later, she reopened it, and the Eternal Essence surrounding that hand had completely changed.
It now emitted an icy, chilling aura that instantly covered parts of the chamber in frost, despite the room having been unbearably hot just moments earlier.
She clapped her hands again, fusing the cold Eternal Essence with the ordinary one, creating a block of ice from thin air.
"If you combine fire with an even stronger fire, it will still remain fire," Shiva said.
"Unlike forging mortal treasures, when it comes to crafting Eternal-quality treasures, the materials themselves are not the most important aspect."
She then looked directly at Yuan and continued, "Your Eternal Essence is."
A flicker of realization suddenly flashed across Yuan's face, as though he had just experienced a moment of enlightenment.
However, even though he knew the problem, there was still one major issue.
"I understand what I've been missing now... but how did you do what you just did?" Yuan asked a moment later.
He summoned some Eternal Essence of his own and attempted to imitate Shiva's cold Eternal Essence, but no matter what he tried, he failed to replicate it.
"This isn't something you can simply replicate," Shiva said while shaking her head.

"Every being—including Eternals—has their own specialty. It's similar to how humans are all born with different talents. Some possess a natural affinity with yin, while others are more suited for yang. In the same way, you need to discover what your Eternal Essence is best suited for and materialize it."
"How do I know what affinity I have?" Yuan asked with raised eyebrows.
"Through experience and experimentation," Shiva replied calmly. "This isn't something you can uncover in just a day or two."
She then continued, "Typically, it takes an Eternal several hundred billion years before they discover their true affinity."
"That still doesn't explain anything..." Yuan sighed. "I don't even know where I'm supposed to begin."
Shiva then said, "Quite frankly, I don't even know whether a mortal like you is capable of wielding Eternal Essence the same way we Eternals do."
She paused for a moment before continuing, "For us, it simply becomes a natural part of our existence after enough time passes."
"So what? Does it just come to you naturally? Like how we learn to breath naturally?"
"Pretty much.
Yuan rubbed his eyes and sighed, wondering if he needed to delay upgrading Number One Under Heaven until he figured this thing out.

"Also, I know humans typically only have a few, like water, fire, earth, and wind. However, when it comes to Eternal Essence, there are many more types of affinity, like blood or shadow. Mine just happens to be something as simple as ice."
"Is it really impossible to create an Eternal-grade treasure without this affinity nonsense?" Yuan then asked.
"Well, if you have a material that has already been properly refined, it's possible. For example, I can refine that Void Fragment for you with my Eternal Essence."
Yuan immediately shook his head and said, "If I were upgrading another treasure, I wouldn't mind doing it that way. However, Number One Under Heaven is special, and my pride will not allow it."
"I guess you're out of luck then," Shiva shrugged.
Yuan pondered for a moment before speaking, "Fortunately, there's still some time before the banquet. I'll try to find my affinity before then. If not, I'll just postpone this until later."
"What banquet?" Shiva asked. "And when is it?"
"Just a little something I had planned before coming here. I still have a little over a month. If I cannot find my affinity in three—two weeks, I'll give up trying to upgrade my treasure for now."
"Two weeks?" Shiva sneered coldly. "If you can truly discover your affinity in such a short amount of time, I'll start calling you Father."
"You'll call me Father...?" A competitive smile immediately appeared on Yuan's face after hearing those words.
There was no way he would pass up an opportunity to make an Eternal address him in such a manner.
Without wasting any more time, he sat down and started fiddling with his Eternal Essence, trying all sorts of things to discover his affinity.

Meanwhile, after working nonstop, the Demon Sealing Clan had finally finished constructing the venue for the upcoming banquet—a massive platform supporting a grand courtyard with a direct line of sight toward the Demonic Realm nearby.
And even though there was still more than a month remaining before the banquet was set to begin, guests had already started arriving with gifts in hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 2510 Venue for the Divine Paragon's Banquet
paragraphs: "Welcome to the Demon Sealing Clan! If you have gifts for the Divine Paragon, please hand them over to the attendants stationed at the red-clothed table over there!"
"And if you did not bring anything, please proceed to the blue-clothed table to check in! The venue has not officially opened yet, but it will be ready soon!"
The Demon Sealers enthusiastically greeted the arriving guests.
"Where is the Divine Paragon? I'd like to pay my respect to him before the banquet begins," inquired one of the guests.
"I apologize, but the Divine Paragon is not present at this moment."
"What about the new leader of the Demon Sealing Clan?"
"The Clan Leader is currently not accepting any guests due to her tight schedule."
Meanwhile, the Demon Sealers working inside the courtyard would glance at the new guests from time to time out of curiosity.
"Wow! That's the current head of the Array Masters' Association, Ye Chen!"
"Isn't that the Divine Essence Monastery's Holy Empress? Even if it's the Divine Paragon, to think she'd travel from the Ninth Heaven just to see a man!"
"Who's that veiled woman beside her?"
"Isn't that the Holy Maiden, the number two genius of the younger generation? I heard she's the kind of genius that only appears once in a billion years."
"Surely, that must be an exaggeration. From what I've heard, nobody even knows what she's capable of and is questioning her position in the ranking."
"Didn't the Heavenly Son fight her and acknowledge her strength?"
The Demon Sealers continued chatting about the Holy Maiden for several minutes before another recognizable figure arrived at the venue.
Meanwhile, the guests passed the time by observing the newly arriving attendees as they waited for the venue to officially open.
Unsurprisingly, the vast majority of the guests who arrived were influential and widely renowned figures.

Of course, there were also attendees with little to no reputation whatsoever. Under normal circumstances, such people would have been ridiculed or outright chased away from a gathering of elites. However, since the Divine Paragon had personally declared that anyone was allowed to attend, the other guests could do nothing but tolerate their presence.
"Do you think the Celestial Emperor will show up?"
"Who knows? But if he wants to, it won't take any effort, since he can still travel between the realms even without the Stairway to Heaven."
"He clearly already possesses the technology to create treasures capable of teleportation between realms. I don't understand what's taking him so long to replace the Stairway to Heaven."
"I bet he doesn't even want to replace the Stairway to Heaven. There's a reason he restricted access to the Stairway to Heaven not too long ago."
A week passed in the blink of an eye, and before long, the venue for the banquet officially opened, with the Demon Sealing Clan finally allowing guests into the grand courtyard.
However, due to the overwhelming number of attendees, those with the greatest influence and status were given priority entry first.
"There's still a month until the banquet, but there's already tens of thousands of people here... I can only imagine how much more crowded it'll get later."
"Do they even have room for all of us?"
"I doubt it... Hell, most of us will probably have to watch from outside the venue altogether."
Soon, another week passed, and as the banquet drew nearer, even more people began arriving from all directions.
Despite the venue being located within the Starry Sky, nearly everyone who was capable tried their best to attend the banquet.
Before long, the number of guests exceeded the venue's capacity, forcing many attendees to remain outside the venue entirely.
However, since such a situation had long been expected, hardly anyone voiced any complaints about it.
As for the guests within the courtyard, they were all served food and drinks while they waited.

"I've never seen such an enormous gathering of influential figures before. I doubt even the Celestial Emperor could gather this many people at once for nothing more than a banquet," one of the Demon Sealers remarked with a dazed expression.
"The Divine Paragon is a legend amongst legends, after all. They're all so intrigued by his existence that they'd come to a place like this just to see him."
Suddenly, the atmosphere around the venue shifted, and a loud voice echoed throughout the area.
"Make way for the Celestial Family!
A path was swiftly opened through the massive crowd gathered around the venue, allowing an extravagant carriage to pass through.
"The Celestial Family? I suppose the Celestial Emperor won't be attending personally and has sent his family in his stead..."
"I bet one of his daughters is inside that carriage..."
"Hah... I guess even someone as powerful as the Celestial Emperor isn't above resorting to such tactics..."
Such whispers could be heard from the crowd.
Once the carriage arrived at the venue, its door slowly opened, and two figures stepped out.
"Heavens! It's Madam Jun and the First Princess! To think he'd send his most precious daughter! The Celestial Emperor must truly value the Divine Paragon to send her to him!"
The people there were shocked to see the First Princess, who was not only the eldest but also the most influential within the Celestial Family, appear at the banquet.
Shortly after their arrival, a figure flew out from within the courtyard and approached them.
"Welcome, Madam Jun and Lady Jun. I am Yan Hara, the current leader of the Demon Sealing Clan."
Madam Jun then spoke, "While we would like to participate in the banquet, our time is unfortunately limited. We were wondering if it would be possible for us to meet the Divine Paragon directly."
An apologetic expression appeared on Yan Hara's face as she responded, "I'm terribly sorry, but the Divine Paragon is not present yet."
"Do you know when he'll arrive?"
"Unfortunately not..." Yan Hara shook her head.
"What a pity..." Madam Jun muttered softly before turning to look at the veiled figure silently standing beside her, seemingly waiting for the First Princess to speak.

chapters.title: Chapter 2511 Eternals' Cultivation Method
paragraphs: After a moment of silence, the First Princess spoke in a soft voice, "It's fine, I can wait."

Madam Jun raised an eyebrow and spoke to her using voice transmission, "You know our schedule is full, and we're already running late, right? In the first place, I agreed to come here only because you said you'd leave immediately after meeting the Divine Paragon."
"Yes, I will leave after meeting the Divine Paragon, but until then... the others can wait."
Madam Jun pinched her nose bridge and released a weary sigh.

"This is a crucial period for securing your position within the family. Even if you currently hold the advantage, it is only by a slight margin. If you continue to dawdle like this, your siblings will eventually surpass you."

After a slight pause, she continued, "Even if the Divine Paragon is a legend, we are long past his era. Once all of the excitement dies down, he will quickly become irrelevant, so if you're trying to acquire his backing..."
"I didn't come here to recruit him," said the First Princess, leaving Madam Jun speechless.
"You're not? Then why are we wasting our time here?"
Instead of responding to her question, the First Princess said, "Can't you just let me be selfish for once?"

"Will that help you defeat your siblings? If so, then you may be as selfish as you wish. Listen, Jun'er... I'm only doing this for your own good. Moreover, it's not like this is your only chance to meet the Divine Paragon."
Eventually, the First Princess gave up and muttered in a somewhat reluctant voice, "...Fine."
Without saying anything else, the First Princess turned around and returned to the carriage.

The entire conversation had been conducted through voice transmission, so nobody present knew what they had discussed. Even if someone possessed the ability to intercept their conversation, nobody there was foolish enough to eavesdrop on the Celestial Family and risk offending them.
"They're leaving just like that?"
The others were surprised to see the Celestial Family departing right after they arrived.
"There's no way. Did the Celestial Emperor not send the First Princess to seduce the Divine Paragon?"
Yan Hara watched the Celestial Family disappear into the void with a slightly puzzled look on her face, wondering why they wanted to meet the Divine Paragon.
"Clan Leader Yan! Do you have some time right now? I'd love to—"
Suddenly, people began approaching Yan Hara, who finally made her presence known.
However, Yan Hara quickly waved them off and said, "Sorry, but I am busy."
After saying that, she quickly turned around and flew back into the courtyard. When some tried to follow her, they were immediately blocked by the Demon Sealers.
'Where are you now, Yuan...?' Yan Hara sighed inwardly.
Time continued to pass, and soon, there were only two weeks left before the banquet was scheduled to begin. Yet, the Divine Paragon was still nowhere to be seen.
Meanwhile, Yuan had spent this entire time trying to discover his own affinity. Unfortunately, no matter how much effort he put into it, he made absolutely no progress.
After all, it was practically impossible to learn something when he did not even understand what that thing truly was.
"Lord Shiva said to just give it up," Mu Xuelian suddenly said out loud. "There's no way you'll be able to discover your affinity like that."
Yuan looked at her and asked, "What were you doing when you first discovered your own affinity?"
"I was napping... said Lord Shiva," Mu Xuelian relayed her response.
"What?" Yuan raised his eyebrows, looking utterly dumbfounded by her response.

"Or more precisely, after I awakened from my nap," Shiva corrected herself. "However, during my slumber, I had a dream where my entire existence was frozen—sealed within an indestructible block of ice."
"After breaking out of that ice and waking up, I discovered my affinity," she added.
"You can't be serious..."
After a moment of silence, Yuan continued to ask, "What were you doing prior to taking your nap?"
"What most Eternals do when they are not napping or fighting each other. I was cultivating.
"Now that I think about it, I have never seen an Eternal cultivating. Does it differ from how I do it?" Yuan asked as he began absorbing the surrounding essence.
"Unfortunately, I cannot cultivate Eternal Essence with this body. That being said, it's definitely different, and I can show you how it's done."
Shiva suddenly took control of Mu Xuelian's body and approached Yuan.
"I'll show the method to your soul directly," she said. "However, since I'm essentially sharing a cultivation method meant for Eternals, the price will be immense."
She narrowed her eyes at him before continuing, "Quite frankly, there's a real chance that you could die from it. Knowing this now, are you still willing to learn?"
Yuan subconsciously swallowed nervously after hearing her warning. However, before he could say anything, Shiva continued speaking.
"What you're currently doing is essentially no different from how an unborn Eternal cultivates," she said. "It's simple... but terribly inefficient."
Yuan then asked, "Do all Eternals cultivate using the same method?"
"Technically, yes," Shiva replied. "Although every Eternal eventually develops their own unique cultivation method, they all originate from a single source and are merely altered versions."
"And where did this cultivation method originally come from?" Yuan asked with a curious expression.
"That... does it really matter?" Shiva responded after a brief pause.
"Huh?" Yuan immediately narrowed his eyes at her with suspicion. "Of course it matters. How am I supposed to know this isn't some dangerous technique?"
He then continued in a wary voice, "I know better than to cultivate a method with an unknown origin—especially one coming from an Eternal."

"Do you think I'm trying to control your mind with this technique or something?" Shiva rebuked, clearly offended by his suspicion. "If you don't want to learn it, then don't. I doubt you'll even survive long enough to cultivate it anyway!"
After a long moment of contemplation, Yuan finally responded, "I want to learn it."
