chapters.title: Chapter 2512 Learning the Eternals' Cultivation Technique
paragraphs: "Why the sudden change of heart? Aren't you worried that I might try to seize your body?" Shiva sneered sarcastically.
"I'm only going to learn it first. Whether I actually cultivate it or not will depend entirely on its contents," Yuan calmly replied.
"And what about the risks? You do understand that there is a very high chance you could die, right?" Shiva said, heavily emphasizing the word 'very'.

After all, unlike merely learning forbidden knowledge about Eternals, Yuan was attempting to learn their cultivation method itself—something that would never even be considered a possible topic for a mere mortal like him under normal circumstances.
"I will be fine," Yuan replied in a casual, almost nonchalant tone.
Shiva narrowed her eyes at him and said, "I will ask you again. Are you certain you want to learn this cultivation technique? There's a good chance that you might not even be able to use it."
"You're really that worried about me, huh?" Yuan chuckled, leaving her speechless.
"You promised to help me regain my true body! I am not going to let you die so easily!" she exclaimed angrily.
"I appreciate the concern, but since I am already in the process of tempering an Eternal Constitution, I will need to learn your cultivation technique sooner or later."
Shiva fell silent, as she'd forgotten about Yuan possessing an incomplete Eternal Constitution.
'Since he's practically half Eternal at this point, he might not need to sacrifice too much to learn our cultivation technique...' she thought inwardly.
'Since he's practically half Eternal at this point, he might not need to sacrifice too much to learn our cultivation technique...' she thought inwardly.
"Alright. Prepare yourself."
Yuan nodded and took a minute to mentally prepare himself before declaring, "I am ready.
Without the slightest hesitation, Shiva grabbed the top of Yuan's head with a claw-like grip before directly transferring the cultivation technique into his soul.

The instant the information began flooding into him, Yuan's entire expression went blank. Even his eyes lost all focus, becoming hollow and lifeless, as though he had suddenly turned into a mindless husk.
Not only was the cultivation technique of the Eternals fundamentally different from those practiced by mortals, but they were also unimaginably profound.
The moment Yuan received the technique, it felt as though he had been thrown into an endless ocean with no visible bottom, slowly drowning in it.
Very quickly, noticeable changes began appearing across Yuan's body.

His skin, which had been flawlessly smooth only moments earlier, suddenly became dry and wrinkled. At the same time, his well-refined physique rapidly withered, his muscles shrinking as though all vitality had been drained from him in an instant.
In mere moments, he looked as if he had suddenly aged into an old man.
Shiva narrowed her eyes slightly upon seeing Yuan's condition, but she was neither shocked nor alarmed by it, as she had already anticipated such a reaction.
This phenomenon was caused by the rapid consumption of Yuan's longevity. Even so, Shiva made no attempt to stop the transfer and continued with a somewhat nonchalant expression.

After all, the moment Shiva began transmitting the technique to him, Yuan had already paid the price in full. Even if she were to stop midway, it would not restore the longevity that had already been sacrificed.

Meanwhile, from Yuan's perspective, the information contained within the technique was no different from incomprehensible gibberish, much like when he had first attempted to learn Heaven's Secret Art from Xiao Hua.
Eternals possessed their own language, and the cultivation technique had been written entirely in that language.

Despite this, Yuan was not overly worried. If this situation were anything like when he had learned Heaven's Secret Art, he would naturally come to understand it eventually. Because of that, he did not even attempt to forcibly decipher or comprehend the information, merely allowing it to flow into his mind.
"Dear..." Zi Xuan watched the situation unfold with a nervous expression on her face, her hands tightly clasped in anxiety.
She had accompanied Yuan through multiple lives and incarnations, yet never before had she seen him in such a frail and weakened state.
A few hours later, Shiva finished transferring the technique and finally released her grasp on Yuan.
The moment she did, his body collapsed limply onto the ground, his skeletal figure hitting the floor with a soft, lifeless thud.
"Dear!" Zi Xuan hurried over in panic, but there was nothing she could actually do except watch helplessly. Even if she wanted to hold him, she lacked a physical body and could not even touch him.
"He's still alive... surprisingly," Shiva suddenly said.
"However, acquiring the cultivation technique consumed nearly all of his longevity, leaving behind only a tiny fragment of it. If nothing is done, he'll die within a few days."
"What can we do?!" Zi Xuan immediately asked in a panicked voice.
"Since he isn't actually injured, recovery treasures will be useless," Shiva replied calmly. "What he needs is something capable of replenishing his lost longevity."
"Treasures capable of restoring longevity...?" Zi Xuan muttered with a dumbfounded expression.

Although Tian Qiyuan's world was unimaginably rich in resources—perhaps one of the wealthiest places in existence when it came to materials—it contained almost nothing outside of blacksmithing resources. As such, treasures capable of restoring longevity simply did not exist there.

Although Yuan still possessed his spatial ring, Zi Xuan was incapable of accessing it due to being a sword spirit. The same applied to Mu Xuelian, who was not the ring's owner and therefore could not open it either.
As for Yuan himself, he was far too weak to even lift a finger, possessing only enough strength to continue breathing.
Suddenly, Shiva returned control of the body to Mu Xuelian, who immediately said, "I will share some of my longevity with him."
Without another word, she knelt beside Yuan and extended her hand toward his chest.
After taking a deep breath, Mu Xuelian began extracting her own longevity before carefully transferring it into Yuan's body.

Almost immediately, Zi Xuan noticed a visible improvement in Yuan's condition. His breathing became steadier, and some of his vitality gradually returned, making him look less like a dried corpse. However, he still looked like a sick old man.

chapters.title: Chapter 2513 The Origin of the Cultivation Technique
paragraphs: Thud.
"That's it... That's the most I can do for him," Mu Xuelian said as she collapsed backward onto the ground, landing on her buttocks in complete exhaustion.
Zi Xuan narrowed her eyes at Yuan, whose condition had clearly improved after receiving some of Mu Xuelian's longevity.
Although he no longer resembled a dying old man, his skin remained wrinkled, while his body was still sickly pale and frighteningly thin, almost like a living skeleton.
"I have given him as much longevity as I can right now, but he's still in a dangerous situation," Mu Xuelian then said.
"This is... more than... enough... Thank you..." Yuan said in a weak voice.
"Can you... help me... into... the lotus position...?"
Mu Xuelian took a moment to catch her breath before helping Yuan into a lotus position.
Once seated, Yuan slowly closed his eyes and took a deep breath.

He began circulating the spiritual energy within his body, gradually recovering a portion of his strength. However, no matter how much he cultivated, there was only so much vitality he could regain through spiritual energy alone. What he truly lacked was longevity.
A few hours later, Yuan opened his eyes and said to Mu Xuelian, "Can you bring me outside of this world and into the Primordial Chaos?"
"What are you planning on doing?" she asked with raised eyebrows. "There's nothing but beasts out there."
"I need them to replenish my longevity," he responded.
"Is that so?"
Without asking any further questions, Mu Xuelian lifted Yuan with her spiritual energy and carried him outside.
The moment they stepped back into the Primordial Chaos, several powerful magical beasts immediately sensed their presence and began approaching from multiple directions.
"Do you need protection?" Mu Xuelian asked in a calm voice, as though the approaching magical beasts were of no concern to her.
"No," Yuan replied. "However, I will need your help. After I use this technique, I'll probably become too weak to even move."
Mu Xuelian silently nodded and watched attentively, waiting to see what Yuan intended to do.
Before long, the magical beasts arrived and immediately locked onto Yuan, whose weakened state made him appear to be the easiest prey among them.
However, before the magical beasts could even approach him, an ominous aura suddenly erupted from Yuan's body.
In the very next moment, every magical beast charging toward them froze midair, as though time itself had suddenly stopped around them.
<Forbidden Blood Extraction!>
Yuan had just used Forbidden Blood Extraction to forcibly extract the Blood Essence from the magical beasts.
Since Blood Essence was essentially a magical beast's refined life force, it could be used to help replenish the longevity he had lost.
However, the moment he finished extracting their Blood Essence, Yuan collapsed onto the ground once again.
"Can you collect their Blood Essence and feed it to me?" Yuan weakly said to Mu Xuelian.
Still somewhat dazed by what she had just witnessed, Mu Xuelian silently nodded before moving to retrieve the Blood Essence.
"How am I supposed to feed these to you?" Mu Xuelian asked after gathering all of the Blood Essence.
She examined them with curiosity, as each one resembled a tiny crimson crystal radiating pure vitality.
Yuan silently opened his mouth, indicating that she should feed them to him directly.
Without saying anything further, Mu Xuelian began placing the Blood Essence into his mouth one crystal at a time.
The moment the Blood Essence touched Yuan's tongue, it instantly melted away, dissolving into pure energy that disappeared into his body.
Rather than refining the Blood Essence into spiritual energy like most would do, Yuan directly converted it into vitality to replenish his lost longevity.
Although each Blood Essence restored only a few years of life, it was still enough for him to recover sufficient strength to move on his own once again.

And while Blood Essence could be consumed directly, most people preferred using it to refine longevity pills instead, as doing so was far more efficient and allowed them to extract significantly more vitality from it.
However, since Yuan essentially had an unlimited supply available to him, he could not care less about such inefficiencies.
"Thanks a lot. I should be fine for now," Yuan said as he slowly stood up and dusted off his clothes.
"What kind of technique was that?" Mu Xuelian suddenly asked.
"I could tell you, but then I'd have to kill you," Yuan replied with a serious expression on his face, completely catching Mu Xuelian off guard.
A moment later, he casually added, "I'm joking."
"You can head back for now. I'll return after I restore a bit more of my longevity," Yuan said before flying away to hunt more magical beasts.
Once Yuan disappeared into the distance, Shiva quietly took control of Mu Xuelian's body and silently stared in the direction he had gone.
"That power..." Shiva muttered with a contemplative look on her face.
It felt strangely familiar to her, as though she had encountered something similar somewhere in the distant past, yet for some reason, she could not remember where.
Two days later, Yuan returned to Tian Qiyuan's world, looking completely refreshed. However, his complexion still appeared slightly pale.
"How much longevity did you recover?" Mu Xuelian asked.
"A few thousand years," he calmly replied. "It's not much, but it's more than enough for now. I'll properly recover my longevity later."
"Lord Shiva asked when you plan to cultivate the technique," Mu Xuelian said.
"I've been going through its contents while hunting magical beasts over the past two days, but I still can't understand it well enough to begin cultivating it," Yuan replied.
"That being said, I've understood enough of it to know its origin."
Yuan narrowed his eyes at Mu Xuelian—or rather, at Shiva residing within her—and continued, "This cultivation technique... was it created by the Absolute Being?"
Shiva took control of Mu Xuelian's body before calmly responding, "That's correct. This cultivation method, used by every single Eternals at one point, was created by the Absolute Being."

chapters.title: Chapter 2514 Studying the Cultivation Technique
paragraphs: "Not only was this cultivation technique created by the Absolute Being, but it was also forced upon all of us," Shiva continued with a calm expression on her face.
"What do you mean?" Yuan asked, his head slightly tilted with puzzlement.
"Just like how humans are born with the instinct to breathe, every single Eternal is born into existence already knowing this cultivation technique," Shiva elaborated.
"Huh? How does that work? What about the Eternals born after the Absolute Being's death?"
Shiva looked at him with an odd expression and remarked, "Why would you say the Absolute Being is dead?"
"He's not?" Yuan raised his eyebrows, as he'd always had this assumption.

"If the Absolute Being is still alive, why are Eternals fighting to acquire the Absolute Power that he left behind? Surely, they wouldn't be doing such a thing if the Absolute Being were still alive."
After a moment of silence, Shiva spoke again.
"While it's true that nobody has seen the Absolute Being for an incredibly long time, nobody possesses any concrete evidence that he is dead either."

She paused briefly before continuing, "That being said, many Eternals believe he has already perished. However, I personally believe he is still alive. After all, there is simply no way a being as powerful as the Absolute Being could truly die. The very idea is unthinkable."
Despite speaking with such conviction, Yuan could clearly detect a faint trace of doubt hidden within Shiva's eyes, as though even she subconsciously questioned her own words.
'If Eternals are nearly impossible to kill, then it makes sense why she believes the Absolute Being cannot perish,' Yuan pondered inwardly.

'However, if he were truly still alive, then what about the Absolute Power he left behind? He must have left it there for a reason. And if he were actually alive, he would have already stopped the others from trying to covet his power.'
"Anyway, we are born knowing the Absolute Being's technique because it's nature," Shiva answered his question a moment later.
"I don't get it. How is it natural if you're forced to learn it?"
"Because it is a law of this universe," Shiva elaborated.
"Just as the ruler of a world can impose laws upon that world and its inhabitants, the Absolute Being—as the master of the universe itself—can establish laws that apply to all existence."
"And one of those laws is that every Eternal is born with this cultivation technique already engraved into their existence."
Yuan's jaw slowly dropped after hearing her explanation.
He had always known that the Absolute Being was regarded as the strongest Eternal, but such a title had always felt too abstract for him to truly comprehend.
However, after hearing Shiva's words, Yuan finally gained a small glimpse into just how terrifying the Absolute Being's powers truly were.
To impose a law upon the universe itself—one that affected every Eternal, including those not yet born—was simply beyond the comprehension of a mortal like Yuan.

Seeing Yuan's expression, Shiva spoke, "If you're thinking about asking me the reason, don't bother. Besides those close to the Absolute Being before his disappearance, nobody knows. Hell, there's a good chance that even they don't know why he made such a law."
"So from my understanding, every Eternal begins with this cultivation technique, but eventually modifies it and turns it into their own unique version?" Yuan asked for clarification.
"That's correct," Shiva nodded in confirmation.
"Anyway... What are you going to do now that you have the technique?"
"I'm going to study it," he said. "Maybe it'll help me discover my affinity."
Shiva sneered in disdain, "If it were that easy, it wouldn't have taken us so much time to discover our own affinity."
Yuan didn't entertain her and closed his eyes to focus on the cultivation technique.
<You have discovered the first cultivation technique in existence>
<Your progress toward Path to Eternity has increased>
[Progress: 20%]
Although Yuan still could not fully comprehend the cultivation technique, he was able to recite it flawlessly without the slightest issue.
As a result, he repeatedly recited the technique over and over, hoping that he would eventually grasp its meaning naturally through repetition, just as he did with Heaven's Secret Art.
'What a waste of time...' Shiva inwardly shook her head before returning control of the body to Mu Xuelian.
In Shiva's eyes, even if Yuan somehow managed to fully comprehend the cultivation technique, he still would not be capable of using it because he lacked the necessary body to support it.
She never bothered mentioning this to him because, to her, it was unnecessary.
However, just as Shiva was prepared to take a nap, she suddenly sensed Eternal Essence leaking from Yuan's body.
At first, she did not think much of it, but she still decided to take a closer look.
'Th-This is—!'
Shiva immediately seized control of Mu Xuelian's body again and stared at Yuan with a dumbfounded expression on her face.
'Although his Eternal Essence is still ordinary... I can sense something changing within it, almost as though an affinity is in the process of being born!'
Naturally, Yuan was completely unaware of the changes occurring within his Eternal Essence, as he was wholly immersed in comprehending the cultivation technique.
'How is this even possible?! He's nothing more than a mortal!'
Shiva subconsciously clenched her fists in agitation.
'This feeling... am I actually feeling inferior to a mere mortal?!' she cried inwardly in disbelief.
'No... this must be some sort of mistake. There's no way he's actually discovering his affinity out of nowhere like this.'
Shiva quickly took a deep breath to compose herself.
'Let's think through this rationally and wait a little longer before I come to any conclusions...'
Shiva proceeded to spend the next several hours closely observing Yuan and the Eternal Essence emanating from his body, which was becoming increasingly refined with every passing moment.
'I once witnessed an Eternal in the process of discovering their affinity, and what I'm seeing from him right now is incredibly similar...' she sighed inwardly.

Although Yuan still could not fully comprehend the cultivation technique, he was able to recite it flawlessly without the slightest issue.
As a result, he repeatedly recited the technique over and over, hoping that he would eventually grasp its meaning naturally through repetition, just as he did with Heaven's Secret Art.
'What a waste of time...' Shiva inwardly shook her head before returning control of the body to Mu Xuelian.
In Shiva's eyes, even if Yuan somehow managed to fully comprehend the cultivation technique, he still would not be capable of using it because he lacked the necessary body to support it.
She never bothered mentioning this to him because, to her, it was unnecessary.
However, just as Shiva was prepared to take a nap, she suddenly sensed Eternal Essence leaking from Yuan's body.
At first, she did not think much of it, but she still decided to take a closer look.
'Th-This is—!'
Shiva immediately seized control of Mu Xuelian's body again and stared at Yuan with a dumbfounded expression on her face.
'Although his Eternal Essence is still ordinary...
I can sense something changing within it, almost as though an affinity is in the process of being born!'
Naturally, Yuan was completely unaware of the changes occurring within his Eternal Essence, as he was wholly immersed in comprehending the cultivation technique.
'How is this even possible?!
He's nothing more than a mortal!'
Shiva subconsciously clenched her fists in agitation.
'This feeling... am I actually feeling inferior to a mere mortal?!' she cried inwardly in disbelief.
'No... this must be some sort of mistake.
There's no way he's actually discovering his affinity out of nowhere like this.'
Shiva quickly took a deep breath to compose herself.
'Let's think through this rationally and wait a little longer before I come to any conclusions...'
Shiva proceeded to spend the next several hours closely observing Yuan and the Eternal Essence emanating from his body, which was becoming increasingly refined with every passing moment.
'I once witnessed an Eternal in the process of discovering their affinity, and what I'm seeing from him right now is incredibly similar...' she sighed inwardly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2515 Yuan's Affinity
paragraphs: 'If he's truly discovering his affinity now, what kind of affinity will show up in a mortal body?' Shiva wondered inwardly as she continued watching Yuan.
Though she was irritated that Yuan might discover his affinity so soon, she was also intrigued by the possibilities.
'A mortal cultivating a cultivation technique meant for gods, huh? Will his incomplete Eternal Constitution even be able to handle the stress?'
'Perhaps I shouldn't even have given him the technique in the first place, as it only makes him even more of a threat to us...'
Shiva was slowly beginning to regret sharing the cultivation technique with Yuan, a mortal who was clearly not afraid of offending or clashing with Eternals.
A few more hours later, the Eternal Essence radiating from Yuan began undergoing a fundamental transformation, and the outline of his affinity slowly started to reveal itself.
Suddenly, a powerful chill ran down Shiva's spine, causing her to instinctively leap away from Yuan.
'What was that feeling?!' she cried inwardly, her eyes narrowing at Yuan.
That was when Shiva realized that everything surrounding Yuan was being converted into Eternal Essence.

However, upon closer inspection, she discovered that Yuan had not actually begun cultivating the technique yet. Instead, the surroundings around him were being transformed into Eternal Essence automatically.
As the Eternal Essence surrounding Yuan grew stronger and denser, his surroundings began transforming into essence at an increasingly rapid pace.
Naturally, this also meant that the chamber itself was slowly being destroyed by the process.
'Wait! Something isn't right!' Shiva's eyes widened when she noticed this.
When an Eternal begins discovering their affinity, their surroundings naturally reflect the nature of that affinity.
For example, when Shiva discovered her own affinity in her slumber, she awoke to find herself completely surrounded by indestructible ice.
"What kind of affinity is this...?" Shiva mumbled in a puzzled voice.
The more Shiva examined Yuan's Eternal Essence, the more confused she became.

Although there existed countless different affinities—far more than the number of Eternals themselves—she was familiar with many of them. Yet never before had she seen or even heard of an affinity capable of turning its surroundings into essence.
'Perhaps I was mistaken this entire time, and this phenomenon isn't caused by him discovering an affinity at all...' Shiva eventually thought inwardly.
'No, let's watch a little longer...'
While Shiva wanted to watch longer, Zi Xuan had a different thought.
"Wake up!" she shouted at Yuan.
"What are you doing?" Shiva frowned.
"Isn't it obvious that I am trying to wake him up?!" Zi Xuan exclaimed.
Before Shiva could respond, Zi Xuan continued, "Look around us! This place is going to be destroyed if things continue!"
"So what? If you disturb him now, he might never—"
"Shut up! This place might mean nothing to you, but it means everything to me!"

Without hesitation, Zi Xuan took advantage of her existence as his sword spirit and spoke directly into Yuan's mind through their connection. After all, she knew that he'd never hear her voice if she tried speaking to him normally.
Soon, Yuan slowly opened his eyes, and the Eternal Essence surrounding him gradually vanished soon after.
"If I had simply left you alone, you would've completely destroyed this entire place along with everything inside it," Zi Xuan said with a deep sigh.
Yuan looked around the chamber, and sure enough, it appeared as though an intense battle had taken place there.
Fortunately, the anvil and the golden wheel remained completely undamaged, as they were far more durable than the chamber itself.
"Thank you," Yuan said as he stood up. "If you hadn't stopped me, I would've completely wrecked this place, as well as this..."
Yuan looked at the golden wheel with a nostalgic air around him.
"You could have discovered your affinity if you hadn't stopped," Shiva said to him.
"My affinity? What are you talking about?" Yuan asked with raised eyebrows.
Shiva then explained everything that had happened while he was immersed in the cultivation technique.
"I see..." Yuan muttered afterward. "Although it's somewhat regrettable, I can always try again another time. If this place gets destroyed, it cannot be replaced."
"That being said, I still have more time. Let's try again at another location."
Yuan left the chamber shortly afterward and continued cultivating outside, where there was nothing important he could accidentally destroy.
Shiva inwardly shook her head and sighed.
'To waste a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity over something so insignificant... what a waste.'
She genuinely believed that what Yuan had experienced inside the chamber was the result of pure luck and that such a phenomenon could never be replicated again.
However, less than an hour after Yuan resumed cultivating, Eternal Essence once again began emanating from his body.
'What is going on...?' Shiva muttered with a bewildered look on her face.
Not only had the phenomenon returned, but it was now far stronger than before.
The ground beneath Yuan—and even the very air surrounding him—rapidly transformed into essence.
'T-This is—!"
Shiva's entire body trembled as a sudden realization struck her.
It had not been obvious before, but now she could finally discern the true nature of Yuan's affinity.
'No! It can't be! This is impossible!'
Shiva slowly stepped away from Yuan, a horrified expression appearing on her face, as though she had just witnessed something truly terrifying.
Suddenly, killing intent surfaced within Shiva's gaze, and her hands slowly clenched into tight fists.
'Should I just kill him before he realizes it...?' Shiva wondered inwardly.
However, Shiva had little time to dwell on those thoughts because almost immediately after the killing intent surfaced within her, Zi Xuan sensed it and attacked her from behind.
"What do you think you're doing?" Shiva slowly turned to look at Zi Xuan after blocking her attack with ease.
"I should be asking you that," Zi Xuan calmly responded. "I can sense your killing intent toward my darling. What are you trying to do?"
Shiva remained silent for a brief moment before calmly responding in a nonchalant voice, "Nothing. It's just a misunderstanding."
The killing intent in her eyes vanished completely afterward, and she returned to observing Yuan as though nothing had happened at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 2516 Shiva's Killing Intent
paragraphs: 'This bitch really thinks I'm stupid...' Zi Xuan narrowed her eyes at Shiva's back.
Even though Shiva had withdrawn her killing intent and claimed it was merely a misunderstanding, Zi Xuan did not believe her in the slightest.
However, Zi Xuan ultimately decided against attacking Shiva and instead continued observing her carefully.
After all, even if she did make a move, she had no real confidence in her ability to defeat Shiva, especially since they were not in the Nine Heavens.
Meanwhile, as Yuan's affinity gradually became more pronounced, his understanding of the cultivation technique also deepened accordingly.
Suddenly, after an entire day had passed, the Eternal Essence surrounding Yuan violently expanded outward like a bursting bubble, transforming everything it touched into essence.
Zi Xuan and Shiva hastily retreated the moment it happened, nearly getting caught within the expanding wave of Eternal Essence themselves.
The Eternal Essence continued expanding outward for countless miles, completely erasing everything in its path.

Fortunately, Yuan had deliberately moved far enough away beforehand, preventing the main island from being entirely consumed. Even so, by the time the expanding wave finally stopped, a sizeable portion of the island had vanished.
Yuan slowly opened his eyes shortly afterward.
He then released a small amount of Eternal Essence from his palm and quietly examined it.
"Shiva was right..." he muttered. "I can naturally sense my affinity now."
<You have discovered your Affinity!>
<Your progress toward Path to Eternity has increased!>
[Progress: 30%]
However, there was still one slight issue remaining.
Yuan returned to the main island, where Shiva and Zi Xuan had retreated earlier, before looking at Shiva and asking,
"What kind of affinity is this?"

He revealed his Eternal Essence to her, and unlike before, it now radiated with a myriad of colors resembling a miniature galaxy, as though he were holding the entire universe within the palm of his hand.
Shiva subconsciously swallowed nervously and did her utmost to maintain a calm exterior.
Then, with a deliberately nonchalant expression, she answered, "I... don't know."
"What?" Yuan frowned.
"There are countless different affinities in existence and only so many Eternals," Shiva explained in a calm voice. "Do you really think I would recognize every single affinity out there?"
Of course, she was lying.
"With that being said, I believe it would be best if you refrain from using that affinity too openly, especially in the presence of other Eternals..." Shiva continued.
"Unless, of course, you wish to become the subject of their experiments."
"Furthermore, an unknown affinity is far more dangerous than you realize," Shiva warned him.
Yuan glanced around at the destruction surrounding them before releasing a helpless sigh.
"You don't need to tell me that."
Some time later, after restoring the damaged portion of the island, Yuan returned to the chamber to test his newly awakened Eternal Essence.
He plucked off a tiny piece of the Void Fragment and began crafting another treasure with it.
However, the moment he attempted to refine the Void Fragment using his newly awakened Eternal Essence, his eyes widened in shock.
The Void Fragment was completely destroyed upon contact with it.
"What the...?" Yuan muttered before looking at Shiva with a puzzled face.
"What exactly do you expect me to say?" Shiva shrugged.
"What am I doing wrong?" Yuan asked.

"What you're doing isn't inherently wrong," Shiva replied. "If anything, the issue lies with your affinity itself. You've only just awakened it, so naturally, you're still unable to properly control it."
"So I am using too much of it?"
Yuan tried again, but this time, he carefully controlled his Eternal Essence and used as little of it as possible.
Yet, the result remained exactly the same. The instant his Eternal Essence fused with the Void Fragment, the material completely vaporized into thin air.
Shiva subconsciously clenched her fists as she watched Yuan use his newly awakened Eternal Essence.
'I'm almost certain that his affinity is...' she sighed inwardly, uncertain about how she should handle the situation moving forward.

As an Eternal, Shiva understood that it would be in her best interest to kill Yuan herself, because even if she chose not to act, the other Eternals would undoubtedly try to eliminate him the moment they discovered the nature of his affinity.
'A mortal capable of threatening gods—threatening our very existence... Such a thing would have once been utterly unthinkable. But now... it may truly become reality,' Shiva sighed inwardly.
"Hey." Yuan suddenly called out to Shiva, snapping her out of her daze.

"My Eternal Essence still destroyed it even when I used the smallest amount possible. Could this not be an issue of quantity?" He narrowed his eyes thoughtfully before continuing, "Perhaps my affinity has something to do with destruction?"
Shiva trembled the moment she heard his words, her eyes widening slightly. And despite her efforts to suppress it, a trace of killing intent once again surfaced within her gaze.
Yuan raised an eyebrow the moment he sensed the killing intent radiating from her, though he could not understand the reason behind it.
"That's quite a dangerous look you have there, Shiva. Are you feeling alright?" he asked cautiously.
Upon realizing that her killing intent had leaked out once again, Shiva immediately relinquished control of the body back to Mu Xuelian.
Rather than answering Yuan's question, she chose to avoid the situation altogether and retreated into silence.
"Umm... Lord Shiva said that she isn't feeling well and needs to rest..." Mu Xuelian spoke a moment later, her voice sounding unusually stiff and awkward.
Yuan wanted to press further, but he could tell that Mu Xuelian herself was just as confused by the situation as he was.

After witnessing Shiva's strange behavior for a second time, Zi Xuan decided to tell Yuan about what had happened during his cultivation through voice transmission, including the moment Shiva had revealed killing intent toward him earlier.
In the end, Yuan chose to remain silent about the matter for the time being while secretly raising his guard around Shiva.

Yuan soon returned to crafting treasures once again. However, because his supply of Void Fragments was limited, he decided not to use them until he figured out a way to refine materials without destroying them.
Thus, he began testing his Eternal Essence on ordinary materials. Though these "ordinary" materials would still be considered priceless treasures within the Nine Heavens.

chapters.title: Chapter 2517 New Stairway to Heaven
paragraphs: One... ten... a hundred—after nearly two hundred failed attempts and destroyed materials, Yuan finally began gaining a deeper understanding of his affinity.
However, even with his monstrous level of comprehension talent, he still could not grasp it quickly enough to finish before the banquet.
As a result, he ultimately decided to stop his experiments for the time being.
Afterward, Yuan stored the Void Fragment back into his spatial ring, along with the hammer, the anvil, and the golden wheel.
"Are you finished?" Zi Xuan asked him.

"For now, yes," Yuan replied. "If I continue working on it, I'll definitely gain enough understanding of my affinity to properly refine materials with it. However, at the current pace, it would take far too long."
He then continued in a defeated tone, "And even if I somehow managed to succeed, I still wouldn't dare use it on Number One Under Heaven until I'm completely confident in my ability to control it."
"Sorry, but your upgrade will have to wait a little longer."
Zi Xuan shook her head and responded, "It's fine. If I'm going to receive an upgrade, then I want it to be something truly worthwhile—not just some insignificant improvement."
"Who knows? You might find something even better to use on my upgrade than the Void Fragment by then."
Yuan nodded, "Not to mention, I am still lacking their crafting technique."
Zi Xuan returned to Number One Under Heaven shortly after.
"I am going to take a nap. Staying outside for so long is more tiring than I anticipated," she said.
"Let's go," Yuan said to Mu Xuelian a moment later.
"Where to now?"
"To partake in a banquet, but I have one more thing to do before then..."
A week before the Divine Paragon's banquet was scheduled to begin, something completely unexpected occurred within the Nine Heavens, causing widespread commotion.
The Stairway to Heaven, which had mysteriously vanished for many years, had returned just as suddenly.
"I heard the Stairway to Heaven has returned!
"No, it's not the original Stairway to Heaven, but something that merely resembles it!"
However, those who went to inspect the treasure immediately realized that something was different about this new Stairway to Heaven, as its appearance was entirely unlike the original.
"Huh? If it's not the original Stairway to Heaven, what is it? And who does it belong to?"
"Probably the Celestial Emperor. After all, His Majesty did mention that he was working on replacing the Stairway to Heaven."

"Believe it or not, it wasn't the Celestial Emperor's doing," said someone more knowledgeable on the subject. "According to those who went to examine the treasure, a certain name was engraved into it!"
"What name?"
"The Exalted Blacksmith!"

Most ordinary people were unfamiliar with the title Exalted Blacksmith, but when blacksmiths across the world heard that name, they were shaken to their very core and immediately rushed over to examine the treasure for themselves.

"You don't know who the Exalted Blacksmith is?!" A passing blacksmith who happened to overhear their conversation immediately interjected before proudly explaining, "He is none other than the most influential and experienced blacksmith in all of history!"

"Listen carefully! The Exalted Blacksmith crafted over thirty percent of all existing Celestial-grade treasures in existence—over seventy percent in his era! Not only that, but during his God of Creation Ceremony, he forged one hundred Celestial-grade treasures back-to-back without a single failure in less than a week!"
"In the world of blacksmithing, the Exalted Blacksmith is a true god! There isn't a single blacksmith alive who doesn't know his name!"
"If he's really that incredible, then how come I've never heard of him?"

The blacksmith released a deep sigh before responding, "Because the Exalted Blacksmith suddenly disappeared shortly after becoming the God of Creation, and nobody has heard a single thing about him ever since..."
His eyes then widened with excitement as he continued, "Until today!"
"How can you be so certain it's genuine and not some impostor? There have been plenty of people like that appearing lately."
"Well... we're currently trying to verify it ourselves," the blacksmith replied. "In fact, the current God of Creation has already announced that he'll personally examine the treasure later today.

"If the Exalted Blacksmith has truly returned... then I wonder what kind of masterpiece he will bestow upon this world next. His abilities were already far ahead of their time before he disappeared millions of years ago. I can't even begin to imagine how terrifying his craftsmanship must be now."
Sure enough, later that same day, the current God of Creation personally arrived at the newly appeared Stairway to Heaven in the Ninth Heaven to examine it.
By the time he arrived, the area surrounding the treasure was already packed with countless people, the majority of them being blacksmiths.
"Welcome, God of Creation!"
The crowd enthusiastically greeted the God of Creation the moment he arrived.
He quickly recognized many familiar faces among the gathering. In fact, every single Divine Blacksmith in the Ninth Heaven was present as well.
After speaking with some of the blacksmiths, the God of Creation got a rough idea about the situation.

Even before the God of Creation had arrived, several Divine Blacksmiths had already carefully examined the engravings on the treasure, comparing them to the works the Exalted Blacksmith had created in the distant past.
And every single one of them had reached the exact same conclusion... it was authentic.

However, despite being almost completely certain of its authenticity, they still had to wait for the current God of Creation to personally examine it before officially announcing the news to the public.
Some time later, the God of Creation retrieved several treasures from his spatial ring before approaching the stairway.
He then carefully compared the engravings on his already authenticated treasures crafted by the Exalted Blacksmith with the engravings carved onto the stairway itself.
Meanwhile, everyone else watched with nervous expressions, silently waiting for the God of Creation to announce his conclusion.
Several minutes later, the God of Creation took a deep breath and announced the results.
"It's real."

"For now, yes," Yuan replied.
"If I continue working on it, I'll definitely gain enough understanding of my affinity to properly refine materials with it.
However, at the current pace, it would take far too long."
He then continued in a defeated tone, "And even if I somehow managed to succeed, I still wouldn't dare use it on Number One Under Heaven until I'm completely confident in my ability to control it."
"Sorry, but your upgrade will have to wait a little longer."
Zi Xuan shook her head and responded, "It's fine.
If I'm going to receive an upgrade, then I want it to be something truly worthwhile—not just some insignificant improvement."
"Who knows?
You might find something even better to use on my upgrade than the Void Fragment by then."
Yuan nodded, "Not to mention, I am still lacking their crafting technique."
Zi Xuan returned to Number One Under Heaven shortly after.
"I am going to take a nap.
Staying outside for so long is more tiring than I anticipated," she said.
"Let's go," Yuan said to Mu Xuelian a moment later.
"Where to now?"
"To partake in a banquet, but I have one more thing to do before then..."
A week before the Divine Paragon's banquet was scheduled to begin, something completely unexpected occurred within the Nine Heavens, causing widespread commotion.
The Stairway to Heaven, which had mysteriously vanished for many years, had returned just as suddenly.
"I heard the Stairway to Heaven has returned!
"No, it's not the original Stairway to Heaven, but something that merely resembles it!"
However, those who went to inspect the treasure immediately realized that something was different about this new Stairway to Heaven, as its appearance was entirely unlike the original.
"Huh?
If it's not the original Stairway to Heaven, what is it?
And who does it belong to?"
"Probably the Celestial Emperor.
After all, His Majesty did mention that he was working on replacing the Stairway to Heaven."
"Believe it or not, it wasn't the Celestial Emperor's doing," said someone more knowledgeable on the subject.
"According to those who went to examine the treasure, a certain name was engraved into it!"
"What name?"
"The Exalted Blacksmith!"

Most ordinary people were unfamiliar with the title Exalted Blacksmith, but when blacksmiths across the world heard that name, they were shaken to their very core and immediately rushed over to examine the treasure for themselves.

"You don't know who the Exalted Blacksmith is?!" A passing blacksmith who happened to overhear their conversation immediately interjected before proudly explaining, "He is none other than the most influential and experienced blacksmith in all of history!"
"Listen carefully!
The Exalted Blacksmith crafted over thirty percent of all existing Celestial-grade treasures in existence—over seventy percent in his era!
Not only that, but during his God of Creation Ceremony, he forged one hundred Celestial-grade treasures back-to-back without a single failure in less than a week!"
"In the world of blacksmithing, the Exalted Blacksmith is a true god!
There isn't a single blacksmith alive who doesn't know his name!"
"If he's really that incredible, then how come I've never heard of him?"

The blacksmith released a deep sigh before responding, "Because the Exalted Blacksmith suddenly disappeared shortly after becoming the God of Creation, and nobody has heard a single thing about him ever since..."
His eyes then widened with excitement as he continued, "Until today!"
"How can you be so certain it's genuine and not some impostor?
There have been plenty of people like that appearing lately."
"Well... we're currently trying to verify it ourselves," the blacksmith replied.
"In fact, the current God of Creation has already announced that he'll personally examine the treasure later today.
"If the Exalted Blacksmith has truly returned... then I wonder what kind of masterpiece he will bestow upon this world next.
His abilities were already far ahead of their time before he disappeared millions of years ago.
I can't even begin to imagine how terrifying his craftsmanship must be now."
Sure enough, later that same day, the current God of Creation personally arrived at the newly appeared Stairway to Heaven in the Ninth Heaven to examine it.
By the time he arrived, the area surrounding the treasure was already packed with countless people, the majority of them being blacksmiths.
"Welcome, God of Creation!"
The crowd enthusiastically greeted the God of Creation the moment he arrived.
He quickly recognized many familiar faces among the gathering.
In fact, every single Divine Blacksmith in the Ninth Heaven was present as well.
After speaking with some of the blacksmiths, the God of Creation got a rough idea about the situation.

Even before the God of Creation had arrived, several Divine Blacksmiths had already carefully examined the engravings on the treasure, comparing them to the works the Exalted Blacksmith had created in the distant past.
And every single one of them had reached the exact same conclusion... it was authentic.

However, despite being almost completely certain of its authenticity, they still had to wait for the current God of Creation to personally examine it before officially announcing the news to the public.
Some time later, the God of Creation retrieved several treasures from his spatial ring before approaching the stairway.
He then carefully compared the engravings on his already authenticated treasures crafted by the Exalted Blacksmith with the engravings carved onto the stairway itself.
Meanwhile, everyone else watched with nervous expressions, silently waiting for the God of Creation to announce his conclusion.
Several minutes later, the God of Creation took a deep breath and announced the results.
"It's real."

chapters.title: Chapter 2518 Divine Paragon's Public Appearance
paragraphs: "I-It's real! The God of Creation has confirmed it!"
The entire crowd exploded with excitement.
"Does this mean the Exalted Blacksmith has returned?!"
"Heavens! Didn't another legendary figure just return recently after disappearing for millions of years?! What in heaven's name is happening?!"
However, the God of Creation suddenly spoke again, instantly halting the crowd's excitement.
"Although I can confirm that this treasure was indeed crafted by the Exalted Blacksmith, there is no evidence proving that he himself has returned."

He paused briefly before continuing, "Think about it logically. The Exalted Blacksmith disappeared without a trace shortly after becoming the God of Creation millions of years ago, and nobody has seen or heard from him ever since. Why would he suddenly reappear now just to replace the Stairway to Heaven?"
"If you ask me, I believe this treasure was most likely placed here by somebody else."

The God of Creation then narrowed his eyes at the stairway before adding, "Furthermore, the Exalted Blacksmith was famous for being far ahead of his era. Yet this treasure does not appear significantly superior to the treasures he crafted millions of years ago. How could so much time pass without his craftsmanship improving drastically?"
He concluded, "That leads me to believe this treasure was actually forged by him in the distant past and only revealed now."
After hearing the God of Creation's explanation, the crowd's excitement quickly diminished as they realized they had allowed themselves to get carried away too soon.
Someone in the crowd suddenly raised their hand and asked, "Even if we don't know who placed this treasure here, we can at least assume it's safe to use... right?"
The God of Creation responded, "I will personally examine this treasure and determine its functions."
"May I accompany you?" one of the Divine Blacksmiths immediately asked.
Even to this day, newly discovered treasures crafted by the Exalted Blacksmith continue to surface from time to time, and every single discovery would shake the world of blacksmithing.
Naturally, this treasure was no exception.
In the end, the God of Creation allowed the Divine Blacksmiths there to accompany him.
And since they were already there, they wasted no time and immediately started their investigation.
Meanwhile, news of the situation continued to spread.
With so many expert blacksmiths jointly inspecting the treasure, it took only two days for the investigation to conclude.
In the end, they determined that the treasure functioned similarly to the original Stairway to Heaven and was safe to use.

When the Celestial Emperor heard the news, he did not know whether to laugh or cry. After all, he had already spent many years and an enormous amount of resources creating a replacement for the Stairway to Heaven, even going as far as hiring the current God of Creation for the task. However, he still decided to continue with his original project.

Even if the Stairway to Heaven had already been replaced, its origins remained completely unknown. And for something that allowed people to freely traverse the Nine Heavens, the Celestial Emperor would much rather possess one that remained entirely under his own control.

On the fifth day following the discovery of the new Stairway to Heaven, the Celestial Emperor officially granted temporary permission for its usage, allowing people to traverse between realms once more.
However, because this was technically an entirely new treasure, all previous trial records tied to the original Stairway to Heaven were not present.
As a result, anyone wishing to ascend—even those originating from the Upper Heavens—would have to retake the trial from the beginning if they wanted to use it.

This situation immediately caused a massive uproar, especially among those who had descended to a lower heaven and ended up stranded there because of the Stairway to Heaven's sudden disappearance. Now, if they wished to return home, they would be forced to retake the trial all over again.

Unfortunately, there was little the Celestial Emperor could do about the situation besides reassure the public that he still intended to replace the Exalted Blacksmith's treasure once his own version was completed.
Until then, he warned everyone against traveling to a lower heaven unless absolutely necessary.
Even then, many from the Eighth Heaven and Ninth Heaven still decided to use the stairway to travel to the Seventh Heaven to participate in the Divine Paragon's banquet.
Several hours before the banquet was scheduled to begin, Yuan finally arrived at the venue.
To his utter shock, the place was already packed beyond capacity with people, far surpassing even his wildest expectations.
From afar, the countless figures gathered around the venue resembled a vast black sea that had suddenly appeared beside the Demonic Realm.
Shortly before showing up at the venue, Yuan sent Mu Xuelian to another place, as he did not want her present at the banquet for several reasons.
Some time later, Yuan used Void Manipulation, bypassing the massive crowd and teleporting directly into the courtyard.
"Divine Paragon!"
"The Divine Paragon has arrived!"
The Demon Sealers swiftly announced after noticing his sudden appearance.
"What? That's the Divine Paragon?"
Everyone stopped whatever they were doing to look at Yuan, their eyes wide with awe and admiration.
"...Yingzhe?" Xiang Biyu subconsciously muttered in a dazed voice after seeing the Divine Paragon's face, her eyes wide with disbelief and doubt.

Yuan had grown and matured significantly since she last saw him, so she didn't immediately think of him when she saw his face. Rather, he reminded her of Tian Yingzhe, the founder of the Celestial Overlords.
As for the Holy Maiden seated beside her, her expression remained hidden beneath her veil, but her hands had quietly tightened into fists for some reason.
The next moment, Yan Hara appeared before him and said, "Welcome back, Senior Tian. There are still a few hours before the banquet is scheduled to begin, but we can start at your discretion."
Yuan nodded and turned to face the crowd.
"Before we start the banquet to celebrate my return, I would like to say a few words first," he began.

chapters.title: Chapter 2519 Revealing the Truth to the Nine Heavens
paragraphs: "First and foremost, allow me to properly introduce myself," Yuan spoke calmly as he faced the hundreds of thousands of guests gathered before him.
"Most of you know me as the Divine Paragon, but my real name is Tian Chenyu, the first leader of the Demon Sealing Clan."
"As many of you already know, I mysteriously vanished near the end of the Demonic Era," Yuan continued.
"In truth, after sealing the Demonic Realm, I accidentally returned there through a second entrance and became trapped inside ever since..."

After a brief pause, he calmly added, "To be frank, I could have returned much sooner. However, I chose to use that opportunity to explore the Demonic Realm and better understand the existence of demons, something I didn't really get to do during my first visit."

"I spent an unimaginably long time exploring the Demonic Realm, learning about their history and their existence as a whole. And what I discovered there shocked me to my very core—so much so that it completely changed the way I view demons."
Yuan's gaze slowly swept across the countless guests before him before he continued,
"Today, I will reveal everything I learned to all of you."

The guests swallowed nervously as many thoughts raced through their minds. They could not help but wonder what kind of shocking truth could possibly cause someone also known as the Bane of Demons to change his perspective on their existence.
A few moments later, Yuan took a deep breath before revealing the same information he had shared with the Demon Sealing Clan not long ago.

"There are two kinds of demons. Ordinary demons, who behave no differently from us, and the Forsaken—the ones who have terrorized our world and slaughtered our people since their very first appearance."
"In the Demonic Realm, the Forsaken are originally ordinary demons who have been corrupted for reasons still unknown, transforming them into bloodthirsty fiends that even prey upon their own kind."

He then continued, "They are no different from the criminals in our own world who prey upon the innocent. Because of this, ordinary demons imprison the Forsaken in a place known as the Deprived Crimson Valley.

"Unfortunately, because the Forsaken are immortal and incredibly difficult to kill, the prison quickly became overcrowded. In the end, the demons chose to cast them into another location beyond their world, completely unaware that our world even existed and that they'd made us experience hell..."
"This is the truth behind the invasion during the Demonic Era. Are there any questions so far?" Yuan asked.
The moment those words left his mouth, thousands of hands shot into the air simultaneously, while many others began shouting questions out loud without even waiting to be called upon.
Yuan ignored those who lacked basic manners and pointed toward someone in the crowd who had patiently raised their hand.
"You there—the second-level God Ascension wearing red robes with a spear on your back."
The man subconsciously smiled before asking, "I thought the Demonic Realm was created by some demon called the Red Tyrant?"

"That was merely an unconfirmed rumor from back then," Yuan calmly replied. "The Demonic Realm existed long before the demons ever invaded our world. In fact, it even predates the existence of the Nine Heavens themselves."

Yuan then pointed toward another person in the crowd, who quickly asked, "Can you tell us more about these ordinary demons? What do you mean when you say they behave like us? Could you elaborate further?"
Yuan nodded calmly before replying, "Just like us, ordinary demons have families, occupations, and their own society where people simply strive to survive and live their lives to the fullest."
"Aren't all demons immortal? How different are their lives from ours?"
"While it's true that demons are essentially immortal even without cultivating, they are not truly immortal in the sense that they can survive forever without sustenance," Yuan explained calmly.
"Just like mortals, they still require nourishment to sustain themselves. If they go for too long without it, they risk becoming a Forsaken, which is essentially considered death among their kind.
"What is the purpose of revealing all of this to us?" someone in the crowd suddenly asked.

Yuan calmly replied, "I wanted to change your perspective on demons. As far as the world is concerned, all demons are viewed as bloodthirsty creatures that humanity can never coexist with. However, I believe coexistence is possible—just as humans eventually learned to coexist with beasts."

"Even if there truly are demons that are not violent, there is still the possibility that they could eventually become Forsaken, correct? Forgive me for being blunt, but I don't believe coexistence is possible unless that issue is resolved first."

Yuan calmly responded, "While it's true that this is indeed an issue, it's also something we already face in our daily lives. For example, cultivators who suffer from Qi Deviation can lose their rationality and become no different from the Forsaken. Then there are those who practice forbidden techniques and eventually lose their minds because of them."

"Even if that's true, there's not much we can realistically do about people like that. However, demons are different. We can simply keep them confined within the Demonic Realm. After all, why should we take such a risk?"
Yuan shook his head and replied, "Only time will tell whether coexistence between humans and demons is truly possible or not."

"As for permanently sealing the Demonic Realm... unfortunately, that was never a realistic solution to begin with. The seal I placed on the Demonic Realm was only a temporary solution, and the only reason they haven't destroyed it despite being fully capable is because I was in the Demonic Realm to stop them."

"There are many demons who are curious about our world, just as I'm certain there are many people here who are interested in the Demonic Realm, and demons visiting our world in the future is inevitable."

He then swept his gaze across the crowd before asking, "And when that day comes... will you attack them and force them back into the Demonic Realm simply because they are demons? How do you think that will turn out?"
Silence.
Yuan then spoke, "Nothing? In that case, I will tell you that it will only lead to another all-out war with the demons, and quite frankly, our world is not prepared to face them."

chapters.title: Chapter 2520 Revealing the Truth to the Nine Heavens(2)
paragraphs: After a long moment of silence, someone in the crowd nervously asked, "What do you mean when you say we are not prepared to face the demons? Are you saying that we would lose in an all-out war against the Demonic Realm?"
"That's correct," Yuan answered in a loud and clear voice, instantly dumbfounding countless people present.
He continued in a grave tone, "That is precisely what I am trying to say. If the Nine Heavens were to clash against the Demonic Realm in a full-scale war, we would be completely at their mercy."
"There's no way!"
"How is that possible?!"
Yuan then explained, "Time flows much faster in the Demonic Realm than it does in the Nine Heavens, and a single year there is equivalent to roughly a single day here."
"This means that, in terms of cultivation, they have already surpassed us by an unimaginable margin."

He paused briefly to let them digest this information before continuing in a solemn voice, "Not only are Cultivation Gods as common as weeds in the Demonic Realm, but they have already discovered the realm beyond the Cultivation God Realm."
"WHAT?!"
Countless shocked gasps and cries instantly erupted throughout the venue the moment they heard those words, many staring at Yuan with wide eyes filled with disbelief.
Cultivation Gods as common as weed? A realm beyond what they considered the peak of cultivation? This was hard to believe, even though it was coming from a legend like the Divine Paragon.
However, some people were shocked for entirely different reasons.

Suddenly, one of them raised their hand and nervously asked, "Senior... if time truly flows much faster in the Demonic Realm... then wouldn't cultivators who train there become far stronger in much less time than those who remain in the Nine Heavens?"

Yuan nodded before responding, "Yes, those who cultivate in the Demonic Realm would indeed progress much faster... provided they can actually survive the environment there. The very air within the Demonic Realm is vastly different from that of the Nine Heavens, and most people would struggle to remain there for extended periods of time."
"Then how come you seem fine? If you've been there for millions of years in our world... that means you've spent billions of years over there!"

"Don't compare me to ordinary people," Yuan sneered. "Not only do I possess a special constitution, but I have also consumed countless demon cores over the years, which greatly helped me adapt to the environment of the Demonic Realm."
The crowd once again fell into silence after hearing Yuan's arrogant yet undeniable words.
A moment later, Yuan continued speaking, "If any of you wish to visit the Demonic Realm, then by all means, go ahead."

He then narrowed his eyes at the crowd and added, "However, if you yourselves are unwilling to coexist with demons in our world, then what makes you think they would willingly allow you to cultivate in theirs?"
"Anyway, let's move on to the next topic and delve into the origin of demons. After learning about their origin, some of you might have an easier time accepting them."

"As all of you already know, demons closely resemble humans, whether it be their physique, limbs, or facial features. Sure, they may possess different skin tones or certain distinct traits, but overall, the similarities between us are undeniable."

"In fact, this resemblance becomes even more pronounced among higher-ranking demons. Hell, there are demons in the Demonic Realm that are indistinguishable from humans, and there is a reason for that."
Yuan took a deep breath before revealing what was perhaps the most shocking piece of information yet.
"That's because demons... used to be human at one point in time."
"...What?"

Everyone present, aside from the Demon Sealers, stared at Yuan with expressions filled with bewilderment and disbelief, many of them gawking openly as though they had just heard the most absurd statement in their entire lives.
"Demons were once humans," Yuan repeated, his voice clearly echoing throughout the stunned silence.
"However, a certain catastrophe eventually befell them, transforming them into what we now know as demons."
He then shook his head slightly before adding, "Unfortunately, I cannot reveal the details behind that catastrophe, so don't bother asking."
When Yuan immediately shut down the very question lingering in everyone's minds, the silence that followed became even heavier and longer than before.
"Well, that's pretty much all I have to say. If you have any questions, feel free to approach me and ask, as I will be available for questioning for as long as the banquet lasts—seven days."
Yuan then looked at the Demon Sealers and said, "Let the banquet officially begin!"
Immediately, the Demon Sealers started serving food and drinks, and some of them even started playing the instruments and dancing on a nearby platform.
Despite how sudden and weird it felt at first, people started approaching Yuan shortly after.
"Senior Divine Paragon—"
"You can just use my real name."
"Then, Senior Tian... Can you tell me more about what you saw in the Demonic Realm?"
"Of course. What do you want to know?"
Thus, the banquet officially began.
It didn't take long before a huge crowd gathered around Yuan, listening to his stories and adventures inside the Demonic Realm.
"Do you truly believe that we will be able to coexist with demons?" someone asked.
"I believe they deserve a chance, and I used to be the biggest demon hater," Yuan chuckled.
"I know I can't ask you about the catastrophe that turned them into demons, but what about your reason for not telling us? Wouldn't it be better to tell us so we can prepare for and prevent it?"
Yuan shook his head and said, "There's no need to prepare for it, as it's not an illness or disease, but that's all I will say."

"Then are demons contagious?" someone suddenly asked in a tense voice. "If we want to coexist, we first need to know whether there's any chance of humans turning into demons simply by being around them."

sentences.text: After a long moment of silence, someone in the crowd nervously asked, "What do you mean when you say we are not prepared to face the demons?
Are you saying that we would lose in an all-out war against the Demonic Realm?"
"That's correct," Yuan answered in a loud and clear voice, instantly dumbfounding countless people present.
He continued in a grave tone, "That is precisely what I am trying to say.
If the Nine Heavens were to clash against the Demonic Realm in a full-scale war, we would be completely at their mercy."
"There's no way!"
"How is that possible?!"
Yuan then explained, "Time flows much faster in the Demonic Realm than it does in the Nine Heavens, and a single year there is equivalent to roughly a single day here."
"This means that, in terms of cultivation, they have already surpassed us by an unimaginable margin."

He paused briefly to let them digest this information before continuing in a solemn voice, "Not only are Cultivation Gods as common as weeds in the Demonic Realm, but they have already discovered the realm beyond the Cultivation God Realm."
"WHAT?!"
Countless shocked gasps and cries instantly erupted throughout the venue the moment they heard those words, many staring at Yuan with wide eyes filled with disbelief.
Cultivation Gods as common as weed?
A realm beyond what they considered the peak of cultivation?
This was hard to believe, even though it was coming from a legend like the Divine Paragon.
However, some people were shocked for entirely different reasons.

Suddenly, one of them raised their hand and nervously asked, "Senior... if time truly flows much faster in the Demonic Realm... then wouldn't cultivators who train there become far stronger in much less time than those who remain in the Nine Heavens?"
Yuan nodded before responding, "Yes, those who cultivate in the Demonic Realm would indeed progress much faster... provided they can actually survive the environment there.
The very air within the Demonic Realm is vastly different from that of the Nine Heavens, and most people would struggle to remain there for extended periods of time."
"Then how come you seem fine?
If you've been there for millions of years in our world... that means you've spent billions of years over there!"
"Don't compare me to ordinary people," Yuan sneered.
"Not only do I possess a special constitution, but I have also consumed countless demon cores over the years, which greatly helped me adapt to the environment of the Demonic Realm."
The crowd once again fell into silence after hearing Yuan's arrogant yet undeniable words.
A moment later, Yuan continued speaking, "If any of you wish to visit the Demonic Realm, then by all means, go ahead."

He then narrowed his eyes at the crowd and added, "However, if you yourselves are unwilling to coexist with demons in our world, then what makes you think they would willingly allow you to cultivate in theirs?"
"Anyway, let's move on to the next topic and delve into the origin of demons.
After learning about their origin, some of you might have an easier time accepting them."
"As all of you already know, demons closely resemble humans, whether it be their physique, limbs, or facial features.
Sure, they may possess different skin tones or certain distinct traits, but overall, the similarities between us are undeniable."
"In fact, this resemblance becomes even more pronounced among higher-ranking demons.
Hell, there are demons in the Demonic Realm that are indistinguishable from humans, and there is a reason for that."
Yuan took a deep breath before revealing what was perhaps the most shocking piece of information yet.
"That's because demons... used to be human at one point in time."
"...What?"

"However, a certain catastrophe eventually befell them, transforming them into what we now know as demons."
He then shook his head slightly before adding, "Unfortunately, I cannot reveal the details behind that catastrophe, so don't bother asking."
When Yuan immediately shut down the very question lingering in everyone's minds, the silence that followed became even heavier and longer than before.

chapters.title: Chapter 2521 Final Day of the Banquet
paragraphs: "Contagious?" Yuan raised an eyebrow after hearing the question before quickly shaking his head.

"No, it is not possible for us to become demons simply by being near them. While it is true that demons were once human, they are not exactly the same as us. There are fundamental differences between our races, and the thing that turned them into demons could only affect them."

After a brief pause, he added, "Not only that, but I have consumed their blood directly, and it did not affect me. That being said, since I have a unique constitution, things might be different for others."
"Senior, you mentioned a realm above Cultivation God. Can you elaborate on that?! Have you seen their prowess? How much stronger are they?"

Yuan nodded and calmly replied, "Not only have I seen one, but I have even directly clashed against one. In the Demonic Realm, they have an entirely different cultivation system, and a Cultivation God is called a True God there. As for the realm above True God, that would be Absolute God."
"An Absolute God is incredibly powerful, so powerful that I wouldn't be surprised if even a single one of them could completely destroy the Nine Heavens."
"A single one could destroy the Nine Heavens?! They're that powerful?!"
The people gasped in shock after hearing this information, unsure how to feel about such a threat looming over their heads.
Many people turned to look at the entrance to the Demonic Realm that was not far away from the venue and swallowed nervously.
"How... how many of these Absolute Gods exist in the Demonic Realm?" someone suddenly asked in a nervous voice.
"Several," Yuan answered without hesitation.
The entire venue instantly fell silent.
The realization that multiple demons possessed strength capable of potentially ending their world left countless people speechless, their faces pale with shock.

"What's with the gloom and doom?" Yuan suddenly said, "I have spoken with some of the strongest demons in the Demonic Realm, and they promised not to attack the Nine Heavens. Moreover, they despise the Forsaken just as much as us."
Some time later, the guests continued asking Yuan questions.
"Senior! Are you married? If not, what about a partner? Are you looking for one?"
"I am not married, but I am already committed to someone."
"Who is this lucky woman?!"
Yuan shook his head with a calm smile, refusing to go into detail.
"Let's stay away from personal affairs."
Time passed, and after an entire day of answering questions from guests in the courtyard, Yuan went outside to speak with those who couldn't enter the venue due to overcrowding.
The guests outside the venue were overjoyed and even somewhat grateful that Yuan had not ignored them.
As a result, they enthusiastically greeted him and eagerly engaged in conversation whenever given the opportunity.
As the days passed, people would leave the banquet, but even more would show up to witness the legendary Divine Paragon with their own eyes.
On the final day of the banquet, a certain individual approached Yuan.
"Hello, Senior Tian. My name is Xiang Biyu."
"What would you like to ask me, Lady Xiang?" Yuan greeted her with a calm expression.
Xiang Biyu did not respond, merely staring at his face with a dazed expression.
"Lady Xiang?" Yuan called out to her a moment later when she remained silent.
Xiang Biyu finally blinked and spoke, "This is not a question, but rather a request."
"When you have the time, would you visit me at the Divine Essence Monastery? There is something important I need to tell you."
The guests who were familiar with Xiang Biyu were instantly stunned by her words.

After all, the Divine Essence Monastery had strictly forbidden the presence of men ever since its creation. Yet here she was, openly inviting a man to visit the monastery in front of hundreds of thousands of people.
To many of them, this was just as shocking as some of the revelations Yuan had shared today.
"I will visit when I have time," Yuan calmly nodded after a moment of silence.
"Thank you."
Without saying anything else, she turned around and walked away.
However, Xiang Biyu stopped a few steps later when she realized that a certain someone wasn't following behind her.
She turned around, and to her surprise, this individual was standing in front of the Divine Paragon, silently staring at him.
"Do you have a question for me?" Yuan asked the veiled figure standing before him.
Instead of answering, her hands slowly rose toward the veil covering her face, as though she intended to remove it and reveal her appearance to everyone present.
However, just as she began lifting the veil, Yuan suddenly looked away from her with a frown on his face, as did many people present.
"W-What is this presence?!"
Moments later, people began noticing countless silhouettes approaching from a distance.
Before long, tens of thousands of figures could be seen advancing from all directions, gradually surrounding the entire venue.
"D-Demons! Demons have appeared!"
The people exclaimed with shock and disbelief.
Yuan slowly ascended into the air, his expression calm as he faced the massive army of demons surrounding the venue.
"Quite bold of you to come here knowing that I am present," he said, his voice carrying clearly across the void.
The very next moment, a single figure emerged from the sea of demons and flew forward to confront him.
"Q-Qian Chu?!"
The Demon Sealers instantly recognized the individual and cried out in shock.
After all, the person leading this enormous force of demons was none other than Qian Chu—the former Clan Leader of the Demon Sealing Clan.
The sight of a man who had recently led the Demon Sealing Clan now appearing among the demons left them utterly stunned.
"Isn't that Qian Chu, the previous Clan Leader of the Demon Sealing Clan?"
"I heard rumors that he had been working with the demons, but I never truly believed them... until now, that is..."
The guests stared at the scene with widened eyes, silently wondering what was happening.
