chapters.title: Chapter 2522 The Appearance of an Ancient
paragraphs: "Aren't you the one I encountered during the Demon Slaying Parade and the previous leader of the Demon Sealing Clan? What are you doing here with an army of Forsaken?" Yuan calmly questioned Qian Chu, deliberately calling them Forsaken rather than demons.
He then swept his cold gaze across the vast army of demons before him, continuing with a mocking smile.
"Don't tell me you came here seeking revenge. Unfortunately for you, even if you brought every single Forsaken in existence with you today, it still wouldn't be enough to defeat me."
"We will see about that," Qian Chu responded in a cold voice.
He raised his arm and continued, "Today, I will make you pay for humiliating me, you fake Divine Paragon!"
He aggressively swung his arm in Yuan's direction and commanded, "Kill the fake Divine Paragon! Afterward, kill everybody present!"
In the next moment, the tens of thousands of demons rushed at Yuan.
"Assist the Divine Paragon and protect the guests!" Yan Hara shouted as she immediately flew toward Yuan, prompting the Demon Sealers to move as well.
However, before any of them could get close, Yuan's voice rang out across the battlefield.
"Do not interfere!"

Yan Hara and the Demon Sealers instantly halted their movements before staring at Yuan with puzzled expressions, unable to understand why he would stop them when an entire army of demons stood before them.
Yuan ignored their confusion and kept his gaze fixed on Qian Chu.
A moment later, he spoke in a calm yet imposing voice.
"Since you—and likely many others—believe that I am a fraud..."
A faint smile appeared on his face as a tremendous surge of Demon Sealing Aura erupted from his body like a volcanic explosion, bursting outward in every direction.
The overwhelming aura instantly engulfed the entire venue, washing over every guest, Demon Sealer, and demon present alike.
In the blink of an eye, the heavens and earth seemed to tremble beneath its might.
"Heavens!
The Demon Sealers exclaimed in unison, their faces filled with unmistakable awe and reverence.
Meanwhile, the demons that had been charging toward Yuan quickly slowed to a halt, with more than half of them being sealed by the aura alone.

The mere eruption of Yuan's Demon Sealing Aura was enough to suppress and seal tens of thousands of demons on the spot, and the battlefield, which had seemed on the verge of descending into chaos only moments ago, suddenly became deathly silent.
It wasn't just the demons who were affected by Yuan's Demon Sealing Aura, either, as even the guests present could feel their bodies becoming stiffer while being bathed in it.
However, Yuan was just getting started, and the Demon Sealing Aura coming from him continued to intensify.
"This is a little something I learned while I was in the Demonic Realm," Yuan remarked casually.
As soon as those words left his mouth, his Demon Sealing Aura began to change.
The once-overwhelming yet stable aura became violent and chaotic, surging like a raging storm that threatened to tear apart everything in its path.
The very next moment, anguished screams erupted from the demon army.
"Aargh!"
"W-What is happening?!"
The demons writhed in agony as the transformed aura washed over them.
Then, those who had already been sealed began to crack apart. Fine fractures rapidly spread across their petrified bodies before the cracks deepened and widened.
Moments later, they shattered into countless fragments before quickly crumbling into dust that vanished into the void.
As for those who were not sealed, their bodies began to break down directly, as if their existence were being erased.
In the span of a few breaths, over two hundred thousand demons had been reduced to nothingness, and Yuan had achieved it without so much as lifting a finger.
The entire battlefield fell into stunned silence as everyone stared at Yuan with expressions of horror and disbelief. Even many of the Demon Sealers felt chills run down their spines at the sight.
For the first time, they truly understood why the demons feared and avoided him like the plague.
"Now that all of the Forsaken are gone, what are you going to do next? Fight me yourself?" Yuan asked Qian Chu, who had a look of disgust, looking like he'd just swallowed a live fly.
Eventually, Qian Chu responded in a low, desperate voice, "This isn't over yet..."

He suddenly retrieved an object from his spatial ring and laughed madly, "Do you know what this is?! This is a treasure that will allow me to summon one of the strongest beings in the Demonic Realm—an Ancient!"
Without another word, Qian Chu activated the treasure.

The very next moment, the space before Qian Chu suddenly split apart vertically, as if cut by a sword, and a massive tear appeared in the fabric of the void itself, revealing a dark and seemingly endless abyss beyond.
An oppressive aura immediately poured from the rift, causing the hearts of everyone present to tremble.
Then, from within that abyss, a solitary figure slowly emerged.
With a single step, the mysterious individual walked out of the rift, as though the abyss itself had given birth to their existence.
The figure that emerged from the abyss was a beautiful woman with incredibly pale, flawless skin and pitch-black eyes that seemed capable of devouring all light.
An unfathomable aura surrounded her entire being, making it impossible for anyone to gauge the depths of her strength.

The moment she appeared, a suffocating pressure descended upon the world, and many of the weaker cultivators immediately collapsed unconscious, while others dropped to their knees on the spot, unable to withstand her mere presence.
Even the experts present felt their hearts tighten and their breathing grow heavy.
It was as though the woman standing there was not a living being, but a walking calamity sent to end their existence.
"What is this madness...?" Yan Hara muttered as she stared at the woman, barely able to keep herself from falling to her knees.
Yuan narrowed his eyes at this woman, trying to remain calm, but the nervousness in his gaze was noticed by many people.

chapters.title: Chapter 2523 The Appearance of an Ancient(2)
paragraphs: After the mysterious woman emerged from the rift, the entire venue fell into a deafening silence.

Nobody spoke or moved a muscle, and nearly everyone unconsciously held their breath, not even daring to breathe, as though they were prey instinctively trying to avoid attracting the attention of an apex predator.
The atmosphere was so oppressive that even the sound of a pin dropping would have seemed deafening.
However, it was not because the pale-skinned woman had threatened them, nor had she released any killing intent.
Her mere existence was enough.

Just by simply standing there, she exuded a presence so overwhelming that everyone instinctively understood one thing... that if such a being wished for their deaths, there was nothing they could do to resist.
And for many, including experts who have experienced countless life-or-death situations, it was the first time in their live they were experiencing this level of fear.
Eventually, the suffocating silence was broken, and it was the mysterious woman who broke it.
She slowly turned her pitch-black eyes toward Qian Chu and asked in a calm yet chilling voice, "Are you the one who summoned me?"
"Yes." Qian Chu acknowledged without hesitation before pointing directly at Yuan. "I want you to help me kill that bastard and destroy this world."
The woman slowly turned her gaze toward Yuan.
Then, without even looking back at Qian Chu, she casually swung her arm.
The movement was simple and unremarkable. Yet, what followed left everyone frozen in shock.
Her target was not Yuan but Qian Chu, and before he could react, his entire body was turned into a bloody mist before quickly vanishing into the void.
One moment he existed, and the next he was gone. Not only was his physical body erased, but even his soul was completely annihilated, leaving him zero chance of reincarnation.
The crowd stared at the empty space where Qian Chu had been hovering moments ago, their minds unable to process what they had just witnessed.
Meanwhile, the woman's expression remained completely indifferent, as though she had merely swatted away an insignificant insect.
"How dare an insignificant being command me?" she sneered in disdain, revealing her reason for killing Qian Chu.
She then looked around, seemingly examining her surroundings and situation.
"This is your world, correct?" the woman asked, focusing her gaze on Yuan.
"That's right. It's been a while, Annabella," Yuan responded with her name, revealing that he was familiar with her.

A cold smile appeared on Annabella's face before she laughed madly, "So this means I am no longer in the Demonic Realm? Hahaha! This is great! As this means you're no longer being protected by that woman, and that I can finally kill you!"
"You weren't able to kill me inside the Demonic Realm even when I was alone, so what makes you think you can kill me here?" Yuan coldly sneered.
"You will experience it for yourself soon," she said. "And after I kill you, I will enslave every single human being in this world just to spite you—even if you're already dead!"

Yuan narrowed his eyes and silently stared at her for a moment before declaring out loud, "Listen carefully, everyone! This is a Forsaken who has ascended beyond the realm of Cultivation God and entered the realm of Absolute God! Not only that, but she has always desired to conquer the Nine Heavens and make it her playground! If it weren't for the demons' assistance, I would've never been able to stop her from invading this world! Unfortunately, Qian Chu has brought her to our world!"
"Today, you will witness what an Absolute God is capable of and why we'll never survive an all-out war with the demons if we point our weapons at them!"
The next moment, Yuan retrieved the Demon Annihilation Sword and pointed it in Annabella's direction before asking in a cold voice, "Any last words before I kill you?"
"GO TO HELL!" Annabella roared as she unleashed her aura.
If her mere presence had been suffocating before, then what followed was akin to the descent of a natural disaster.
BOOM!
An overwhelming wave of pressure exploded from her body, sweeping across the Starry Sky, even reaching the Seventh Heaven and Eighth Heaven.
The very fabric of space itself seemed to collapse beneath its weight, and everyone in the area instantly fell to their knees, unable to withstand the crushing force.
"A-Activate the defensive formation!" Yan Hara commanded while blood dripped from the corner of her lips.

Seconds later, a massive defensive formation enveloped the whole venue and everyone there besides Yuan, protecting them from some of Annabella's unfathomable aura and allowing them to breath properly again.

Shortly after the defensive formation was put up, Zhou Yanfei approached Yan Hara with rushed movements and apologized with teary eyes and bloodied lips, "I-I sincerely apologize for doubting you, Leader Yan! You were right to be cautious and set up this defensive formation ahead of time! If it weren't for you, we would've all been crushed by that monster's pressure and died just now!"

It wasn't just Zhou Yanfei, as multiple Demon Sealers apologized to Yan Hara the following moment. After all, many of them had questioned her decision to prepare a defensive formation while they were building the venue.
In their eyes, the banquet would have top experts from around the world and even the Divine Paragon himself present, so such caution was needless worry.
However, Yan Hara was adamant about preparing the defensive formation, as if she had foreseen this situation.

Hearing their words and apologies, Yan Hara shook her head and replied, "I do not deserve your gratitude, nor can I take credit for preparing the defensive formation in advance, as I was simply following the Divine Paragon's instructions."
"T-The Divine Paragon...?" Zhou Yanfei mumbled with a dazed look on his face.
Yan Hara nodded and elaborated, "The Divine Paragon said he had a gut feeling that something might happen during the banquet, so he requested me to prepare accordingly."
"I-Is so that..."
After recovering from their shock, everyone shifted their focus to Yuan, who was surging with even more Demon Sealing Aura than previously as he clashed with Annabella.

chapters.title: Chapter 2524 Last Resort
paragraphs: Shortly after the defensive formation went up, Annabella's aura soared even higher. It was to the point where even the barrier blocked most of her aura; it was still strong enough to cause great discomfort to many of the guests present.
Not wanting to look weak, Yuan also unleashed as much Demon Sealing Aura as he could.
As both of their auras reached their peak, their figures abruptly vanished from sight.
For a brief split second, it was as though they had disappeared from existence entirely.
Then—
A violent ripple suddenly erupted across the Starry Sky, spreading outward like a colossal wave, and before anyone could even process what had happened, their figures reappeared, already clashing.
The collision of their powers detonated with a force that shook the surrounding space, warping and twisting it, almost as if whirlpools had appeared in the Starry Sky.
On their second exchange, cracks spread in the fabric of space around them, while torrents of chaotic energy erupted in every direction, strong enough to push the venue further into the distance.
"Heavens! Is that the prowess of an Absolute God?! That's several times stronger than a Cultivation God!"
The cultivators watched the battle with a mixture of horror and fascination etched across their faces.
On one hand, they were terrified of Annabella's unfathomable strength—a power so overwhelming that it could likely erase their entire existence with little effort.
On the other hand, they could not help but admire her profound cultivation.
After all, she had reached a realm that they had not even known existed until recently, and it was human nature to admire the strong.
To many of the experts present, it felt like they were witnessing the beginning of a new era.
Every movement she made seemed to contain profound truths beyond their comprehension, while every clash between her and Yuan revealed a glimpse of a world far above their own.
Of course, it was not just Annabella who earned the cultivators' admiration. If anything, their attention was drawn even more toward Yuan.
Despite facing a being whose mere presence could suffocate the Nine Heavens, he was not only holding his ground but actively contesting her.
To many of the spectators, that was even more incredible than Annabella's frightening strength, and every exchange between them only deepened the crowd's admiration for him.
As Yuan had mentioned earlier, many guests there doubted his identity as the Divine Paragon. However, upon witnessing his fight with Annabella, all of their doubt and suspicions vanished like smoke.

Meanwhile, as they clashed, Yuan communicated with Annabella through a unique method that could not be intercepted, "I know we're just pretending, but you should really fight with the intention of killing me to make it more believable, Angela."
Annabella was none other than Angela, who was pretending to be a Forsaken to scare the Nine Heavens.
"I am just getting warmed up!" she laughed as her aura suddenly increased again.
This entire time, Angela had been fighting without using her powers as an Absolute God, relying solely on ordinary Celestial Qi.
As for Yuan... he was also restricted to using only Demon Sealing Aura and had no intention of transforming or using Eternal Essence.
BOOM!

Once Angela began utilizing Refined Celestial Essence, her aura underwent a drastic transformation. The already overwhelming pressure surrounding her became even more domineering and suffocating, rising to an entirely different level.
"What is that energy?! Her aura is completely different now!"
Angela's presence was so powerful that the defensive formation was being damaged merely by the shockwaves generated from it.
At that moment, everyone present gained a deeper understanding of just how terrifying a being beyond the Cultivation God Realm truly was.
A genuine nervous smile tugged at Yuan's lips as he faced Angela's pressure.
'It's several times stronger than the Supreme Ancestor...' he thought inwardly.

Unlike the Supreme Ancestor, who could barely control his power, Angela's control over her Refined Celestial Essence reached near perfection, allowing her to wield it with precision and more efficiently.
Yet, even with near-perfect control, Yuan could tell that the Refined Celestial Essence was still damaging her.
'Truly a double-edged sword...' Yuan thought.
Shortly afterward, the two of them clashed once again.
This time, however, the outcome was noticeably different.
The moment they collided, a devastating shockwave erupted across the Starry Sky as Yuan's figure shot through space, leaving behind a trail of shattered void.
Although the spectators hoped Yuan could overcome it, none were really surprised that he could no longer keep pace with Angela after she began using Refined Celestial Essence.
However, Yuan refused to give up and continued fighting back with unwavering determination.
Unfortunately, each exchange only made the disparity between them more obvious.
Their clashes continued to shake the Starry Sky, but with every collision, Yuan was pushed farther and farther back.
<Demon Annihilation Array!>
With a mere breath from Angela, the array shattered into countless fragments.
<Demon Annihilation Legion!>
With a mere swing of her arm, the entire army was annihilated.
Yuan threw everything he had at Angela, but without the assistance of Eternal Essence, he was nowhere near her level.
'I guess it's about time, huh?' Yuan sighed inwardly.
After taking a deep breath, he loudly declared, "I will kill you today, even if it's the last thing I do in this life!"
"You're all talk, Tian Chenyu!" Angela laughed madly.
Yuan gritted his teeth and used Void Manipulation to get behind Angela before embracing her tightly from behind.
"What do you think you are doing?" Angela sneered with clear disdain.
"I will admit that I am not strong enough to defeat you normally," Yuan said.
"That's why I am going to take you down with me."
"What?" Angela frowned.
"This is my last resort."
Suddenly, Yuan's aura surged violently, the energy surrounding him rapidly condensing into a single point within him, gathering with such intensity that even the surrounding space began to distort.
When the spectators witnessed this scene, realization immediately dawned upon them, and their expressions twisted with shock and disbelief.
"He can't be..."
"Divine Paragon!"
Cries erupted throughout the venue as despair filled their hearts.
Some clenched their fists until blood dripped from their palms, while others lowered their heads, unable to continue watching.
"I'll leave the Demon Sealing Clan in your hands, Leader Yan!" Yuan shouted with a smile, his voice echoing across the Starry Sky.

The next moment, Yuan ignited the condensed energy. In an instant, it expanded from within him and erupted into a blinding light that illuminated the Starry Sky, resembling the birth of a radiant sun.
"Senior Tian!" Yan Hara cried out loud as the light consumed both Yuan and Angela's figures.

chapters.title: Chapter 2525 Divine Paragon's Sacrifice
paragraphs: The small sun in the void caused by Yuan's sacrifice did not fade until many moments later, and when it finally did, Yuan and Angela were nowhere to be seen, as if they'd been erased from existence.
Yet, nobody moved or spoke, merely staring at the empty void with blank expressions on their faces.
After a long moment of silence, someone finally broke the silence and muttered in a dazed voice, "S-Soul... Soul Rupture... the Divine Paragon detonated his soul just to defeat that monster..."

Soul Rupture functioned similarly to Dantian Destruction, a forbidden technique in which a cultivator destroyed their own Dantian—the very source of their cultivation—to unleash immense destructive power. Naturally, such a drastic measure was only taken in the most desperate life-or-death situations.
When a cultivator used Dantian Destruction, their cultivation would perish entirely. However, there remained a slim chance that they could survive and eventually rebuild their Dantian.

Soul Rupture, however, was different. Although it was several times more powerful than Dantian Destruction, there was no coming back from it. Using it meant certain death, and even the soul itself would perish afterward, leaving the individual without any chance of reincarnation.

Because of this, almost nobody would dare to use such a technique, even in the face of certain death. At the very least, death still offered the possibility of reincarnation, whereas Soul Rupture erased even that final hope.
Hell, even a madman would hesitate to resort to such a technique.
"Yuan... why...?" Yan Hara fell to her knees and muttered in a voice as faint as a mosquito's buzz from a mile away, tears streaming down both sides of her face.

When she had asked Yuan how he intended to live as both the Divine Paragon and Yuan, his answer had been to kill off the Divine Paragon. Because of that, she already knew that the Divine Paragon would eventually die.
However, she had never expected Yuan to use Soul Rupture—a technique that would kill both of them. This made her wonder if something had gone wrong.
"Why...?" Xiang Biyu mumbled, her face dazed and her eyes unfocused. "Why did this have to happen?"

The Holy Maiden standing beside her remained as still as a statue. Although her expression was hidden behind her veil, tears could be seen dripping from beneath it, staining her pure-white robes with dark spots.
Unfortunately for everyone present, the situation was far from over. Before anyone could truly mourn the Divine Paragon's death, a familiar presence suddenly enveloped the area.
"T-This pressure?! That monster didn't die?! How is that possible?!"
Panic erupted among the people when they realized that the Absolute God—the Forsaken that the Divine Paragon had sacrificed his life to kill—was still alive.
"I am getting out of here!"
It didn't take long for people to start fleeing from the venue.
However, before they could get far, a massive barrier rose around the area, completely trapping them inside.
"Who gave you insignificant insects permission to leave?"

An unfamiliar voice resounded through the area. Then, right before everyone's eyes, many of those who had tried to escape suddenly exploded into bloody mist, dying in the same gruesome manner as Qian Chu had earlier.
In the blink of an eye, thousands of people perished. Because there were so many of them, their blood did not immediately vanish; instead lingering in the void like raindrops.
A moment later, the people finally saw the one behind the voice and the slaughter—a beautiful woman with features strikingly similar to the Forsaken the Divine Paragon had killed.
"H-How...? Where did she come from?!"
Yan Hara suddenly realized something and turned to look in the direction of the Demonic Realm.
"The seal is gone!" she exclaimed.
"It must have disappeared with the Divine Paragon's death!" someone remarked.
"Silence!"
The woman roared as she slowly appeared before them, looking as though the Goddess of Death herself had descended upon the world.
"I'm impressed... shocked, even, that a mere ant managed to kill my sister," she said in a grim voice, her pressure gradually intensifying.
When she reached the defensive formation protecting them, she gently blew on it, instantly shattering it into countless pieces.

"Although her death was unexpected and saddening..." After a brief pause, she suddenly burst into maniacal laughter. "At least this means I won't have to share this world and its resources with her anymore!"
Her pitch-black eyes, brimming with bloodlust and malice, swept over the people before her.
Then, she continued in a voice trembling with delight, "With that annoying bug Tian Chenyu gone, I won't have to worry about his annoying buzzing while I feast upon his world!"
"You insignificant ants should be grateful for the honor of becoming my nourishment!"
She looked around before muttering, "But there are so many of you that I am having trouble picking my first meal..."
Suddenly, her eyes narrowed on a certain individual, and a sinister smile tugged at her lips as she pointed at them.
"I'll make you my first meal."
After saying that, she vanished like a ghost before reappearing directly in front of her target.
"Leader Yan!"
The Demon Sealers cried out loud when the demon appeared in front of Yan Hara.
"P-Protect the Clan Leader!" Zhou Yanfei shouted in a trembling voice before instinctively attacking the woman.
However, the others were so terrified of the woman that they couldn't even move, much less attack her.

"What the hell are you doing?!" Zhou Yanfei shouted angrily. "If we don't kill her, not only will we all die, but this entire world will be finished! We can no longer rely on the Divine Paragon to save us from these monsters!"
Almost immediately after Zhou Yanfei's words rang out, another individual sprang into action and attacked the woman.
However, she was not a Demon Sealer, but the Holy Empress—Xiang Biyu!
Still with tears flowing down her face, she loudly declared, "I'll kill you even if it costs me my life!"
After blocking their attack without any effort, the woman replied with a cold smile, "I don't mind getting a little exercise before my meal. It will only make it taste that much better, after all."

"I'll make you my first meal."
After saying that, she vanished like a ghost before reappearing directly in front of her target.
"Leader Yan!"
The Demon Sealers cried out loud when the demon appeared in front of Yan Hara.
"P-Protect the Clan Leader!" Zhou Yanfei shouted in a trembling voice before instinctively attacking the woman.
However, the others were so terrified of the woman that they couldn't even move, much less attack her.
"What the hell are you doing?!" Zhou Yanfei shouted angrily.
"If we don't kill her, not only will we all die, but this entire world will be finished!
We can no longer rely on the Divine Paragon to save us from these monsters!"
Almost immediately after Zhou Yanfei's words rang out, another individual sprang into action and attacked the woman.
However, she was not a Demon Sealer, but the Holy Empress—Xiang Biyu!
Still with tears flowing down her face, she loudly declared, "I'll kill you even if it costs me my life!"
After blocking their attack without any effort, the woman replied with a cold smile, "I don't mind getting a little exercise before my meal.
It will only make it taste that much better, after all."

chapters.title: Chapter 2526 An Undefeatable Monster
paragraphs: Shortly after the Holy Empress made her move, others began finding the courage to join the fight. However, what truly spurred them into action were Zhou Yanfei's words.
If they failed to bring down this monster, there would be no future for them—or the Nine Heavens. Even if every last one of them had to die there, they had no choice but to fight.
Fueled by this realization, the hundreds of thousands of people present launched their attacks at the woman, with more joining in every passing moment.
Unfortunately for them, their attacks had no effect on the woman. She was an Absolute God, while not a single Cultivation God was present among them.
"Hahaha! How hilarious! Your futile efforts, I mean!" the woman laughed madly as she calmly allowed their attacks to strike her body, only for her to emerge completely unscathed.
The entire banquet venue was quickly destroyed, reduced to countless tiny fragments that drifted deeper into the void.

At first, the woman did not seem interested in attacking and merely allowed their strikes to land on her. However, that did not last long. Before anyone could react, she began slaughtering them one after another, turning them into bloody mist.
"I don't want to kill too many of you since I prefer my meals fresh and alive," the woman remarked with a sinister grin on her face, sending chills down the spines of everyone who saw her expression.
"It's hopeless! Without the Divine Paragon, we have no chance of stopping this monster!"
After personally facing an Absolute God, they finally understood just how overwhelming—and utterly unbeatable—such an existence truly was.
"Is this all you've got?! Struggle a little harder! Entertain me more!" the woman laughed as her aura began surging with even greater intensity.
"She's still holding back?! Just how powerful is she?!"
"It's over... It's all over..."
One by one, the people began lowering their weapons.
The determination in their eyes faded, replaced by despair and helplessness. Many even lowered their heads, no longer able to muster the will to continue fighting.
After just a few short exchanges, they realized the truth—that the being standing before them was simply too powerful... too overwhelming... and too far beyond their understanding.
To them, she was an existence that could not be defeated or defied.
And so, one after another, they abandoned any thoughts of victory and resigned themselves to their fate.
"Do not give up!" Yan Hara shouted, blood staining her robes as she struggled to remain conscious.
"The Divine Paragon did not sacrifice himself so that we could surrender!"
Her voice rang across the battlefield, reigniting the fading spirits of many cultivators, especially the Demon Sealers.
"We will fight until our very last breath!" she declared.
The woman looked at her for a moment before slowly shaking her head.
"You still don't want to give up?"
A sigh escaped her lips, as though she were disappointed by their stubbornness.
"I suppose I should stop playing around and show you the reality of defying me."
The next moment, she brought her hands together in front of her chest. The movement was slow and almost graceful, yet it caused countless people to tense instinctively.
Then, she began pulling her hands apart.
As her palms separated, a tiny speck of black energy materialized between them.
At first, it was no larger than a grain of sand, but it rapidly grew larger as she continued spreading her arms.
The black energy seemed to devour everything around it, including the very void itself, as if it were a miniature black hole.
"Heavens..."
Yan Hara and many others muttered in a dazed voice as they stared at the woman, their pupils dilating.
Even though the woman was clearly not finished with the technique, they could tell that even in its unfinished state, it could easily wipe out everyone present in the blink of an eye.
"Is this truly the end for us all?" Yan Hara mumbled to herself.
Just as the black energy reached the size of a watermelon, the woman abruptly halted and frowned, quickly turning to look in the direction of the Demonic Realm.
Then, without warning, she tossed the black energy. However, to everyone's astonishment, she did not target them and instead threw it toward the Demonic Realm.
The black sphere shot through the Starry Sky, streaking across the void with unfathomable power and consuming everything in its path, drastically growing larger and larger in size as it traveled.
Everyone watched in stunned silence as the sphere rapidly approached the entrance to the Demonic Realm.

Just as the energy was about to consume the entrance to the Demonic Realm, a slender figure suddenly appeared before it like a ghost and calmly extended a hand toward the incoming sphere before making a simple grasping motion.
The massive sphere, capable of erasing everything in its path, instantly compressed, quickly shrinking in size until it became as small as a pebble.

At that moment, the mysterious figure reached out and seized the pebble-sized sphere in their hand. Although the sphere had shrunk, the energy and raw power contained within it remained unchanged. Yet the figure grasped it barehanded, treating it as though it were nothing.
"Selena!" the woman roared angrily, a hint of fear flashing in her eyes.
The mysterious figure, Selena, suddenly vanished from where she stood and appeared before the woman like a ghost, instantly seizing her by the neck.
Then, she spoke in a low yet enraged voice. "Tian Chenyu's life tablet shattered... Did you kill him, Hela?"
"N-No!" Hela immediately denied. "I didn't kill him! It was Annabella, and she's already perished!"
Selena did not respond.
Instead, she turned to look at Yan Hara and the others, seemingly trying to grasp the situation.
After a moment of silence, she spoke again. "We promised Tian Chenyu not to harm the humans of this world, yet here you are... doing exactly that."
"Bullshit! Annabella and I never agreed to such a thing! That was something you decided on your own!" Hela shouted.
"And as the Absolute Ruler of the Demonic Realm, my words are law. Since you defied them, I have no choice but to get rid of you."

chapters.title: Chapter 2527 Selena, Absolute Ruler of the Demonic Realm
paragraphs: "Get rid of me...?" Hela sneered in disdain before swinging her arm at her own neck.
In an instant, her head flew from her body, allowing her to escape Selena's grasp.
After retreating to a safe distance, Hela shouted angrily, "Why the hell do you still care about your promise with Tian Chenyu when that bastard is already dead?!"

"Are you saying we should forget our promises the moment the other party is gone? How tasteless." Selena narrowed her eyes and replied. "Besides, I am not doing this merely because of our promise. I also desire to coexist with the humans of this world."
"There's no way that will happen! They will never accept you!"
"Only time will tell..."
"If you are that adamant on siding with these pathetic and weak beings, then you can go ahead and do that! However, I want no part in your foolishness!"
After saying that, Hela attacked Selena, unleashing even more power than before.
Seeing this, Selena merely shook her head in silence.

The moment Selena and Hela clashed, the collision of their energy made it seem as though the entire universe was trembling. The ripples of their battle even reached the Ninth Heaven, alarming countless experts—including the Celestial Emperor himself.
"W-What is this crazy amount of energy?!"
"Not even a Cultivation God would be able to exude so much power!"
"Is it a treasure being born?!"

Upon sensing the energy unleashed by Selena and Hela's battle, many experts from the Ninth Heaven began making their way toward its source, completely disregarding the danger it might pose. Of course, this was simply the nature of cultivators—drawn to danger like moths to a flame.
Meanwhile, the Celestial Emperor commanded several squads of Heaven's Mandate to investigate the source of the energy.
Since Heaven's Mandate possessed teleportation treasures that allowed them to traverse the Nine Heavens with ease, they were naturally the first to arrive at the scene.
However, the moment they arrived, they were stunned speechless by what they witnessed, unable to comprehend it.
"W-Wat the hell is going on here?! Who are those two fighting?!" The soldiers quickly asked the others.
"D-Demons... from the Demonic Realm..." someone answered in a dazed voice.
"Huh? Demons? Both of them? Why are they fighting with each other?"
The answer only made them even more puzzled by the situation.
"General, what should we do? Should we stop them?" one of the soldiers suddenly asked.

"Stop them?" The General immediately frowned. "Are you fucking insane? Can't you sense their auras? The ridiculous energy being released from their clashes? Forget stopping them—we'd perish the moment we get too close! The only thing we can do here is wait until they are finished!"
After a brief pause, he added, "In the meantime, go gather information from everyone here!"
"Yes!"
The soldiers immediately began questioning those who had been present since the beginning, and as they gained a deeper understanding of the situation, their shock only continued to grow.
However, before the soldiers could report back to their leader, the fight between Selena and Hela reached its climax.
"Die."
Selena muttered in a low voice as she devoured Hela's entire being with a massive black hole, erasing her from existence.
After killing Hela, Selena turned her attention toward the people of the Nine Heavens and began approaching them.
"Do not come closer!" The General of Heaven's Mandate shouted with a fearful expression on his face, and his soldiers subconsciously raised their weapons, pointing them at her.
Seeing this, Yan Hara hastily shouted at him, "Immediately lower your weapons! She's not our enemy!"
Normally, nobody would dare to command Heaven's Mandate around, but in this situation, pretty much everyone there started yelling at them following Yan Hara's words.
"Lower your weapons, you idiots! Are you trying to get us all killed?!
Some of the people there even lunged at the soldiers to seize their weapons.
"What the hell do you think you're doing?! Unhand me!"
"You dare lay your hands on us?!"
"Shut the hell up!"
"Calm down, humans of the Nine Heavens," Selena suddenly spoke, her calm voice instantly bringing the commotion to a halt.
"I am Selena, the Absolute Ruler of the Demonic Realm, and a friend of Tian Chenyu. Rest assured, I have no intention of harming anyone."
Everyone present fell silent, giving Selena their full attention.

"First and foremost, allow me to apologize for what happened today. Had I dealt with the Forsaken 'Hela' and 'Annabella' sooner, none of this would have happened, and Tian Chenyu might still be alive..."

"I am aware that many of you fear demons because of what happened between you and the Forsaken in the past. However, as the ruler of the Demonic Realm, I promise you that such a tragedy will never happen again, and that we ordinary demons have no intention of fighting you. If anything, we wish for peace."

"I understand that asking for coexistence between our worlds right now is impossible. That is why I will remain in this world for the time being, to clear up any misunderstandings, answer any questions you may have, and hopefully start a peaceful relationship between our worlds. Not only that, but I will also clean up all of the Forsaken that linger in this world—or any that may trespass into this world in the future."
Yan Hara and everyone present swallowed nervously at Selena's words. Although they sounded too good to be true, it was also a fact that Selena protected them from Hela.
After a moment of silence, Selena spoke again, "Now then... Who here is the closest or the most familiar with Tian Chenyu? I'd prefer starting with someone that I can trust."
Hearing Selena's question, many people there turned to look at Yan Hara.
Seeing this, Yan Hara swallowed nervously before raising her hand and responding, "T-That would be me... I am the leader of the Demon Seal—"
She abruptly stopped mid-sentence and cleared her throat before continuing, "Ahem... I am Senior Tian's successor, Yan Hara."

chapters.title: Chapter 2528 He's Still Alive
paragraphs: After Yan Hara's introduction, Selena suddenly vanished into the void before reappearing in front of her with a calm smile on her face.
"You don't have to be wary or try to hide the Demon Sealing Clan from me since I've already heard about it from Tian Chenyu."
"Sorry, but I am a little overwhelmed right now, and I don't think I will be able to have a proper conversation with you..." Yan Hara responded after a moment of silence.
Selena nodded and said, "Understandable, especially since you've just lost someone close to you. Take all the time you need."
However, at the same time, Selena spoke to Yan Hara via voice transmission, "He's still alive."
"Huh?" Yan Hara's face immediately twisted in surprise, her eyes slowly widening with disbelief.
"I said that he's alive. Tian Chenyu, that is," Selena repeated, not worried that anyone there could intercept her voice transmission due to her vastly superior cultivation.
"Now, repeat after me..."
Yan Hara then spoke, following Selena's instructions, "I-If you don't mind, would you like to stay at our headquarters in the meantime?"
Selena quickly nodded.
"Of course."

"T-Then..." Yan Hara turned to look at the others and declared, "As much as I wish to say more, I am simply at a loss for words. Therefore, I ask everyone to return home and tend to your injuries. Once I have composed myself and spoken with Senior Selena, I will give a proper response regarding everything that happened today."
After saying that, Yan Hara turned around and began to leave, with the Demon Sealers quickly following behind her.
However, the General of Heaven's Mandate suddenly shouted, "Wait! You can't leave until we are finished here!"
Yan Hara halted at his words.

Without turning around, she responded, "If you—or the Celestial Emperor—have any questions regarding today's events, you may come to the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library at a later date. As I said earlier, I need some time."
Then, she continued on her way, quickly disappearing from their view.

The General trembled with anger after being ignored by Yan Hara—and in front of so many people, no less. However, there was nothing he could do. Just a single glance from Selena had shattered his courage, leaving him unable to utter another word.

Once Yan Hara—or more precisely, Selena's presence—could no longer be sensed, the General turned to face the others and roared, "Nobody else leaves until we finish our investigation! This is an order issued under my authority as the General of Heaven's Mandate's Third Squad! If anyone dares to disobey, I will have your head!"
Soon, Heaven's Mandate resumed questioning everyone present, refusing to let anyone leave until they had a clear understanding of the entire situation.
"What? The Divine Paragon is dead?" The General was shocked to learn this.
Once he had gathered enough information to understand the situation—or rather, its gravity—he immediately requested backup, as well as notifying the Celestial Emperor of everything.
"To think the Divine Paragon would perish so quickly after his return... It's almost comical." The Celestial Emperor shook his head after learning of Tian Chenyu's death.
"Absolute Ruler of the Demonic Realm, huh? If I had someone like that on my side, it would make getting rid of that bastard a lot easier..."
Some time later, the Celestial Emperor summoned Heaven's Mandate First Squad and commanded them to visit the Demon Sealing Clan and invite the Absolute Ruler for a conversation with him.

At the same time, news of the Divine Paragon's death, along with the information he had shared with everyone at the banquet, spread like wildfire, sending massive tremors throughout the Nine Heavens and shocking everyone to the core.
"Huh? The Divine Paragon is dead? There's no way!"
"It's real! I heard that he'd sacrificed his own life to kill a demon with a cultivation above Cultivation God!"
"Did you hear? The Divine Paragon used Soul Rupture, sacrificing his life and chance of reincarnation just to protect our world!"
"There are two kinds of demons, and they all used to be human? What the heck am I supposed to do with this information?!"

The Divine Paragon immediately became the hottest topic, mentioned in nearly every corner of the world. Because of his sacrifice, he became a hero again, becoming a legend whose fame somehow surpassed even his former glory as the savior of humanity.
Meanwhile, at the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library, a surprise awaited the Demon Sealers who had just arrived at the location.
"D-Divine Paragon?!
The Demon Sealers were shocked to their core when they saw the Divine Paragon standing before the closed entrance to the library, each of them looking as though they had just seen a ghost.
"How are you still alive after using Soul Rupture?!"
"Huh? What are you talking about? Soul Rupture? Why would I use such a dangerous technique?" Yuan remarked with a confused expression on his face.
"Yuan...?" Yan Hara mumbled in a dazed voice after seeing his handsome face.
"What? Yuan?"
The Demon Sealers stared at Yuan in shock and bewilderment.
"That's right. I'm Yuan. That Divine Paragon joke is getting old, you know?"
"By Yuan... do you mean the Little Founder?! Fuck! You nearly gave us a heart attack!"

"Little Founder? Who the heck is that? If he's not the Divine Paragon, then why does he look so similar? No, I'd even say he looks identical to the Divine Paragon!" someone who used to belong to the Demon Sealing Grotto exclaimed.

"He's a talented Demon Sealer who joined the Demon Sealing Clan not long ago. He became famous for his striking resemblance to the Divine Paragon, which earned him the nickname 'Little Founder'..." explained someone familiar with his story.
"That being said... he was much younger the last time I saw him. Now that he has grown up, I truly cannot discern any difference between him and the Divine Paragon!"
"You can't be serious... How can someone like that even exist? Are the Heavens mocking us...?"
"How can we be sure that he's not the Divine Paragon messing with us?"
"Didn't you all witness it yourself? The Divine Paragon used Soul Rupture... There's no way he could've survived that..."
Everyone fell silent shortly after, quietly staring at Yuan as though struggling to believe that he was not the Divine Paragon.

"T-Then..." Yan Hara turned to look at the others and declared, "As much as I wish to say more, I am simply at a loss for words.
Therefore, I ask everyone to return home and tend to your injuries.
Once I have composed myself and spoken with Senior Selena, I will give a proper response regarding everything that happened today."
After saying that, Yan Hara turned around and began to leave, with the Demon Sealers quickly following behind her.
However, the General of Heaven's Mandate suddenly shouted, "Wait!
You can't leave until we are finished here!"
Yan Hara halted at his words.
Without turning around, she responded, "If you—or the Celestial Emperor—have any questions regarding today's events, you may come to the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library at a later date.
As I said earlier, I need some time."
Then, she continued on her way, quickly disappearing from their view.
The General trembled with anger after being ignored by Yan Hara—and in front of so many people, no less.
However, there was nothing he could do.
Just a single glance from Selena had shattered his courage, leaving him unable to utter another word.
The General trembled with anger after being ignored by Yan Hara—and in front of so many people, no less.
However, there was nothing he could do.
Just a single glance from Selena had shattered his courage, leaving him unable to utter another word.
Once Yan Hara—or more precisely, Selena's presence—could no longer be sensed, the General turned to face the others and roared, "Nobody else leaves until we finish our investigation!
This is an order issued under my authority as the General of Heaven's Mandate's Third Squad!
If anyone dares to disobey, I will have your head!"
Soon, Heaven's Mandate resumed questioning everyone present, refusing to let anyone leave until they had a clear understanding of the entire situation.
"What?
The Divine Paragon is dead?" The General was shocked to learn this.
Once he had gathered enough information to understand the situation—or rather, its gravity—he immediately requested backup, as well as notifying the Celestial Emperor of everything.
"To think the Divine Paragon would perish so quickly after his return...
It's almost comical." The Celestial Emperor shook his head after learning of Tian Chenyu's death.
"Absolute Ruler of the Demonic Realm, huh?
If I had someone like that on my side, it would make getting rid of that bastard a lot easier..."
Some time later, the Celestial Emperor summoned Heaven's Mandate First Squad and commanded them to visit the Demon Sealing Clan and invite the Absolute Ruler for a conversation with him.

At the same time, news of the Divine Paragon's death, along with the information he had shared with everyone at the banquet, spread like wildfire, sending massive tremors throughout the Nine Heavens and shocking everyone to the core.
"Huh?
The Divine Paragon is dead?
There's no way!"
"It's real!
I heard that he'd sacrificed his own life to kill a demon with a cultivation above Cultivation God!"
"Did you hear?
The Divine Paragon used Soul Rupture, sacrificing his life and chance of reincarnation just to protect our world!"
"There are two kinds of demons, and they all used to be human?
What the heck am I supposed to do with this information?!"
The Divine Paragon immediately became the hottest topic, mentioned in nearly every corner of the world.
Because of his sacrifice, he became a hero again, becoming a legend whose fame somehow surpassed even his former glory as the savior of humanity.
Meanwhile, at the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library, a surprise awaited the Demon Sealers who had just arrived at the location.
"D-Divine Paragon?!
The Demon Sealers were shocked to their core when they saw the Divine Paragon standing before the closed entrance to the library, each of them looking as though they had just seen a ghost.
"How are you still alive after using Soul Rupture?!"
"Huh?
What are you talking about?
Soul Rupture?
Why would I use such a dangerous technique?" Yuan remarked with a confused expression on his face.
"Yuan...?" Yan Hara mumbled in a dazed voice after seeing his handsome face.
"What?
Yuan?"
The Demon Sealers stared at Yuan in shock and bewilderment.
"That's right.
I'm Yuan.
That Divine Paragon joke is getting old, you know?"
"By Yuan... do you mean the Little Founder?!
Fuck!
You nearly gave us a heart attack!"
"Little Founder?
Who the heck is that?
If he's not the Divine Paragon, then why does he look so similar?
No, I'd even say he looks identical to the Divine Paragon!" someone who used to belong to the Demon Sealing Grotto exclaimed.
"He's a talented Demon Sealer who joined the Demon Sealing Clan not long ago.
He became famous for his striking resemblance to the Divine Paragon, which earned him the nickname 'Little Founder'..." explained someone familiar with his story.
"That being said... he was much younger the last time I saw him.
Now that he has grown up, I truly cannot discern any difference between him and the Divine Paragon!"
"You can't be serious...
How can someone like that even exist?
Are the Heavens mocking us...?"
"How can we be sure that he's not the Divine Paragon messing with us?"
"Didn't you all witness it yourself?
The Divine Paragon used Soul Rupture...
There's no way he could've survived that..."
Everyone fell silent shortly after, quietly staring at Yuan as though struggling to believe that he was not the Divine Paragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 2529 Little Founder's Return
paragraphs: After a long moment of silence, Selena suddenly spoke in a calm voice. "Although he may look similar to Tian Chenyu, the resemblance is only on the surface. If you take a closer look, you can see clear differences."
"S-She's right! The Divine Paragon's nose is a bit shorter, and his jaws are not as defined!"
"Now that you mention it, the Divine Paragon's eyes are a bit rounder."

The Demon Sealers began to notice more and more differences between Yuan and the Divine Paragon after Selena's words. Eventually, it reached the point where they could no longer see the Divine Paragon in Yuan.

Unbeknownst to these Demon Sealers, Yuan had purposefully adjusted the Divine Paragon's facial features before returning to the Nine Heavens. After learning Bone Manipulation, he could adjust his appearance without any appearance-altering pills, something that would be easily detected by experts.
"It's unfortunate, but he's really not the Divine Paragon..."
Yuan frowned and said, "I've already said from the beginning that I am not the Divine Paragon. What's going on? And why do you all look like you'd been to hell and back?"
Yan Hara responded with a question, "Where have you been this entire time?"
"I was in seclusion," Yuan calmly answered. "After coming out, I decided to come here, but the doors were sealed."
Yan Hara sighed and said, "A lot has happened, but I'll go through them with you, so come with me."
However, Zhou Yanfei suddenly said, "Leader Yan, you can leave such mundane tasks to me or anyone else here. There's no need for you to—"
"It's fine. He's my disciple, after all," Yan Hara quickly interrupted. "I also happen to have some private business with him."
"If Leader Yan insists... We'll let you deal with him..." Zhou Yanfei said.

"I'm sure you're all exhausted, both mentally and physically, so take some time to recover. With Senior Selena here, we won't have to worry about demons—the Forsaken for now. However, we still have to deal with the Demon Worshippers later."
Some time later, Yan Hara brought Selena and Yuan into her private quarters.
The moment she closed the door and ensured the concealment formation inside was working properly, Yan Hara turned to face Yuan, took a deep breath, and shouted angrily, "ARE YOU INSANE?!"
Yuan subconsciously plugged his ears with his fingers and remarked, "Are you trying to blow out my eardrums? Relax a little."
"Relax?! Not only did you kill the Divine Paragon, but you also gave me a heart attack when you used Soul Rupture! How in heaven's name did you even survive that?! Or was that some sort of trick?!"
"Oh, that was no trick," Yuan reassured her. "I really did blow up my soul using Soul Rupture."
"Then how the hell are you still alive?! Not even a Cultivation God could survive their soul being blown to bits!"
Yuan chuckled, "I have my ways."
Yan Hara fell silent, but the frown on her face remained.
"Although you managed to fool everyone with the Divine Paragon's death... at what cost? You never told me there would be real sacrifices. If you had, I would never have agreed to it."
"Huh? What are you talking about?" Yuan asked with a genuine puzzled face.
"Are you really playing dumb with me right now? I am talking about all of the people who died! There were tens of thousands of deaths, you know!"
Despite hearing that so many people had died, Yuan somehow managed to smile.
"You—"
"Do you really think I'd go as far as killing random people just for the sake of my little show?" Yuan interrupted Yan Hara just as she opened her mouth.
"I thought you knew me better..." Yuan sighed, shaking his head in disappointment.
"B-But I saw it with my own eyes! Or are you trying to say that you'd somehow managed to fake that many deaths?" Yan Hara exclaimed, puzzled by the whole situation.
"No, those people really died," Yuan then said, bewildering her.
He quickly continued, "However, they were all demons disguised as humans that I planted within the crowd before the banquet even began."
"D-Demons...? Disguised as humans...?"
Yuan nodded and elaborated, "If nobody died during such a chaotic battle, it would have seemed suspicious and far less convincing."

He continued, "There were a few things I wanted to achieve with the play today. First, I wanted the humans of the Nine Heavens to experience the terror and power of the Forsaken firsthand, so they would think twice before acting aggressively toward the demons who may visit in the future."

"Second, I wanted to introduce Selena as their protector and as the ambassador of the Demonic Realm. That way, she could become the voice of both worlds—and hopefully, the bridge that connects the Nine Heavens and the Demonic Realm. She's also proof that coexisting with demons is possible."

"Third, I wanted the Divine Paragon to disappear for good. At the end of the day, the real Divine Paragon perished long ago and does not belong in this era. Moreover, while the Divine Paragon could try to convince the Nine Heavens to trust the demons, I have a feeling his existence would have the opposite effect and become a roadblock instead."
"Lastly... well, it isn't related to the Divine Paragon or the Demon Sealing Clan, so I'll just skip it."
Yan Hara fell backward, kissing the floor with her buttocks after hearing Yuan's explanation.
"I apologize for keeping many things from you, but I needed it to be as convincing as possible," Yuan apologized a moment later.
"What now...?" Yan Hara asked after a full minute of silence.

"I want you to work with Selena and create a future where both of our worlds can coexist. I know I am asking a lot from you, but you can do it as the Leader of the Demon Sealing Clan and successor of the Divine Paragon, right?"
Yan Hara released a deep sigh and nodded in a defeated manner before responding, "Even though I didn't sign up for this... I guess it's better than fighting demons for the rest of my life."

chapters.title: Chapter 2530 The Celestial Emperor's Invitation
paragraphs: "If you need any help, I will also be here," Yuan said with a smile.
"In that case, I will request your assistance immediately," Yan Hara said. "You want the Nine Heavens and the Demonic Realm to coexist, but that is easier said than done."
"There are two major roadblocks standing in the way of coexistence. Not only do the people of this world still fear demons, but we must also find a solution to demons turning into Forsaken."

Yuan quickly replied, "I am well aware that it will not be easy, and that it could take a very long time. Hell, whether coexistence is even possible remains questionable. However, now that both worlds are clearly aware of each other's existence, it is inevitable that they will interact more often in the future."

"Cultivators from the Nine Heavens will venture into the Demonic Realm to advance their cultivation, while those from the Demonic Realm will visit the Nine Heavens out of curiosity. And once they discover the abundance of resources in our world, they will definitely want to interact with us more."

"As for your main concerns... the people of the Nine Heavens' distrust toward demons can be resolved with time and Selena's presence. As for the Forsaken... I already have something in mind. However, since I am not certain it will work, I will not reveal it yet and raise your hopes unnecessarily."

Yan Hara then said, "I'm not so sure people will learn to trust demons with time. Do you remember when someone asked you during the banquet if demons were contagious? There will be many more people with the same concern. Unless we can prove with certainty that it is safe to be around demons, I doubt anything will change."
"What do you think?" Yuan turned to look at Selena. "You're more knowledgeable than me in this aspect."

Selena pondered for a moment before answering, "Since the mutation was created for the humans of my world, and the humans of this world are fundamentally different, it is highly unlikely that we would affect you simply by being nearby. However, if the humans of this world were to come into contact with our blood... or somehow merge with it... I cannot say what the results would be without experimenting."
Before Yuan could respond, Selena continued, "I know you probably don't want us to experiment on your people, so—"
"I have an idea," Yuan suddenly interrupted. "You need humans for your experiments, right?"
"Yes...?" Selena nodded, wondering where Yuan was going.
A smile tugged at Yuan's lips as he continued, "We happen to have humans who would be more than willing to participate in your experiments if we tell them there's a chance they could become demons."
"Y-You don't mean..." Yan Hara's eyes and mouth widened when she realized what Yuan was thinking.
"That's right. I mean the Demon Worshippers. This way, they will finally serve some purpose and contribute to our world for once in their lives.
"Of course, I am not saying we should force them to partake in these experiments. However, I have a feeling they wouldn't say no."
"I will keep this in mind when we capture them..." Yan Hara nodded in a dazed manner.
"Anyway, here are a few things to help you with your new responsibilities." Yuan retrieved a spatial ring and tossed it at Yan Hara.
After catching it, she immediately peeked inside.
"T-This is...!" Yan Hara's eyes widened with bewilderment after seeing what was inside.
"The rest of my techniques. Although it won't be as useful anymore, I figured that you should still have them, especially when you're my successor."
"Thank you! I will treasure them!"
Yan Hara and Yuan continued talking about the future of the Nine Heavens and the Demonic Realm until someone knocked on the door and announced they had guests.
"Leader Yan! Heaven's Mandate is here, and they wish to request an audience with Absolute Ruler Selena!"
"Heaven's Mandate? What's that?" Selena asked with a raised eyebrow.
"They're the servants of the Celestial Emperor, who is the ruler of the Nine Heavens. You met them before," Yan Hara explained.
"Ah, those foolish ones? What do they want from me?"
"Hard to say without meeting them..."
"They're probably here because the Celestial Emperor wants to speak with her," Yuan suddenly said.
"You sound confident. What makes you think so?" Yan Hara asked with a curious face.

"If you were a ruler of an entire world, what would you do if a ruler of another world suddenly visits yours?" Yuan responded with a question. "If it were me, I'd probably want to meet them and set some ground rules."

"Set ground rules...? That only applies if the two of them are on equal standing..." Yan Hara looked at Selena and recalled her terrifying prowess, thinking to herself that even the Celestial Emperor would not be able to make her bow.
However, if Selena offended the Celestial Emperor, it would definitely make coexisting with the Nine Heavens much more difficult.
"Let's see what they have to say," Selena said.
Yan Hara nodded before leaving to welcome Heaven's Mandate.
Some time later, Yan Hara returned to the room with a small group.
"We greet the Absolute Ruler of the Demonic Realm. We are Heaven's Mandate, servants of the Celestial Emperor, ruler of the Nine Heavens."
The group hastily knelt on the ground and greeted Selena with lowered heads.

Under normal circumstances, Heaven's Mandate would never bow to anyone but the Celestial Emperor, even under threat. However, this was a special situation, and the Celestial Emperor himself had ordered them to treat her as they would him.
"What is your purpose for seeking an audience with me?" Selena responded.
"Our Master, the Celestial Emperor, has invited you to the Celestial Palace for a private conversation."

Selena smiled slightly and said, "Normally, I wouldn't accept such a half-assed invitation, but since I am a guest here, I'll tolerate it once. As for my response to the Celestial Emperor's invitation..."
Selena's eyes glanced at Yuan.
"Go ahead," he said to her via voice transmission. "You'll have to meet with him sooner or later, anyway."

chapters.title: Chapter 2531 Two Reasons
paragraphs: After hearing Yuan's words, Selena responded to Heaven's Mandate, "Very well. I'll meet your emperor."
They smiled inwardly after hearing this, and the General of the squad said, "In that case, let's leave immediately!"
However, Selena narrowed her eyes and said, "I will go when I am ready."
"B-But His Majesty is waiting—"

"So what?" Selena interrupted in a cold voice, her eyes narrowing slightly. "Let us make something clear right now. Although I may be a guest here, do not order me around. I will tolerate your insolence this once, but if you treat me as though I am beneath your emperor and disrespect me again, I will punish you accordingly, regardless of your identity."
"M-My apologies! I will watch my mouth from this moment forth!"
The General trembled at Selena's invisible pressure, his back soaked in cold sweat.
"Then we will wait outside until you are ready to leave. Once you are ready, please let us know."
After saying that, Heaven's Mandate swiftly retreated outside.

"Are you sure you should be acting so arrogantly?" Yan Hara asked in a concerned tone once they were alone again. "The Celestial Emperor plays a crucial role in uniting our worlds. If you offend him... things will only become more difficult."

"I have no intention of lowering my head to the emperor of this world," Selena calmly replied. "If anything, he should be the one lowering his head to me, as the fate of this world currently rests in my hands."
"Although I do not want the humans of this world to fear me, I also do not want them to look down on me. There must be a balance, or coexistence will be impossible."
Yuan suddenly said, "As crazy as it sounds, the Immortal Monarch once united humans and beasts through fear and violence. That being said, I don't think it would work as well in this situation."
Selena looked at him and asked, "So, when do you want me to meet with this Celestial Emperor? And what do you want me to say to him? How should I act?"
"You can meet him as soon as I leave this place. As for what to say..." Yuan paused for a moment before shrugging his shoulders. "I couldn't care less what you do as long as you don't kill him."
Yan Hara's jaw dropped at his words, and she quickly spoke, "You don't intend on going with her?"
"No, I have other things to do. Also, I don't intend on meeting the Celestial Emperor unless I need to kill him.
"What did you just say?" Yan Hara's eyes widened at his outrageous words, even doubting her own ears for a moment. "You want to kill the Celestial Emperor? Why would you want to do that?"
"It's not like I want to kill him, but if he continues to stand in my way, I will have no choice but to get rid of him."
"...Just what is happening between you and the Celestial Emperor?"
Yuan merely shook his head at her question.
"Then when are you going to leave?" Yan Hara changed her questions after realizing that Yuan didn't want to continue talking about the Celestial Emperor.
"Very soon."
"In that case, before you leave, I want to let you know that I plan on hosting a proper funeral for the Divine Paragon. After all, it'd be weird if we don't do one."
Yuan nodded, "Do as you please."
After chatting for several more hours, Yuan left the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library alone.

Meanwhile, Yan Hara returned to her duties as the Demon Sealing Clan's leader and began preparing for the Divine Paragon's funeral. As for Selena, she went with Heaven's Mandate to the Ninth Heaven to meet with the Celestial Emperor.

"So, how did it go? Was it convincing enough?" Angela asked him.
He nodded with a smile, "More than enough."

Angela sighed before admitting, "Even though it was an act, when you ruptured your soul, it really startled me for a second. Your Soul Strength is too strong for a mere mortal. If I wasn't prepared for it, I would've probably died to it."
"At least you weren't forced to fight Selena. It's been a while since I had such a fierce exchange with her," Helena shook her head.
"So, where's Selena right now?" Angela then asked.
Yuan explained the situation and Selena's whereabouts to them.
"The Celestial Emperor, huh? I wonder what she's going to do," Helena muttered.
"As long as he doesn't piss her off, it should be fine," said Angela.

Then, she turned to Yuan and continued, "I know you picked Selena to become the representative because you think she's more reasonable and less aggressive than Helena and me, but you haven't seen what she's capable of when she's angry."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at such words and inquired, "What's she like when she's angry?"
"You don't want to find out."
Yuan became speechless for a moment before clearing his throat and speaking, "I... trust her."
A moment later, Yuan turned to look at a nearby individual and said, "Anyways, let's go speak with our new friend."
He walked several meters before standing before a man who was currently restrained.
"How are you feeling, Qian Chu?" Yuan asked him with a smile.

Everyone at the banquet had witnessed Qian Chu being annihilated by Angela, but unbeknownst to them, the Qian Chu that had been killed was just an avatar created by Angela, much like Supreme Ruler Umbra, and the real one was very much still alive.
"Are you finally going to tell me why you kidnapped me instead of killing me?" Qian Chu asked calmly despite his situation.
"I have two reasons for sparing you... for now. Firstly, I'm interested in your goals. The other reason is that I want you to finish what you started and summon an 'Ancient' for me."
"You can't be serious..." Qian Chu stared at Yuan with widened eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 2532 Removing Qian Chu's Restraints
paragraphs: "Why the hell do you care about my goals? Moreover, why do you want me to summon an Ancient when you already have two of them standing right beside you?" Qian Chu responded with a deep frown on his face.
"Oh? You knew they were Ancients?" Yuan muttered.

"I am not stupid," he coldly sneered. "Only an Ancient could possibly exude such a ridiculous presence, not to mention their ability to command the demons like slaves. I may have never seen an Ancient before, but I am aware of their capabilities."

"Is that so? Well, is it really so strange that I want to know your goals? I don't know how you escaped the purge and arrived in the Nine Heavens, but you could have lived a peaceful life. Yet instead, you chose to become the leader of the Demon Sealing Clan and scheme behind the scenes with the Forsaken. Since you're already captured and have no way out, you might as well tell me everything and relieve yourself of some of that burden."
Qian Chu fell silent for a moment before responding in a low voice, "My goal is simple. I want revenge against the demons for purging my kind, and the humans for assisting them."
Yuan raised an eyebrow and said, "I understand your hatred for the demons, but I was the only human who helped them. Why bring the entire Nine Heavens into your mess?"
A cold smile tugged at Qian Chu's lips as he answered, "Because human sacrifices are necessary to complete my second goal."
"To summon an Ancient, correct? How does that work? These two are pretty certain that there's no method to summon them."
"If you remove the restrictions on me, I can demonstrate to you how it's done," said Qian Chu with a mysterious smile. "And you don't need to worry about me running away."
"Run away? That concern never even crossed my mind, as there's no way for you to escape," Yuan said with full confidence.
Not only were there two Transcendents beside him, but he himself could easily catch Qian Chu if he attempted to escape.
"Then why are you hesitating? Free me, and I'll give you exactly what you want. Or, you can just kill me right now."
"Free him," Angela suddenly said to Yuan. "I want to see what kind of nonsense he has up his sleeves."
"I am also curious," said Helena.
"I was going to do that even if he didn't say anything, but he clearly has an ulterior motive.
"So what? No matter what happens, there's nothing he can realistically do to us," Angela spoke with a calm smile.
Yuan pondered for a moment before saying, "Let's bring him outside before I remove his restraints."
Some time later, they left Tian Qiyuan's world and brought Qian Chu somewhere in the Primordial Realm.
"Don't disappoint me now, Qian Chu," Yuan said to him before removing his restraints, allowing him to move and use his cultivation again.
After being released, instead of acting immediately, Qian Chu took his sweet time cracking his neck and stretching his limbs, acting like a prisoner who'd just regained their freedom.
Rather than being annoyed, Yuan was intrigued by Qian Chu's behavior, as he was acting like someone who no longer cared about anything.
Qian Chu then lifted his head and gazed in a certain direction in the void, as though staring at something invisible to the naked eye.
"Soon... I will avenge all of you..." He muttered.
After saying those words, Qian Chu suddenly plunged his hand into his own chest and pulled out his heart.
Yuan raised an eyebrow at his puzzling actions but didn't interrupt him.
Moments later, Qian Chu began mumbling in a language that Yuan could not understand, and in response, the heart in his grasp started to shrink, condensing into a perfectly round crimson bead.
Despite having a gaping hole in his chest and his heart ripped out, Qian Chu's expression remained calm, almost tranquil, as if he were in a trance.
Then, without warning, he put the crimson bead into his mouth and swallowed it.
"What the hell is he doing?" Angela could no longer remain silent and questioned aloud.
"He must have gone crazy," Helena remarked.

Shortly after Qian Chu swallowed his own heart, a small black sphere suddenly appeared at the center of his abdomen, and his body began to twist and contort in a surreal fashion, slowly consumed by it.
Once Qian Chu's entire being disappeared, the black sphere began to expand until it became a portal that was large enough for a person to fit.
"What in the...?"
Not just Yuan, but the other two were dumbfounded by the turn of events.
However, before they could even figure out what Qian Chu had just done, a pale leg suddenly stepped out of the portal.
"T-That's—!" Angela and Helena's eyes widened with shock and disbelief when they saw the face of the individual who had just emerged from the portal.
"L-Lucian!" Helena shouted.
"Lucian?" Yuan stared at the individual before him, who had a similar appearance to that of all Transcendents, except that, instead of being a woman, he was a man.
"You two..."
The individual named Lucian narrowed his eyes at Angela and Helena for a brief moment before widening them in surprise.
"Helena?! Angela?! What the hell are you doing here?!" he exclaimed in shock.
"We should be asking you that! How are you alive?! We witnessed the Demon God kill you back then with our own eyes!" Anegla shouted back.
However, Lucian did not answer her question. Instead, his surprised expression quickly faded, and his gaze became eerily tranquil.
"Lucian?" Helena called out to him, but he remained unresponsive.
Suddenly, Yuan shouted at them, "Get back!"
In the next instant, immense killing intent surged from Lucian's body, and he lunged at Angela and Helena, enveloped in a profound aura that felt disturbingly similar to Eternal Essence.
Although his sudden attack had taken them by surprise, Angela and Helena reacted quickly enough to avoid it.
"What the fuck are you doing, you bastard!" Angela roared angrily.
