chapters.title: Chapter 2533 Lucian
paragraphs: After barely avoiding his sneak attack, Angela and Helena stared at Lucian with wide eyes.
"What the fuck are you doing, you bastard!" Angela immediately shouted at him.
However, Lucian didn't show even the slightest reaction on his face and lunged at them again for a second time.
"Snap out of it, Lucian!" Helena shouted at him.
"Stop wasting your breath. He obviously can't hear you," Yuan remarked as he calmly stood there.
Even though Yuan had blocked Lucian's first attack, Lucian completely ignored him and went straight for the other two.
"Why is he only attacking us?!" Angela exclaimed with a puzzled face as she continued dodging Lucian's attacks.
Yuan shrugged, "Beats me."
"Hey! Why are you just standing there and watching him attack us?! Come help us! He is using a weird energy that is similar to yours, and we cannot handle it alone!" Helena shouted at Yuan.
Yuan sighed before confronting Lucian again. However, just like before, Lucian would completely ignore him, only going after Angela and Helena.
Seeing this, Yuan said to them, "Since he is clearly targeting you two, get out of here. I will hold him back."
"You want us to run away? No way!" Angela immediately refused.
Helena then said, "He is clearly suffering from some kind of affliction. We cannot abandon him! He's our friend!"
"Then you can continue fighting him by yourselves," Yuan shook his head as he stopped trying to block Lucian.
"If he's acting like this because of your presence, then he might return to normal once you leave," he added a moment later.
"That's..."
Angela and Helena exchanged glances with each other before finally agreeing to leave.
"If nothing changes, call us back!" Angela said as she used Void Manipulation to teleport away.
"If he does return to normal, make sure you ask him about it!" Helena said before teleporting away as well.
However, Lucian had no intention of letting them escape so easily and immediately attempted to use Void Manipulation.
"No, you don't!" Yuan shouted, barely managing to intercept him before he could chase after them.
With Angela and Helena gone, Lucian finally turned his attention to Yuan.
"So you can actually see me, huh? I was starting to think I was invisible to you or something," Yuan muttered with a calm smile.
Unsurprisingly, Lucian remained silent.
Then, without warning, he attacked.
"I won't kill you since you're their friend, but I will have to defend myself and wake you up somehow."
Yuan's body immediately surged with Eternal Essence.
The moment Lucian sensed it, his body briefly froze, as though reacting to its power.
However, Yuan paid it no mind and struck without hesitation, driving a straight punch into his gut.
"Argh!" Lucian coughed up a mouthful of blood as the impact rippled through his body, shattering his bones and tearing apart his muscles from within.
Knowing that Lucian was a Transcendent, Yuan didn't hold back because he wasn't afraid of killing him by accident.
Of course, Yuan limited himself to using only ordinary Eternal Essence.
"Aaaah!"
Lucian roared as he unleashed even more of his fake Eternal Essence.
Unfortunately for him, no amount of fake Eternal Essence would allow him to defeat Yuan.
For the next several hours, Lucian endured a completely one-sided beating.
"When are you going to wake up? Do you really want to die like this?" Yuan questioned, his hand wrapped tightly around Lucian's neck.
After a moment of silence and complete stillness, Lucian's body suddenly began to relax, and light slowly returned to his eyes.
"Oh?"
Upon seeing the change, Yuan released his grasp on Lucian.
"Cough!"
Lucian spat out another mouthful of blood before looking at Yuan with a dazed expression.
"W-Who are you...?" Lucian asked.
"Yuan."
"Yuan? I have never heard of you. Are you an Eternal? You don't look like one, though..." Lucian questioned with a puzzled expression.
Yuan shook his head and calmly replied, "I'm human."
"What?" Lucian's eyes widened with shock. "B-But you can wield Eternal Essence!"
"Don't worry about it. Right now, I have some questions for you," Yuan then said.
"Angela and Helena, you know them, right?"
Lucian raised an eyebrow and responded with a surprised face, "Huh? How do you know those names? Did you meet them?"
It was Yuan's turn to raise his eyebrows.
"You don't remember?" he asked.
"Remember what?"
"That you met and attacked them. We were fighting for a reason, you know?"
A look of realization flashed across Lucian's face, and he fell silent for a moment before asking in a concerned tone, "I... I didn't hurt them, did I?"
"Physically? No."
Lucian released a sigh of relief after hearing this.
"Care to elaborate on why you attacked them out of nowhere? You were also moving around like a lifeless puppet when we fought."
"Sorry, but I cannot disclose anything to you." Lucian shook his head.
"Are you sure? I know Deemo very well, you know?" Yuan said, mentioning the Demon God.
"Y-You know my Master?!" Lucian exclaimed in disbelief.
"Not only that, but I even plan on fighting for him during the next 'event', if you know what I am talking about."
Lucian's expression changed once again when Yuan mentioned the event.
"You are going to participate in the Eternals' Reckoning, too? And under Master Deemo?" Lucian asked in a somewhat doubtful voice. "But you're a human from the Nine Heavens."
Without saying a word, Yuan activated his Transcended Demonic Awakening, taking on his demon form.
Lucian subconsciously backed away from Yuan after sensing his ridiculous presence.
"What about now?" Yuan asked with a smile on his face.
"How in..." Lucian rubbed his eyes and looked again, as if trying to make sure he was not seeing things.

"To be honest with you, I have not decided whether I will participate in the event yet, and Deemo really wants me to fight for him. I think you know why. However, if you refuse to tell me about your situation, I'll tell Deemo that I won't participate—and then I'll blame it all on you," Yuan said, pointing at him.
"What?! That's ridiculous! And unreasonable!"
Yuan shrugged and said, "If you don't want that to happen, then tell me everything. I won't tell Deemo. I promise."
After a moment of silence, Lucian released a defeated sigh and said, "I cannot go into the details, because doing so would cost me my life—literally."
"Then tell me what you can."
Lucian nodded.
"Before that, I have a question for you. How much do you know about my origin, if anything at all?"
"I know about the Great Cataclysm, as well as the Transcedents' clash with Deemo. I was also told that some of you were killed during that clash."
Lucian then spoke, "No, we weren't killed. Master Deemo saw potential in us and had us participate in the Eternals' Reckoning, and we've been training and fighting for him ever since then."
"As for why I attacked those two... It's due to a curse, and I have no control over it."
"Did Deemo cast this curse on you?" Yuan then asked.
Lucian nodded.
"We are forbidden from coming into contact with anyone from our world. If we do... we are forced to eliminate them, regardless of who they are."
"What purpose could such a curse possibly serve?" Yuan raised his eyebrows, puzzled by the restriction.
However, Lucian merely shook his head in silence, either because he did not know the answer himself or because he was unable to reveal it.
"So, are the rest of the Transcendents still alive right now?" Yuan then asked.
A grim expression appeared on Lucian's face as he responded in a dejected voice, "There were six of us in the beginning, but only two of us remain now."
"How did they die?"
"How else? They all died during the Eternals' Reckoning."
"Huh? I'm surprised that Deemo allowed you guys to die. I thought he valued the Transcendents."
"Are you kidding me?" Lucian sneered. "We're nothing but tools in his eyes."
"Even so, there are so few of you. What will he do if you all perish?"
"He'll just find others to replace us."
After a moment of silence, Yuan spoke, "Alright. I get the gist of your situation. Now I need to know your connection to Qian Chu—the one who summoned you here."
"He's just another expendable pawn for my Master."
"What?" Yuan tilted his head, looking utterly confused.
"Sorry, but I cannot tell you the details."
"Then what is your role in all this?"
Lucian silently shook his head.
"Looks like I will have to ask Deemo myself..." Yuan sighed aloud.
Lucian proceeded to stare at Yuan intently, looking as though he wanted to say something.
"What is it?"

"I don't know what kind of relationship you have with my Master, but if you are not close to him, you should stay away. Otherwise, you will inevitably become entangled in his schemes and cruelty," Lucian warned.
"Anyway, I will take my leave now. Give my regards to Angela and Helena... Oh, and thank you for stopping me from killing them."
Before Yuan could even open his mouth to respond, Lucian vanished into the void.

However, Yuan paid it no mind and struck without hesitation, driving a straight punch into his gut.
"Argh!" Lucian coughed up a mouthful of blood as the impact rippled through his body, shattering his bones and tearing apart his muscles from within.
Knowing that Lucian was a Transcendent, Yuan didn't hold back because he wasn't afraid of killing him by accident.
Of course, Yuan limited himself to using only ordinary Eternal Essence.
"Aaaah!"
Lucian roared as he unleashed even more of his fake Eternal Essence.
Unfortunately for him, no amount of fake Eternal Essence would allow him to defeat Yuan.
For the next several hours, Lucian endured a completely one-sided beating.
"When are you going to wake up?
Do you really want to die like this?" Yuan questioned, his hand wrapped tightly around Lucian's neck.
After a moment of silence and complete stillness, Lucian's body suddenly began to relax, and light slowly returned to his eyes.
"Oh?"
Upon seeing the change, Yuan released his grasp on Lucian.
"Cough!"
Lucian spat out another mouthful of blood before looking at Yuan with a dazed expression.
"W-Who are you...?" Lucian asked.
"Yuan."
"Yuan?
I have never heard of you.
Are you an Eternal?
You don't look like one, though..." Lucian questioned with a puzzled expression.
Yuan shook his head and calmly replied, "I'm human."
"What?" Lucian's eyes widened with shock.
"B-But you can wield Eternal Essence!"
"Don't worry about it.
Right now, I have some questions for you," Yuan then said.
"Angela and Helena, you know them, right?"
Lucian raised an eyebrow and responded with a surprised face, "Huh?
How do you know those names?
Did you meet them?"
It was Yuan's turn to raise his eyebrows.
"You don't remember?" he asked.
"Remember what?"
"That you met and attacked them.
We were fighting for a reason, you know?"
A look of realization flashed across Lucian's face, and he fell silent for a moment before asking in a concerned tone, "I...
I didn't hurt them, did I?"
"Physically?
No."
Lucian released a sigh of relief after hearing this.
"Care to elaborate on why you attacked them out of nowhere?
You were also moving around like a lifeless puppet when we fought."
"Sorry, but I cannot disclose anything to you." Lucian shook his head.
"Are you sure?
I know Deemo very well, you know?" Yuan said, mentioning the Demon God.
"Y-You know my Master?!" Lucian exclaimed in disbelief.
"Not only that, but I even plan on fighting for him during the next 'event', if you know what I am talking about."
Lucian's expression changed once again when Yuan mentioned the event.
"You are going to participate in the Eternals' Reckoning, too?
And under Master Deemo?" Lucian asked in a somewhat doubtful voice.
"But you're a human from the Nine Heavens."
Without saying a word, Yuan activated his Transcended Demonic Awakening, taking on his demon form.
Lucian subconsciously backed away from Yuan after sensing his ridiculous presence.
"What about now?" Yuan asked with a smile on his face.
"How in..." Lucian rubbed his eyes and looked again, as if trying to make sure he was not seeing things.
"To be honest with you, I have not decided whether I will participate in the event yet, and Deemo really wants me to fight for him.
I think you know why.
However, if you refuse to tell me about your situation, I'll tell Deemo that I won't participate—and then I'll blame it all on you," Yuan said, pointing at him.
"What?!
That's ridiculous!
And unreasonable!"
Yuan shrugged and said, "If you don't want that to happen, then tell me everything.
I won't tell Deemo.
I promise."
After a moment of silence, Lucian released a defeated sigh and said, "I cannot go into the details, because doing so would cost me my life—literally."
"Then tell me what you can."
Lucian nodded.
"Before that, I have a question for you.
How much do you know about my origin, if anything at all?"
"I know about the Great Cataclysm, as well as the Transcedents' clash with Deemo.
I was also told that some of you were killed during that clash."
Lucian then spoke, "No, we weren't killed.
Master Deemo saw potential in us and had us participate in the Eternals' Reckoning, and we've been training and fighting for him ever since then."
"As for why I attacked those two...
It's due to a curse, and I have no control over it."
"Did Deemo cast this curse on you?" Yuan then asked.
Lucian nodded.
"We are forbidden from coming into contact with anyone from our world.
If we do... we are forced to eliminate them, regardless of who they are."
"What purpose could such a curse possibly serve?" Yuan raised his eyebrows, puzzled by the restriction.
However, Lucian merely shook his head in silence, either because he did not know the answer himself or because he was unable to reveal it.
"So, are the rest of the Transcendents still alive right now?" Yuan then asked.
A grim expression appeared on Lucian's face as he responded in a dejected voice, "There were six of us in the beginning, but only two of us remain now."
"How did they die?"
"How else?
They all died during the Eternals' Reckoning."
"Huh?
I'm surprised that Deemo allowed you guys to die.
I thought he valued the Transcendents."
"Are you kidding me?" Lucian sneered.
"We're nothing but tools in his eyes."
"Even so, there are so few of you.
What will he do if you all perish?"
"He'll just find others to replace us."
After a moment of silence, Yuan spoke, "Alright.
I get the gist of your situation.
Now I need to know your connection to Qian Chu—the one who summoned you here."
"He's just another expendable pawn for my Master."
"What?" Yuan tilted his head, looking utterly confused.
"Sorry, but I cannot tell you the details."
"Then what is your role in all this?"
Lucian silently shook his head.
"Looks like I will have to ask Deemo myself..." Yuan sighed aloud.
Lucian proceeded to stare at Yuan intently, looking as though he wanted to say something.
"What is it?"
"I don't know what kind of relationship you have with my Master, but if you are not close to him, you should stay away.
Otherwise, you will inevitably become entangled in his schemes and cruelty," Lucian warned.
"Anyway, I will take my leave now.
Give my regards to Angela and Helena...
Oh, and thank you for stopping me from killing them."
Before Yuan could even open his mouth to respond, Lucian vanished into the void.

chapters.title: Chapter 2534 Leaving Primordial Chaos
paragraphs: Even long after Lucian left the scene, Yuan remained lingering in the void with a pondering expression on his face, contemplating everything he'd just learned.
Although he still had many questions, there was one thing that he understood clearly from his conversation with Lucian.
'Deemo... that bastard cannot be trusted.' Yuan thought to himself.
While he already had a vague feeling that Deemo was hiding things from him, he could never have anticipated that Qian Chu was somehow related.
'Just what was Qian Chu doing for Deemo? And why did Lucian just leave after being summoned?'
Some time later, Yuan returned to Tian Qiyuan's world, where Angela and Helena were nervously waiting.
"You're back!"
They rushed over the moment they sensed his presence enter the world.
"Where's Lucian? What happened?"
"Did you kill him?"
They bombarded him with questions.
"Calm down," Yuan said to them as he took a few steps back. "He's fine, and he told me about a few things. Do you want to hear the good or bad news first?"
Helena and Angela exchanged glances for a moment before responding simultaneously, "The good news first."
"Good news, there are still other Transcendents out there. Bad news, there are only two of them left, so there are five of you in existence right now."

"Only two left...? What happened to the others? Selena told us that the Demon God claimed he didn't kill them during our fight, even though we witnessed it with our own eyes," asked Angela with a puzzled face.

"It's true," Yuan said before elaborating. "The Demon God did not kill your friends. Instead, he forced them to participate in some gladiator-style event used purely to entertain Eternals—gods like the Demon God."
"What?! So they've been fighting for the Demon God this entire time?! That's a fate even worse than death!" Angela exclaimed in shock after hearing this.
Yuan nodded.
"According to Lucian, there were six of them in the beginning. Unfortunately, there are only two of them remaining now."
Helena fell silent, her head lowered slightly, as if mourning her companions.
"Did you find out why he suddenly attacked us?" Angela then asked.
"It's a curse from the Demon God that forces them to kill any demon they encounter for whatever reason."
"That's outrageous!"
"Does that mean we can't even meet them? Since they will just try to kill us?" Helena asked.
"Most likely, unless we remove the curse."
"Damn it..." Angela gritted her teeth angrily.
"It's unfortunate, but there's nothing we can do now," Yuan said while shaking his head.
After all, Deemo was simply too powerful.
"Unless we somehow find another Prime Eternal who'd be willing to help us deal with Deemo, there's nothing we can realistically do to him," he added.
"And what are the chances of something like that happening?"
Yuan shrugged.
"I don't know any other Prime Eternals besides Deemo...
After a slight pause, he added, "Actually, I do know another Prime Eternal, but they are after my life, so there's that."
"Lord Shiva wants me to ask—which Prime Eternal did you offend?" Mu Xuelian suddenly asked.
"Someone called Morveth."
"MORVETH?!" Shiva abruptly took control of Mu Xuelian's body just to exclaim in shock.
"You offended Morveth?! How in the universe did you manage to do that?!"
"I killed one of her pets or something," he calmly replied.
"Unbelievable..." she muttered in a daze before continuing, "Out of the five Prime Eternal, Morveth is the most vengeful. If you offend her even slightly, you can expect a gruesome retaliation."
"Well, she's already tried to kill me once. If it weren't for Deemo, I wouldn't be alive right now."
"You... should probably return to the Nine Heavens and stay there." Shiva shook her head.
"So, what are your plans now? And what should we do?" Angela asked.

Yuan looked at them and said, "I promised that I'd let you explore this world if you helped me clean up with Forsaken, and since you've done just that, I don't have a reason to keep you with me any longer. Go and have fun, but remember not to cause any trouble."
"I guess it'll help us take our minds off the others..." Helena sighed.
"When do you think Selena will be able to join us?"

Yuan shrugged, "She'll likely be busy trying to unite the Demonic Realm and the Nine Heavens for some time, but you can join her if you'd like. Just make sure you don't go in your true appearance and disguise yourself like her."
"Alright. We'll meet up with her first, then decide."
Angela and Helena left his world shortly after, leaving Yuan and My Xuelian behind.
"What now?" Shiva asked.
Yuan pondered for a moment before responding, "I was going to deal with the Celestial Overlords, but I am currently waiting for something, so instead, let's go visit another Eternal."
"What?" Shiva raised her eyebrows.
"You said you know another Eternal who's being sealed in the Nine Heavens, correct? Let's go meet them."
"Seriously? You'd be willing to help?"
"That will depend entirely on the Eternal's personality and whether they're dangerous or not. Do you know where they are sealed?"
"Well, I know where he was sealed before this world was split into nine realms, but not anymore."
"Do you remember any details about the location?"
"I remember that it had a lot of mountains, and there were beasts that recently settled nearby."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at her description and wondered if this Eternal was the same one he had encountered in Heavenly White Valley.
"I want to bring you somewhere first," Yuan said a moment later.
Some time later, they left Tian Qiyuan's world and prepared to return to the Nine Heavens.
However, as they traversed the Primordial Chaos, they noticed something off about the atmosphere there.
"Is it just me, or has this place gotten a lot quieter?" Mu Xuelian wondered aloud.

"No, it has definitely gotten quieter," Yuan responded with a thoughtful expression. "We were being swarmed by magical beasts on our way here, but now I cannot detect even a single one with my divine sense."
It was almost as if all the magical beasts in the Primordial Chaos had been erased.
Suddenly, Mu Xuelian came to a halt, and her entire aura changed, as Shiva had taken over.

"Shiva?" Yuan turned to look at her, only to find her staring in a certain direction in the void. However, when he followed her gaze, he saw nothing but countless stars scattered across the vast distance.
"What do you see?" Yuan asked.
"I don't know," she replied in a nervous voice.
"What?" Yuan raised his eyebrows, looking puzzled.
Not only did Shiva make no sense, but this was the first time he'd seen her look so nervous.
"I don't see anything, but my instincts are screaming at me right now," she continued. "My instincts as an Eternal..."
"Wait..."
A look of realization suddenly appeared on her face, and she muttered, "But there's no way... Why would she be here?"
"Who?" Yuan inquired with a frown, an ominous feeling growing in his guts.
"Hil—"
Shiva opened her mouth to speak, but before she could even say a single word, she felt something covering her mouth.
Sensing this, Shiva did not dare to move, her entire body turning as stiff as a frozen statue.
"I wanted to remain as a spectator for a little longer, but you had to ruin it."
A calm voice suddenly echoed in the void, alerting Yuan, even though he still could not sense anyone nearby.
"Allow me to introduce myself."

The voice continued, and the space behind Shiva suddenly began to bend, revealing a figure—or more precisely, a barely noticeable outline of an invisible figure who had their hand covering Shiva's mouth.
"Who are you?" Yuan asked, preparing to engage in combat at any moment.
"My name is Hilla."
"Hilla?" Yuan quickly recognized the name.
"One of five Prime Eternals?"
"Oh? You recognize my name? How unexpected for a mortal."
"And what does a powerful being like you want from us?"
The invisible figured claiming to be Hilla removed her hand from Shiva's mouth and said, "Nothing."
"You really expect me to believe that?"
"Saaruk," Hilla suddenly mentioned another familiar name.
"Recognize it?" she asked.
"Of course..." Yuan narrowed his eyes slightly. "Don't tell me you're here to avenge him or something?"
"Avenge him...?" Hilla muttered in a somewhat dumbfounded voice.
"Hahaha!" she suddenly burst into laughter.
"He is nothing more than an idiot who loves pretending to be stronger than he truly is. I could not care less if an idiot like him is killed."
"Then why did you mention him?"
"Because he allowed me to discover an intriguing existence like you, being useful for once."
The invisible figure slowly approached Yuan before circling around him.
Yuan watched her every movement in silence, wondering what she was planning.
Then, Hilla spoke again, "A mortal who is not only capable of wielding Eternal Essence, but one that can even absorb the Essence of the Void? You have piqued my interest," Hilla said.

chapters.title: Chapter 2535 Prime Eternal Hilla
paragraphs: "What?! He can absorb Essence of the Void?!" Shiva exclaimed in shock after learning this for the first time.
Since it happened after she abandoned him, she had no idea until Hilla mentioned it.
"Mortal, I want to witness it with my own eyes," Hilla then spoke.
"You want me to absorb the Essence of the Void right now?" Yuan asked with a raised eyebrow.
"Yes, or would that be a problem? You can absorb it, can't you?" Hilla answered, sounding adamant.
"Well, I haven't tried again after my fight with Saaruk because I was only able to absorb a limited amount before feeling like I'd reached a bottleneck," he admitted.
'However, I might actually be able to absorb more now, given that my cultivation and understanding of the Power of the Void had improved significantly since then...' Yuan thought to himself.
After pondering for a moment, Yuan looked at Hilla's transparent figure and said, "Okay, I will try to absorb the Essence of the Void. Give me a minute to prepare myself."
He had a feeling Hilla would not let him leave unless she got what she wanted, especially since she took her time traveling all the way to the Nine Heavens to meet him.
Moreover, he'd rather not offend another Prime Eternal if he didn't need to, as he already had Deemo and Morveth to deal with.
'She feels different from other Eternals for some reason... Although I still cannot trust her, let's see where this goes...' Yuan thought to himself as he prepared to cultivate.
A moment later, Yuan took a deep breath and started feeling the 'essence' of the void.
Due to his improved understanding of the void overall, he was able to sense it much quicker this time.
Almost immediately after sensing the Essence of the Void, Yuan began attempting to absorb it.
Shiva's eyes slowly widened with shock and disbelief as Yuan really started absorbing the Essence of the Void moments later.

'This monster! His Eternal Constitution isn't even complete, and he can already absorb the Essence of the Void that true Eternals like me have trouble doing?! This doesn't make any sense at all! How is he achieving this with a body like that?!' she cried inwardly.
It was at this moment that Shiva started to suspect something was fundamentally different about Yuan's physique because, logically speaking, his body should not be able to handle Essence of the Void.
Meanwhile, Hilla watched Yuan in silence, her expression unknown due to her invisible features.

After he began absorbing the Essence of the Void, Yuan could sense his Eternal Essence growing at a rapid pace. Every minute of cultivation produced the equivalent of over ten years' worth of Eternal Essence.

This incredible rate of improvement was precisely why all Eternals cultivated the Essence of the Void whenever possible, as it allowed them to progress far faster than absorbing ordinary essence. Unfortunately, not even Eternals could cultivate the Essence of the Void without limit. Each of them had their own threshold, and once they reached it, they would be forced to take a break.
And it was this very limit that differentiated one Eternal from another. In a way, it was the standard by which Eternals measured their talent.
<Your understanding of the Power of the Void has increased significantly>
<Your understanding of the Power of the Void has reached the next realm>
<You have learned Supreme Void Understanding>
<Your Void Manipulation has reached a new level>
It didn't take long before Yuan reached a new level of Void Understanding, as he was already on the verge of a breakthrough during his last cultivation of Essence of the Void.
The moment his Void Understanding reached Supreme-level, Yuan's ability to sense the Essence of the Void became even clearer, and his absorption rate increased even more.
As for the rate he acquired Eternal Essence, it also skyrocketed.
A few days later, Yuan stopped cultivating when he started feeling the bottleneck again.
"Are you satisfied?" Yuan turned to look at Hilla, who had remained as still and quiet as a statue during the last few days.
Hilla remarked a moment later, "You're even more interesting than I thought."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at such a remark, wondering if he'd gotten himself in more trouble.
"If you're satisfied, can we go now?" Yuan then asked.
"Sure."
"Really?"
Yuan doubted his ears when Hilla agreed so easily to allow them to leave.
"Why do you seem so surprised that I am letting you go?" she asked, sounding intrigued by his reaction.
"Because I find it hard to believe that you would travel all the way here just to see me cultivate," he admitted.
"Then what else are you expecting me to do?"
He shook his head.
"I don't know."

Hilla then said, "Although I wouldn't mind it if you lingered a little longer, that wouldn't be interesting at all. After all, I wish to see more of what you'll achieve, and that can only be done if you continue doing your own thing."
"Wait... that sounds like you intend to keep watching me." Yuan's eyes widened at her words.
"Of course. It has been such a long time since I found something this interesting. It would not make sense for me to leave before seeing it through."
Yuan swallowed nervously before asking, "Does that mean..."
He paused for a second.
"You'll follow me around?"
He already had Shiva following him around, and the idea that another Eternal—a Prime Eternal, at that—following him sounded awful.
"Follow you? To that place with 'his' power? I'd rather not, as I can watch you perfectly fine from out here." Hilla said.

Hearing this, Yuan inwardly sighed in relief. Even so, it still felt strange knowing that a Prime Eternal would be constantly watching over him. Unfortunately, there was nothing he could realistically do about it.
"Then... I'll be leaving now..."
Yuan turned to look at Shiva before beginning to leave.
Shiva quickly tried to follow, but she immediately froze in her tracks when Hilla's voice echoed behind her.
"Shiva, I am not done with you."

'She feels different from other Eternals for some reason...
Although I still cannot trust her, let's see where this goes...' Yuan thought to himself as he prepared to cultivate.
A moment later, Yuan took a deep breath and started feeling the 'essence' of the void.
Due to his improved understanding of the void overall, he was able to sense it much quicker this time.
Almost immediately after sensing the Essence of the Void, Yuan began attempting to absorb it.
Shiva's eyes slowly widened with shock and disbelief as Yuan really started absorbing the Essence of the Void moments later.
'This monster!
His Eternal Constitution isn't even complete, and he can already absorb the Essence of the Void that true Eternals like me have trouble doing?!
This doesn't make any sense at all!
How is he achieving this with a body like that?!' she cried inwardly.
It was at this moment that Shiva started to suspect something was fundamentally different about Yuan's physique because, logically speaking, his body should not be able to handle Essence of the Void.
Meanwhile, Hilla watched Yuan in silence, her expression unknown due to her invisible features.
After he began absorbing the Essence of the Void, Yuan could sense his Eternal Essence growing at a rapid pace.
Every minute of cultivation produced the equivalent of over ten years' worth of Eternal Essence.
This incredible rate of improvement was precisely why all Eternals cultivated the Essence of the Void whenever possible, as it allowed them to progress far faster than absorbing ordinary essence.
Unfortunately, not even Eternals could cultivate the Essence of the Void without limit.
Each of them had their own threshold, and once they reached it, they would be forced to take a break.
And it was this very limit that differentiated one Eternal from another.
In a way, it was the standard by which Eternals measured their talent.
<Your understanding of the Power of the Void has increased significantly>
<Your understanding of the Power of the Void has reached the next realm>
<You have learned Supreme Void Understanding>
<Your Void Manipulation has reached a new level>
It didn't take long before Yuan reached a new level of Void Understanding, as he was already on the verge of a breakthrough during his last cultivation of Essence of the Void.
The moment his Void Understanding reached Supreme-level, Yuan's ability to sense the Essence of the Void became even clearer, and his absorption rate increased even more.
As for the rate he acquired Eternal Essence, it also skyrocketed.
A few days later, Yuan stopped cultivating when he started feeling the bottleneck again.
"Are you satisfied?" Yuan turned to look at Hilla, who had remained as still and quiet as a statue during the last few days.
Hilla remarked a moment later, "You're even more interesting than I thought."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at such a remark, wondering if he'd gotten himself in more trouble.
"If you're satisfied, can we go now?" Yuan then asked.
"Sure."
"Really?"
Yuan doubted his ears when Hilla agreed so easily to allow them to leave.
"Why do you seem so surprised that I am letting you go?" she asked, sounding intrigued by his reaction.
"Because I find it hard to believe that you would travel all the way here just to see me cultivate," he admitted.
"Then what else are you expecting me to do?"
He shook his head.
"I don't know."
Hilla then said, "Although I wouldn't mind it if you lingered a little longer, that wouldn't be interesting at all.
After all, I wish to see more of what you'll achieve, and that can only be done if you continue doing your own thing."
"Wait... that sounds like you intend to keep watching me." Yuan's eyes widened at her words.
"Of course.
It has been such a long time since I found something this interesting.
It would not make sense for me to leave before seeing it through."
Yuan swallowed nervously before asking, "Does that mean..."
He paused for a second.
"You'll follow me around?"
He already had Shiva following him around, and the idea that another Eternal—a Prime Eternal, at that—following him sounded awful.
"Follow you?
To that place with 'his' power?
I'd rather not, as I can watch you perfectly fine from out here." Hilla said.
Hearing this, Yuan inwardly sighed in relief.
Even so, it still felt strange knowing that a Prime Eternal would be constantly watching over him.
Unfortunately, there was nothing he could realistically do about it.
"Then...
I'll be leaving now..."
Yuan turned to look at Shiva before beginning to leave.
Shiva quickly tried to follow, but she immediately froze in her tracks when Hilla's voice echoed behind her.
"Shiva, I am not done with you."

chapters.title: Chapter 2536 Prime Eternal Hilla(2)
paragraphs: Shiva cried inwardly when she heard Hilla's words, but she didn't dare to complain and stopped to face her invisible figure.
"What do you want from me?" Shiva asked with a slight frown.
Even though she was facing a Prime Eternal, Shiva was still an Eternal herself and had to maintain her composure. As long as she did nothing to offend Hilla, she had no real reason to fear her.
Meanwhile, Yuan also stopped to watch them. However, both Shiva and Hilla suddenly vanished from his perception, becoming completely invisible and undetectable even to his divine sense.
'I guess she doesn't want me to hear whatever they are going to discuss...' Yuan shook his head inwardly.
Still, he lingered, as he did not want to leave without Shiva.
Not far away, Hilla and Shiva began their conversation within a concealment barrier.
"Why are you with this mortal? Last I heard, you were sealed after losing a fight." Hilla questioned.
"He was the one who freed me from my seal," Shiva answered truthfully. "And he promised to help me regain my true body, so I am just following him around until then."
"So, you have no intention of acquiring the power that resides within his world?"
"The Absolute Power? Hah!" Shiva sneered. "I am not stupid enough to chase after some imaginary power that nobody has been able to prove truly exists."
"Even though there is evidence that it exists?"

"If you mean how our powers get weaker the closer we get to that world, I wouldn't consider it real evidence. Who knows? It could be a special trait of the world and has nothing to do with the Absolute Power."
Hilla fell silent, as if pondering something.
"Did you stop me just to ask me a few questions?" Shiva then asked.
"That mortal..." Hilla spoke, but paused midway and did not continue.
"No... forget it. There are still a few things I need to confirm."
"What do you mean?" Shilva raised her eyebrows, looking puzzled.
However, Hilla refused to elaborate and vanished into the void.
At the same time, the barrier around Shiva disappeared, allowing Yuan to see her again.
Shiva turned to look at him and remarked, "You're still here?"
"Why would I leave without you? Unlike a certain someone, I am not the type to abandon others," Yuan replied, taking a jab at her for abandoning him before.
Shiva sucked her teeth in annoyance but did not say anything else and returned control of the body to Mu Xuelian.
Shortly later, Yuan and Mu Xuelian continued leaving the Primordial Chaos, quickly returning to the Nine Heavens.
"I'm surprised that she actually let us go so quickly," Yuan muttered.
"Lord Shiva said it's unexpected but not shocking, considering that Prime Eternal Hilla is the most mysterious amongst the five Prime Eternals," Mu Xuelian said.
"The most mysterious?" Yuan asked.
"Lord Shiva said that nobody ever knows what she's thinking, and that she doesn't participate in a lot of things, merely keeping to herself."
"The only thing I want to know is..."
Yuan paused briefly before continuing via voice transmission, "Should I be worried about her?"
"Lord Shiva said that Prime Eternal Hilla is the least aggressive Prime Eternal and that she tends to be an observer most of the time."
"Still, I don't know how to feel about having a Prime Eternal constantly watching over me like a creep..." Yuan shivered.
"Believe it or not... There are Eternals constantly watching the Nine Heavens. You just aren't aware of them because they don't make themselves known."
"So the Absolute Being's power doesn't block their surveillance, huh?"
"It doesn't take much energy to look, so no, it doesn't. Also, it's not like they constantly keep watch. They usually just take a peek before returning to their own business."
"Good to know."
After returning to the Seventh Heaven, Yuan brought Mu Xuelian directly to the Nameless Stairway.
Upon arriving, Yuan was surprised to find the area crowded with people. However, most of them did not appear to be climbers. Instead, they were inspecting the stairway with great interest.
"What's going on here?" Yuan approached one of the people there and asked.

"You haven't heard? After this new Stairway to Heaven was confirmed to have been crafted by a legendary blacksmith from the past, blacksmiths from all over the world gathered here just to inspect it."
"Is that so?"
Yuan turned to look at Mu Xuelian and said, "Let's go."
Without waiting for a response, he jumped toward the stairway, landing right before the door.
"Hey, you guys mind moving out of the way?"
"Shut up, can't you see that we're busy here?"
Yuan sighed, "I know you're excited about this new treasure, and I don't blame you, but you shouldn't block the whole thing, preventing people from using it."
However, the blacksmiths completely ignored him and continued to examine the stairway.
Unbeknownst to them, they were completely ignoring the very person who created the Nameless Stairway they were inspecting.
"Just give up," another climber waiting for the blacksmiths to finish said to Yuan. "They won't move for anyone. If one of them leaves, another blacksmith will immediately take their spot."
"It's also unwise to offend them, or your life may become complicated in the future."

Since most blacksmiths were members of the same association, offending one of them was no different from offending all of them. If that happened, one could be barred from purchasing weapons or having their own weapons repaired, which would make any cultivator's life extremely difficult.

Of course, the same could be said for offending alchemists. However, unlike blacksmiths, alchemists have many different organizations, so offending a few would not be the end of the world, as long as they did not belong to a top one.
That being said, Yuan couldn't care less about offending them. Even if he offended every single blacksmith in the world, it would not matter to him.
After taking a deep breath, Yuan approached one of the blacksmiths, grabbed him by the back of his robes, and yanked him away from the door, shocking everyone watching.

chapters.title: Chapter 2537 Indestructible Steel Association
paragraphs: The entire place suddenly became dead silent, and for the first time, the blacksmiths turned their attention away from the Nameless Stairway to look behind them, their eyes wide with shock and disbelief.
"D-Do you have any idea what you have just done?!"
The cultivator who had warned Yuan not to offend them muttered, a bewildered look on his face.
The very next moment, an angry shout echoed through the area as the man Yuan had yanked away from the stairway flew back into the air, his face twisted with rage.
"How dare you, you little bastard! Do you have any idea who I am and what you've just done?!"
Yuan's expression remained nonchalant as he replied, "Who are you? If I had to remember every insignificant little ant like you, my life would be miserable."
The man trembled some more before shouting loudly, "In that case, allow me to introduce myself!"

He suddenly made a few hand gestures before poking Yuan in the chest with his index and middle fingers. Although Yuan could've easily avoided the man's attack, he was intrigued, so he allowed himself to be struck.
However, the man did not attack Yuan, doing something else entirely instead.
"Oh?" Yuan muttered in a slightly surprised voice when he realized what the man had just done to him.

"I have just barred you from ever receiving support from the Indestructible Steel Association and every single blacksmith under its wing! Do you finally realize how fucked you are right now and who you've offended?!"
Yuan raised an eyebrow and calmly replied, "I understand the first part, but that doesn't tell me anything about your identity. In fact, I still have no clue who you are."
"Bastard! Only a Divine Blacksmith can block people from the association without needing a formal approval, and I am one of only a hundred Divine Blacksmiths in existence!"
"Oh, you were a Divine Blacksmith? I would've never been able to guess with how lowly you were acting," Yuan said, still remaining nonchalant about the whole situation.

"Y-You ignorant bastard! You must have no idea what kind of mess you've gotten yourself into! The Indestructible Steel Association is the largest association for blacksmiths in the Nine Heavens, with the majority of blacksmiths in the world under our name! Now that you've been barred from receiving our assistance, good luck buying treasures or getting them repaired by us! Not only that, but everyone associated with us will also avoid you like the plague!"
"I am aware, and I still don't think it's a big deal. Hell, I wouldn't let you repair my treasures even if you paid me," Yuan remarked.
"Hmph!" The Divine Blacksmith coldly sneered. "You can keep acting tough, but as long as that brand is attached to your soul, you can forget about receiving our help!"
A calm smile appeared on Yuan's face, and he replied, "Is that all you have to say? Because I have places to be and have already wasted enough time dealing with an idiot like you.
The Divine Blacksmith trembled at Yuan's words before erupting in even greater fury. "It seems you are not satisfied with your punishment and require further discipline!"
His fists ignited with flames as he launched a punch straight at Yuan's chest.
However, instead of letting the Divine Blacksmith strike him, Yuan actually blocked it this time, casually catching his fist.
The Divine Blacksmith wore a shocked face when Yuan casually blocked his fist. Although he didn't intend to kill Yuan, his attack had enough force to break a few ribs.
"Since you didn't strike with the intend to kill, I won't punish you too harshly—" Yuan muttered before clenching tightly, crushing the Divine Blacksmith's hand into a bloody mess.
"Aahh!" The Divine Blacksmith screamed in pain as he pulled back, staring at his mutilated hand with a terrified expression on his face.
"Don't worry, you can fix that with a few good pills. I'm sure you're more than capable of buying them with your resources as a Divine Blacksmith. Though it might affect your abilities for a little."
"S-Senior Huang!"
The other blacksmiths finally snapped out of their daze when they saw the Divine Blacksmith injured. The next moment, they surrounded Yuan, their hammers raised.
"Save your energy," Yuan said as he revealed a fraction of his hidden aura.
A terrifying pressure instantly engulfed the area, making everyone feel as though mountains had suddenly been placed upon their backs.
"W-Who the hell are you?!" The Divine Blacksmith muttered with a pale complexion.
"I'm Yuan," he revealed his true identity without a care.
Then, without another word, he walked to the door and tapped on it.
The door immediately opened for him.

Before stepping inside, Yuan said, "Oh, right. Starting today, every blacksmith from the Indestructible Steel Association is prohibited from using the stairway. If you have any problems, come find me."
"What...?"
Without elaborating, Yuan entered the stairway, disappearing into the darkness. Mu Xuelian silently followed, the door closing behind her.
Once Yuan and his pressure had disappeared, the blacksmiths quickly rushed to the Divine Blacksmith's side and began offering him recovery pills for his injured hand.
"Here, Senior Huang! Quickly consume this before your injury gets any worse!"
However, the Divine Blacksmith ignored them and silently stared at the Nameless Stairway, Yuan's final words echoing inside his head like some kind of curse.
"Move!"
The Divine Blacksmith shouted as he pushed them aside and rushed to the door.
"Open up!"
He pounded on the door with his other hand.
Yet, the stairway remained unresponsive.
Seeing this, the Divine Blacksmith's complexion paled even further.
"Impossible..." he muttered in a dazed voice, looking as though he'd just realized something.
"What's going on, Senior Huang?"
The other blacksmiths asked him with puzzled faces.
The Divine Blacksmith swallowed nervously before responding in a shaky voice, "That man... was the mysterious owner of the stairway!"
"HE'S WHAT?!" Not just the blacksmiths, but everyone present exclaimed in shock, their eyes wide with bewilderment.

chapters.title: Chapter 2538 Returning to Heavenly White Valley
paragraphs: "T-This must be some kind of misunderstanding! There's no way some rude bastard like that could be the owner of the stairway!"
The blacksmiths refused to believe it, even though it was coming from a Divine Blacksmith.
"If you don't believe me, go ahead and try using the stairway!" said the Divine Blacksmith.
The blacksmiths swallowed nervously before they approached the door and knocked on it, trying to enter it one by one.
However, the Nameless Stairway remained unresponsive to all of them.
Seeing this, the Divine Blacksmith suddenly pointed at one of the cultivators who had been waiting for the blacksmiths to finish and said, "You wanted to climb, right? Do it now."

Although the cultivator had already intended to climb, it still felt strange to be ordered around in such a manner. Yet, there was nothing he could do but silently nod and follow the Divine Blacksmith's command.
When the cultivator reached the door and knocked on it, the Nameless Stairway opened for him, leaving the blacksmiths it had ignored completely stunned and speechless.
The next moment, the cultivator entered the stairway and disappeared inside.
Just as the door began to close, one of the blacksmiths suddenly shot forward and slipped into the stairway before it could fully shut.
"He went inside!"
However, a second later, the door opened again, and the blacksmith who had tried to sneak in was ejected like trash, leaving a trail of blood in the air.

The other blacksmiths gasped in shock and hurriedly rushed to catch him. After examining his condition, they sighed in relief upon discovering that he was not dead and had suffered only superficial injuries.
"How does the treasure differentiate us?" one of the blacksmiths suddenly questioned aloud.
The Divine Blacksmith, who had just consumed a recovery pill, responded with a grim expression. "Most likely through our association's identification symbol."

Just as every faction possessed a distinct symbol that identified both the organization and its members—a symbol its members were required to carry on their bodies—the Indestructible Steel Association had something similar. Every blacksmith under its banner bore the same identifying symbol.

"So are you saying that unless we remove our symbol, which is akin to leaving the association, that we would not be able to use the new Stairway to Heaven?! That's outrageous! Who the hell does that man think he is?!"
"He basically just declared war on the entire association! Even if he's the owner of the stairway, he won't get away with this!
Soon, news that the owner of the new Stairway to Heaven had been identified began to spread, and Yuan's name began echoing throughout the Nine Heavens again.
Meanwhile, Yuan and Mu Xuelian made their way to the Heavenly White Valley upon arriving in the Eighth Heaven.
"Lord Shiva asks why you're bringing her to this place," Mu Xuelian said as they traveled through the endless mountain valleys.
"You'll find out soon enough."
Eventually, they arrived at the location.
Yuan created a hole in the ground, revealing the tunnel he'd covered up before.
"Let's go."
Without explaining, Yuan entered the tunnel with Mu Xuelian following closely behind.
Some time later, they arrived at the underground cavern with the massive sealed gate.
"What do you think?" Yuan turned to look at Mu Xuelian, but Shiva had already taken control and was staring at the gates with wide eyes.
"These inscriptions... It's the language of Eternals!" she muttered.
"So, do you recognize this place?" Yuan asked. "Is it where your friend is sealed?"
Shiva fell silent for a moment before shaking her head, "I don't recognize this place."
Yuan raised an eyebrow and said, "Really? There's an Eternal sealed inside."
"I don't sense an Eternal inside, though," Shiva quickly responded, which puzzled Yuan even further.
"What do you mean? I spoke to them the last time I was here. They even shared a technique with me."
Yuan approached the gate and shouted loudly, "Hey! Remember me? I have returned!"
Silence.
Yuan wondered if the Eternal was slumbering, so he struck the gates like he did last time, but instead of using his sword, he kicked them with so much force that it shook the entire cavern.
"Wake up! Or do you want to stay sealed?!"
Still no response, as if the Eternal inside was no longer there.
"As I said, I don't sense any Eternals inside," Shiva said. "Even if they are sealed, I should be able to sense them."
"How is that possible? Don't tell me someone else freed them?" Yuan pondered out loud.

However, the only other person who knew this location was Bai Sulan, as she was with him at the time of the discovery. But he also had no reason to believe that Bai Sulan had any capability to unseal the Eternal.
"You said the Eternal gave you a technique, right? Let me see it," Shiva suddenly asked.
Yuan was about to agree, but he stopped himself. Even he did not know why—perhaps it was simply a gut feeling.
"Instead, why don't you teach me your language?" Yuan said a moment later. "I understand a little of it, but not enough to comprehend the technique."
Shiva narrowed her eyes at him, sensing his distrust. However, she did not complain and simply said, "Fine. I will teach you our language."
The next moment, she shared with him a translation of their language into the human tongue.
Yuan took a few minutes to digest the information. Then, he sat down and closed his eyes to study the technique given to him before by whatever was sealed behind the gates.
A few minutes later, his eyes opened, shock flickering within.
'I'm truly glad that I did not give this technique to her!' he cried inwardly, realizing that he'd just dodged a bullet.
"So? What did you learn?" Shiva asked him after seeing his expression.
Yuan turned to look at her with a perplexed expression, debating whether he should tell her. After all, the information was too catastrophic to fall into the wrong hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 2539 Selena's Audience With the Celestial Emperor
paragraphs: "Why are you staying quiet? You're the one who brought me here, you know?" Shiva remarked when Yuan refused to explain anything to her.
Yuan sighed and finally spoke, "I know, but this turned out to be much more complicated than I thought."

Shiva fell silent before turning to look at the massive gates once again, her eyes narrowed slightly. She was certain that there was no Eternal sealed behind them, but Yuan had no reason to lie either.
'He started acting suspiciously after learning our language... What kind of technique did he acquire from whatever is behind the gates?' she wondered inwardly.
Then, she focused on the gates themselves, as she'd only been paying attention to the inscriptions thus far.
'These gates...!' Shiva's eyes widened when she realized something after paying closer attention to the gates—or more specifically, the materials they were made of.
Yuan raised an eyebrow when Shiva suddenly started approaching the gates, even pressing her palm against it.
'As I thought, these gates aren't meant to keep Eternals sealed inside but to hide whatever is inside from us!'
The materials used to craft the gates were a rare material that not only completely blocked their senses but was also especially durable against their power: Eternal Essence!
However, Shiva wasn't completely certain, so she decided to test it out herself.
After gathering a tiny amount of Eternal Essence in her fist, she threw a punch at it.
"What are you—"
BOOM!
When Shiva's fists collided with the gates, her Eternal Essence rippled throughout them before scattering like water being dropped on a surface covered in water-repellent substances.
"What are you doing?" Yuan asked with a puzzled look on his face.
Shiva turned to look at him and calmly replied, "I have an idea why you're hesitant about telling me what you know."
"You do? Let's hear it."
"I don't feel like it," Shiva shrugged before turning around and walking towards the exit. "I'll be waiting for you outside. Take your time in here.
"What do you mean?"

"You're going to open the gates and retrieve whatever is inside, right? I doubt you'll want me around when you do that, so I'll wait outside," she calmly said before returning control to Mu Xuelian, who quickly left the cavern, leaving Yuan alone.
Once he was alone, Yuan turned to stare at the gates.
Although he was alone in the cavern, it did not mean he was completely alone, as Prime Eternal Hilla could be watching him at this very moment.
After some thought, Yuan decided to open the gates anyway.
'Even if she is watching, she probably won't be able to see inside once I close the doors behind me.'
With that thought in mind, Yuan approached the gates, placed his hands on the gates, and started mumbling unknown words that were not of the human language.
Moments later, the gates that had been sealed for an unknown amount of time started to slowly creak open.
However, the gates opened only a small crack, just large enough for Yuan to enter.
After taking a deep breath, Yuan took a step forward and entered the gates, which automatically closed behind him.
Meanwhile, somewhere in the Ninth Heaven, Selena entered the Celestial Palace while being surrounded by the entire Heaven's Mandate—all 13 squads.
Despite having basically the entire army present, nobody there felt safe around Selena, a monster with a cultivation level beyond that of a Cultivation God.
"So, how long do you plan on making me wait, Emperor of the Nine Heavens?" Selena asked aloud after waiting for some time outside the Celestial Emperor's audience room.
"Excuse me for the delay, Absolute Ruler."
The Celestial Emperor's voice resounded, and the doors to the room opened the following moment.
Selena calmly walked inside, followed by the generals of Heaven's Mandate.
At the far end of the room sat the Celestial Emperor, with a masked figure standing silently beside him.

Selena stopped before the raised platform and, without even lifting her head to look at the Celestial Emperor, spoke in an annoyed voice. "Not only did you make me wait, but you even dared to seat yourself above me, forcing me to look up at you?"

Before the Celestial Emperor could respond, Selena continued in a domineering tone, "But since you are not accustomed to being in the presence of someone above you, I will not blame you for this mistake. I will even give you a chance to correct it."

The generals of Heaven's Mandate widened their eyes in shock at Selena's bold words. Under normal circumstances, they would have immediately condemned such blasphemy. However, knowing her identity and strength, none of them dared to utter a word. Their mouths opened in disbelief, only to close again a moment later.
The Celestial Emperor remained silent for a moment before rising from his seat and descending the platform until he stood on the same level as Selena.
"You are right. I apologize if my habits have offended you in any way, Absolute Ruler."

A cold smile tugged at Selena's lips as she replied, "I understand that you are wary of me. You even went to such lengths to create these defensive formations, but they are nothing more than a waste of resources. If I wished to, I could kill everyone here with ease."
Then, she took a step toward the Celestial Emperor. In the next moment, the invisible formation between them shattered like fragile glass.
Seeing this, everyone present flinched, subconsciously reaching for their weapons.
However, the Celestial Emperor quickly raised his hand and spoke, "Stand down."
Once the generals withdrew their hands, the Celestial Emperor continued, "You may all leave. I wish to speak with the Absolute Ruler alone."
"W-We cannot do that, Your Majesty!"

The Celestial Emperor glared at them and said, "As she has already stated, if she wished to harm me, none of you would be able to stop her. Therefore, it makes no difference whether you remain here or not. I will not repeat myself."
After a moment of silence, the generals reluctantly left the room, leaving Selena, the Celestial Emperor, and the masked man in the room alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 2540 Selena's Audience With the Celestial Emperor(2)
paragraphs: Selena glanced at the masked figure beside the Celestial Emperor for a brief moment before ignoring him and speaking to the Celestial Emperor, "So, what do you wish to speak to me about?"
"It's quite simple. I want to know what your true purpose for coming to our world is. Do you really wish for humans and demons to coexist, or are you looking for something else?"
Selena raised an eyebrow at the Celestial Emperor's choice of words. "What makes you think I am looking for something?"
"I have no reason to think that," the Celestial Emperor replied. "I was merely making an assumption."

Selena fell silent for a moment before speaking again. "Although there is nothing I personally want from the Nine Heavens, I will admit that its resources will likely be sought after. The Demonic Realm's resources have long since become scarce due to overpopulation and the immortality of our people."

"Hmm... While our world does possess an abundance of resources, that does not mean we can use them without restraint. The only reason we have not exhausted them is because we enforce strict regulations to prevent overconsumption."
Selena nodded. "I will ensure that strict regulations are imposed on any demons who visit this world, so they do not take more than they are allowed."

The Celestial Emperor shook his head. "Their desire for our resources is not what concerns me most. It is our safety. From what I have been told, Cultivation Gods are fairly abundant in the Demonic Realm. Yet in this world, there are so few that they can be counted on one's fingers."
He continued, "If even a few of them were to visit our world, the balance of power would immediately collapse. Hell, your presence alone has already thrown it into disarray."

"Because time flows differently between our worlds, it is not something I can truly regulate. However, it is possible to restrict the strength of those allowed to visit your world, ensuring that they remain within this world's power level," Selena said.

Then, she continued, "I have also heard that some of your people wish to visit the Demonic Realm to accelerate their cultivation, since time passes much faster in our world. However, I must warn you that our environment is vastly different and may not be suitable for humans like you. The Divine Paragon is an anomaly and should not be used as an example."
The Celestial Emperor nodded and said, "We will also have regulations for humans who wish to visit the Demonic Realm."
"Onto my next concern... could whatever turned your people into demons spread to our world? If there is even the slightest possibility, we will have no choice but to keep our world closed."
"I do not have a clear answer for you right now, but once I have a concrete answer, I will let you know."
"How do you plan to determine that without experimenting on our people?"
"I do not," Selena answered calmly. "Because I intend to experiment on the humans of this world."
"What?" The Celestial Emperor immediately frowned at her outrageous words.

"I have already discussed this matter with the leader of the Demon Sealing Clan. Apparently, there are people in this world who worship demons—Demon Worshippers. We plan to conduct the experiments on them... though, of course, their participation will be entirely voluntary."

The Celestial Emperor fell silent at her explanation, unsure how to feel about it. On one hand, he despised the Demon Worshippers as much as everyone else. On the other hand, allowing demons to experiment on humans did not sit right with him, even if it were voluntary.

Selena noticed the hesitation in the Celestial Emperor's eyes and continued, "Either that, or we can leave it to time to reveal the truth. That being said, I am quite confident that it is not contagious. Otherwise, you humans would have long since turned into demons during the Forsaken's invasion in the past."

The Celestial Emperor narrowed his eyes slightly, finding her explanation difficult to refute. It was not as though demons had only just appeared in their world, since the Forsaken had existed there since ancient times. Yet, there had not been a single recorded case of a human turning into a demon.
Selena and the Celestial Emperor continued to discuss coexistence between humans and demons until there was nothing left to discuss.
"Then let us end our meeting here," Selena said.
The Celestial Emperor nodded.
"Once you have become more accustomed to our world, we can discuss the matter further in the future."
Selena didn't linger and left shortly after, escorted back to the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library by Heaven's Mandate.
Once Selena left, the Celestial Emperor returned to his own private chamber with the masked figure, who had not spoken a word since the beginning.
"That woman is much harder to deal with than I anticipated," the Celestial Emperor sighed aloud. "I wanted to invite her to our side, but I need to monitor her a little longer before I decide.
He turned to the masked figure and asked, "What do you think, Master? Is she going to be a problem?"
The masked figure finally spoke in a cold voice. "That woman cannot be trusted. There is a good chance her creator, Deemo, sent her here to steal the Absolute Power from us."
He continued, "Although she may become a problem in the future, it is not something we cannot handle. For now, she is of no concern."

After a brief pause, the masked man spoke in an irritated voice. "Our focus right now should be on that bastard who forced us into slumber and delayed our plans. Although we killed him during our clash, we were unable to destroy his soul. He will undoubtedly return and cause even more trouble for us."
He turned to face the Celestial Emperor and commanded, "Stop wasting time! Find that bastard and annihilate him! If you cannot kill him, then hinder him until we have fully recovered!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2541 Earth?
paragraphs: "Yes, Master. I will use every resource at my disposal to eliminate that bastard who was foolish enough to defy you," the Celestial Emperor said, bowing to the masked figure.
Without another word, the masked figure suddenly collapsed to the ground like a lifeless corpse, and the mysterious aura emitted from their body vanished like smoke.
Moments later, the figure stood back up without picking up the mask that had fallen off during his fall.
"Huh? What am I doing here?" the man looked around with a dumbfounded look on his face.
"Y-Your Majesty! Please forgive this subordinate for intruding in your private chambers! I swear I don't—"
"Leave." The Celestial Emperor interrupted in a cold voice.
"Yes!"
The man didn't dare to linger and hastily left the room while still being confused.
Once he was alone again, the Celestial Emperor stared into the empty horizon and mumbled, "Where are you...? The moment you reveal yourself, I will end you once and for all!"
Meanwhile, after leaving the Celestial Palace, Selena decided to return to the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library by herself, sending Heaven's Madate away.
Shortly later, she was approached by Angela and Helena.
"Are you done speaking with the Celestial Emperor or whatever?" Angela asked.
Selena nodded, "Yes. What are you two doing here?"
"Yuan gave us permission to explore this world, so that's what we're going to do. What about you? Are you really going to play the role of the Demonic Realm's ruler and help unite our worlds?"
"I am. It's actually a lot of fun, and I get to travel, too."
Angela and Helena exchanged looks with each other, wondering whether to reveal what they had learned to her so soon, as it could disturb her mind.
Eventually, Helena said, "Selena, we have something to tell you. It's about our comrades—the other Transcendents who were supposedly killed by the Demon God."
In the end, they decided to tell her everything.
Selena listened with a solemn expression. Although her face remained calm, a flicker of burning anger glinted in her eyes.
"I see... so there are only two of them left..." she mumbled.
"We must avenge our comrades, Selena!" Angela suddenly shouted.
Helena agreed by nodding silently.

Selena rubbed her eyes and sighed out loud. "And how are we going to do that? Have you already forgotten how miserably we lost before? How will it be any different this time? It's not that I don't want to avenge our comrades, but there's really nothing we can do, and I don't want to pointlessly lose our lives."
"B-But—!" Angela opened her mouth to speak, only to realize that she had no response to Selena's words.

Selena spoke again, "I know what you're feeling, but do you really want to throw away your life—your freedom, so soon after just regaining it? We have an eternity to figure out how to avenge our comrades and defeat the Demon God, so let's take this slowly."

"What about Lucian and the other Transcendent, who are still imprisoned by the Demon God? Although we are free, they are still prisoners who have been forced to fight this entire time." Helena said. "They may be immortal, but they don't have unlimited time like us."

Angela added, "And who's to say the Demon God wouldn't make us fight for him after they die? We got lucky because we weren't as strong as the others, but once we're truly the only Transcedents left, the Demon God will definitely come after us.
"I... will try to think of something, but for now, let's just focus on our current situation."
"In that case, can we join you? Yuan said we could if we wanted to."
Selena nodded, "Of course."
'I wonder what he's doing now...' Selena wondered inwardly as Yuan's face entered her mind.
At the same time, Yuan had just passed through the sealed gates and found himself surrounded by the Starry Sky, standing upon a lone path that stretched toward the distant horizon.
Without hesitation, Yuan began walking down the path.
As he walked, he carefully surveyed his surroundings.

Throughout his many past lives, Yuan had spent an immense amount of time in the Starry Sky—so much so that he remembered the position of nearly every star around the Nine Heavens. He could even immediately tell when a star had died or when a new one had been born.

At first, Yuan could tell that he was somewhere close to the Nine Heavens, as he recognized many of the stars around him. However, as he continued down the path, the positions of the stars gradually began to shift. Some vanished from view, while unfamiliar ones appeared in their place.
Eventually, the Starry Sky before him contained no stars he recognized, meaning he had traveled somewhere far beyond the Nine Heavens.
After walking for an unknown amount of time, the Starry Sky became completely unrecognizable, and even the flickering stars seemed fundamentally different.
Eventually, Yuan caught sight of the end of the path, where a lone black door stood ominously in the distance, silently beckoning him forward.
After reaching the end of the path, Yuan stood quietly before the door, examining it with great interest.

At first glance, the door appeared ordinary. However, an engraving covered its surface, depicting a group of human-like figures staring up at a massive being hovering above them—one that looked down upon them like some kind of god.
'Humans... and an Eternal?' Yuan wondered inwardly.
After pondering for some time, Yuan pushed the door open and stepped into the abyss beyond it.
In the next moment, he felt his consciousness being drained away, as though his soul had left his body.
When he finally came to, Yuan found himself lying in a field of grass, staring up at a clear, bright-blue sky.
He quickly sat up and surveyed his surroundings.
"Where... am I?" Yuan muttered, his face filled with bewilderment as his gaze swept over the towering skyscrapers around him—buildings that reminded him of Earth.
"Haha! You can't catch me!"
The sound of children playing nearby reached Yuan's ears, causing him to turn toward them. Sure enough, a group of children was playing what appeared to be tag nearby.
However, there was something strange about these children.
"Their auras... they're cultivators?" Yuan examined their aura closely, and to his absolute shock, every one of these children was a Cultivation God!
"What?!" Yuan shot to his feet in disbelief, drawing the children's attention.
The children then approached him and stared at him in silence, their eyes flickering with intrigue, as if they were looking at something unusual.
"Mister, I have never seen someone with such a weak aura before," one of the children suddenly remarked.
Yuan's eyebrows twitched, and he replied, "And I have never seen children with such a powerful aura. Are you really children? Or experts disguised as one?"
The children exchanged puzzled looks with each other.
"What is he talking about?" one of them asked aloud.
"Our aura is powerful? This is the first time I've been told such a thing," said another.
"Surely, he must be messing with us."
The children turned their attention to Yuan again, and one of them asked, "Mister, where are you from? I have never seen clothes like yours before."
Only then did Yuan realize that the children were wearing skin-tight full-body suits that covered them from neck to toe.
"I'm from a place called the Nine Heavens. What is this place called?"
"Nine Heavens? Never heard of it."
"We're at Sector 11."
"Sector 11? Is that a street name? What about this world?" Yuan inquired.
Despite his odd questions, the children answered, "Sector 11 is the area we're in. Our planet is called Earth."
"What? We're on Earth?" Yuan raised his eyebrows.
He immediately attempted to use his divine sense, only to realize it did not work, as if something were preventing him from using it.
That was when he noticed something else. The entire place was enveloped by something similar to a formation—one that suppressed spiritual energy perfectly.
"Mister, where is this 'Nine Heavens' place?" one of the children questioned.
"I don't know how to explain it... But are you sure this world is called Earth? I used to live in a place called Earth, but it was nothing like this," Yuan said.
"Are you saying that we're lying?"
"We're not lying! This world is really called Earth! Our teacher taught us about it yesterday, too!"
Yuan rubbed his eyes at his puzzling situation.
'Is this another world that is similar to the Demonic Realm? A world created by an Eternal?'
He could not understand why the sealed gates had brought him to such a place. Hell, he was not even sure where he had been taken.
Suddenly, sirens began blaring in the distance, causing the children to tremble in fear.
Then, without warning, they turned around and started sprinting away.
"Hey! Where are you guys going? What's happening right now?" Yuan asked as he chased after them.
