chapters.title: Chapter 2542 Taking Shelter
paragraphs: 'These kids are fast!' Yuan cried inwardly as he struggled to keep up with them.

Unable to use spiritual energy, he could only rely on the strength of his physical body to chase after these children. But despite tempering his body to an extreme degree that would overwhelm even a Cultivation God in the Nine Heavens, he was still having difficulty keeping up with children who appeared to be no older than ten.
'No! It's not that they're fast—it's that I'm slow!' Yuan suddenly realized as he began moving.
There was something fundamentally different about the atmosphere in this place. The gravity was unimaginably heavy, making Yuan feel as though mountains were chained to his back.
Perhaps his senses had been muddled after the teleportation, but he really didn't notice the gravity until he just started moving.
"Why are you moving so slow? Hurry up if you don't want to disappear!" One of the kids suddenly turned his head around to shout at Yuan.
"What do you mean by that? I don't even know what's going on!"
"Are you serious?!"
"Are you really an adult? Even children younger than us know about it!"
The children exclaimed in disbelief after hearing Yuan's words.
"I already told you that I am not from this place!" Yuan sighed loudly.
"We'll explain it to you once we reach the shelter! Just keep running for now!"
A few minutes later, they arrived at a small, unassuming rectangular building, and the children entered without hesitation.
Yuan raised an eyebrow at the structure, which resembled nothing more than a public restroom, before silently following them inside.
The moment Yuan stepped into the building, an odd sensation washed over him, as though he had just passed through an invisible barrier.
"What the—?"
Yuan raised his eyebrows at the sight before him. After following the children into the building, he found himself teleported to an entirely different place.
He was no longer inside a building, but in a vast underground expanse shrouded in darkness, with only dim lights illuminating the area.
There were many buildings scattered throughout the area as well, though none were as tall as the skyscrapers outside.
However, what stood out to Yuan most was the sheer number of people present, with more and more individuals teleported into the underground expanse with every passing second.
Yuan examined the cultivations of those around him, and the discovery left him utterly shocked. Everyone present was at least a Cultivation God, while many had even reached the Absolute God Realm.

Yet the most shocking part was that the majority of them emitted auras Yuan could not perceive at all. That could only mean one thing—that their cultivation was so high that even he was unable to see through it.

It had not been long since Yuan learned of a realm above the Cultivation God Realm in the Demonic Realm, and seeing so many people who might possess cultivations even beyond the Absolute God Realm left him utterly dazed.

'What cultivation level are these people? How long did it take them to achieve it? If it took trillions of years for the Demonic Realm to discover the realm of Absolute God, how old is this world?!' Yuan cried inwardly, wondering if he'd somehow entered an ancient civilization unfathomably old, or if it was a world where time moved countless times faster than the Demonic Realm.
"Mister, are you okay?"
One of the children suddenly asked, snapping Yuan out of his daze.

Yuan lowered his head to look at the children standing before him. There were four of them—two boys and two girls—and they were all staring at him with curious, inquisitive gazes, as though intrigued by his unusual existence.
"Do you really have no idea what is going on, Mister?" one of them eventually questioned him.
Yuan calmly nodded.
Then, one of the boys said, "When the sirens activate, everyone must enter the shelter, or you will disappear from this world."
Yuan then asked, "How will you disappear?"
However, the children shook their heads. "We won't know the details until we grow up. We are only told that we will disappear if we fail to seek shelter in time."

Upon hearing this, Yuan could not help but feel that something about the entire situation was suspicious. He wondered whether the children were being lied to or brainwashed. However, that still did not explain why there were so many adults inside the shelter.
"Then how long do we have to stay down here?" Yuan then asked.
"It depends. Some days we won't be able to return to the surface for weeks, while there are days when we can leave after just a few hours," replied one of the girls.
"Then what do you all do down here?"
"The same thing we do on the surface."
"And what is that?
"School. Play. Everything."
"What is this world's population like? Is everyone here?" Yuan asked as he looked around.
At a glance, he could easily count more than a hundred thousand people, with hundreds more appearing every passing second.
"I don't know how many people are in this world, but not everyone goes to the same place."
"There are many shelters out there, one for each sector. And we're currently in Shelter 11."
"In that case, how many Sectors are on Earth?"
"There are ninety-nine Minor Sectors, nine Major Sectors, and one Core Sector."
"What are the differences between seach sectors? Wealth? Fame? Influence?" Yuan inquired.
"I'm not too sure... What about you guys?"
"I don't know, either."
"Anyway, I have to return home now. It was nice meeting you, weird Mister!"
"Me, too! Let's chat again next time!"
One by one, the children scattered in different directions, quickly disappearing into the crowd.
Although Yuan still had many questions, he felt that he would not learn much more from them.
'Should I speak to another adult, or...?'
Yuan surveyed his surroundings with a thoughtful expression.
Eventually, he decided to take a brief tour of the area to better understand his new environment before approaching another resident.

chapters.title: Chapter 2543 Arrested
paragraphs: As Yuan quietly walked down the crowded underground streets, his distinctive appearance drew the attention of nearly everyone he passed.

While everyone present wore tight bodysuits that resembled futuristic spacesuits, Yuan wore loose robes from the Nine Heavens. However, it wasn't his unique appearance alone that made him stand out, as his low cultivation at the 3rd level of God Ascension left many people speechless.
After all, even children at the age of 10 were Cultivation Gods in their world. Yet, an adult like Yuan was below that.
Yuan ignored the stares and examined the buildings' structures.
'As I thought, they resemble those from Earth, but they are far more advanced... Could this place somehow be Earth's future?' Yuan wondered inwardly.

As absurd as the thought sounded, it made sense to him. After all, it would explain why the cultivators here possessed strength that far surpassed even those of the Demonic Realm—a world already far ahead of the Nine Heavens in the passage of time.
Moreover, he had already visited a world that was essentially the ancient Nine Heavens, so it would not be strange if, this time, he had arrived in the distant future instead.
'So this is what Earth would look like in the future, huh?' Yuan's intrigue surged after reaching this conclusion.

However, he still couldn't understand why he was brought to this world in the first place, as he'd expected something else entirely after fully translating the technique given to him by the 'Eternal' that was sealed the last time he visited the cavern.
'And this whole situation... what could they possibly be hiding from?'
If experts who stood far above the Absolute God Realm were frightened enough to hide underground, Yuan could not help but feel nervous about the kind of monsters they were hiding from.
As Yuan walked through the underground shelter, he began to understand what the children meant when they said that life below was no different from life on the surface.
There were restaurants, schools, and even parks in this shelter, making life underground the same as on the surface.
Moreover, the people present all acted as if it were normal, indicating they were used to such a lifestyle.
"Hey, you with the weird appearance!" A voice suddenly resounded loudly.
Even without looking, Yuan knew this person was calling out to him, so he stopped and turned around to face them.
Yuan's eyes widened with shock and disbelief when he saw the face of this individual.
"Meixiu?!" Yuan exclaimed when he saw the face of the individual who had called out to him.
At first, he thought she merely resembled Meixiu. However, even that would have been an understatement, as this woman looked exactly like her.
This woman, who resembled Meixiu, wore a black-and-white suit with a golden badge on her chest.
"What nonsense are you babbling about? I am Officer Mei." The woman responded as she approached Yuan.
She looked at him from head to toe before questioning with a frown on her face, "Where is your battlesuit?
"Uh... I lost it?" Yuan made a random excuse.
"Are you serious? You know it's against the law to walk around outside without your suit, right? A misdemeanor, to be exact. Let me see your ID," said Officer Mei, gesturing for his identification.
Yuan pretended to look around his robes before responding, "Oh, right. I lost it along with my suit."
"What?! How can you lose something like that?!"
Yuan shrugged.
Officer Mei rubbed her eyes and sighed. "In that case, you are under arrest."
Before Yuan could respond, Officer Mei flicked her arm, sending a streak of golden light toward him.
The moment it touched Yuan, the golden light coiled around his body like ropes, binding him in place.
Yuan stared at the bindings with a raised eyebrow. The next instant, he felt every ounce of strength drain from his body.
Thud.
Deprived of his strength, Yuan collapsed beneath the immense gravity of this world. Even at full power, he had struggled merely to move around.

"This is why you wear your battlesuit outside," she remarked. "That being said, I'm actually impressed that you're walking around without your suit, since it helps resist the immense energy of this world."
Then Officer Mei grabbed the bind on Yuan with her hand, lifted him, and carried him away, treating him like luggage.
"Where are you bringing me?" Yuan inquired calmly despite his situation.
"Where else? The station, so I can identify and charge you."
Yuan fell silent after that and allowed her to take him away.
Some time later, they arrived at the station.
"Oh? Who is this weirdo you brought back, Officer Mei?"
The moment they entered the station, the others inside turned to stare at Yuan with curious expressions.
"Some idiot walking around without his suit or identification," she calmly replied.
"Hahaha!"
The entire room burst with laughter.
"Anyway, I'm going to run his prints so I can charge him properly."
"The room's free, so go ahead."
Officer Mei nodded and carried Yuan into another room.
"I'm going to loosen your restraints to retrieve some of your blood now," Officer Mei remarked as she seated Yuan on a seat with a machine right next to it.
"Don't do anything stupid," she then warned.
Yuan silently nodded.
After removing his restraints, Officer Mei grabbed his hand and fed it into the machine.
Yuan could immediately feel something prick his finger before drawing his blood.
"Why are you staring at me so intently?" Officer Mei questioned.
"You resemble someone that I know," he said.
"Meixiu?" she asked.
Yuan nodded.
"Is that so?" she muttered indifferently before turning toward the machine that had begun to beep.
"Huh?" Officer Mei's expression turned puzzled when she saw the results.
"What's going on? Inconclusive? How's that possible?"
She fell silent, then, after a moment's thought, said, "I am going to take the test again due to an unexpected error."
"Do as you please, but it probably won't work," Yuan remarked.
"What do you mean?" she asked, her eyebrows raised in a puzzled manner.

sentences.text: As Yuan quietly walked down the crowded underground streets, his distinctive appearance drew the attention of nearly everyone he passed.
While everyone present wore tight bodysuits that resembled futuristic spacesuits, Yuan wore loose robes from the Nine Heavens.
However, it wasn't his unique appearance alone that made him stand out, as his low cultivation at the 3rd level of God Ascension left many people speechless.
After all, even children at the age of 10 were Cultivation Gods in their world.
Yet, an adult like Yuan was below that.
Yuan ignored the stares and examined the buildings' structures.
'As I thought, they resemble those from Earth, but they are far more advanced...
Could this place somehow be Earth's future?' Yuan wondered inwardly.
As absurd as the thought sounded, it made sense to him.
After all, it would explain why the cultivators here possessed strength that far surpassed even those of the Demonic Realm—a world already far ahead of the Nine Heavens in the passage of time.
Moreover, he had already visited a world that was essentially the ancient Nine Heavens, so it would not be strange if, this time, he had arrived in the distant future instead.
'So this is what Earth would look like in the future, huh?' Yuan's intrigue surged after reaching this conclusion.

However, he still couldn't understand why he was brought to this world in the first place, as he'd expected something else entirely after fully translating the technique given to him by the 'Eternal' that was sealed the last time he visited the cavern.
'And this whole situation... what could they possibly be hiding from?'
If experts who stood far above the Absolute God Realm were frightened enough to hide underground, Yuan could not help but feel nervous about the kind of monsters they were hiding from.
As Yuan walked through the underground shelter, he began to understand what the children meant when they said that life below was no different from life on the surface.
There were restaurants, schools, and even parks in this shelter, making life underground the same as on the surface.
Moreover, the people present all acted as if it were normal, indicating they were used to such a lifestyle.
"Hey, you with the weird appearance!" A voice suddenly resounded loudly.
Even without looking, Yuan knew this person was calling out to him, so he stopped and turned around to face them.
Yuan's eyes widened with shock and disbelief when he saw the face of this individual.
"Meixiu?!" Yuan exclaimed when he saw the face of the individual who had called out to him.
At first, he thought she merely resembled Meixiu.
However, even that would have been an understatement, as this woman looked exactly like her.
This woman, who resembled Meixiu, wore a black-and-white suit with a golden badge on her chest.
"What nonsense are you babbling about?
I am Officer Mei." The woman responded as she approached Yuan.
She looked at him from head to toe before questioning with a frown on her face, "Where is your battlesuit?
I lost it?" Yuan made a random excuse.
"Are you serious?
You know it's against the law to walk around outside without your suit, right?
A misdemeanor, to be exact.
Let me see your ID," said Officer Mei, gesturing for his identification.
Yuan pretended to look around his robes before responding, "Oh, right.
I lost it along with my suit."
"What?!
How can you lose something like that?!"
Yuan shrugged.
Officer Mei rubbed her eyes and sighed.
"In that case, you are under arrest."
Before Yuan could respond, Officer Mei flicked her arm, sending a streak of golden light toward him.
The moment it touched Yuan, the golden light coiled around his body like ropes, binding him in place.
Yuan stared at the bindings with a raised eyebrow.
The next instant, he felt every ounce of strength drain from his body.
Thud.
Deprived of his strength, Yuan collapsed beneath the immense gravity of this world.
Even at full power, he had struggled merely to move around.
"This is why you wear your battlesuit outside," she remarked.
"That being said, I'm actually impressed that you're walking around without your suit, since it helps resist the immense energy of this world."
Then Officer Mei grabbed the bind on Yuan with her hand, lifted him, and carried him away, treating him like luggage.
"Where are you bringing me?" Yuan inquired calmly despite his situation.
"Where else?
The station, so I can identify and charge you."
Yuan fell silent after that and allowed her to take him away.
Some time later, they arrived at the station.
"Oh?
Who is this weirdo you brought back, Officer Mei?"
The moment they entered the station, the others inside turned to stare at Yuan with curious expressions.
"Some idiot walking around without his suit or identification," she calmly replied.
"Hahaha!"
The entire room burst with laughter.
"Anyway, I'm going to run his prints so I can charge him properly."
"The room's free, so go ahead."
Officer Mei nodded and carried Yuan into another room.
"I'm going to loosen your restraints to retrieve some of your blood now," Officer Mei remarked as she seated Yuan on a seat with a machine right next to it.
"Don't do anything stupid," she then warned.
Yuan silently nodded.
After removing his restraints, Officer Mei grabbed his hand and fed it into the machine.
Yuan could immediately feel something prick his finger before drawing his blood.
"Why are you staring at me so intently?" Officer Mei questioned.
"You resemble someone that I know," he said.
"Meixiu?" she asked.
Yuan nodded.
"Is that so?" she muttered indifferently before turning toward the machine that had begun to beep.
"Huh?" Officer Mei's expression turned puzzled when she saw the results.
"What's going on?
Inconclusive?
How's that possible?"
She fell silent, then, after a moment's thought, said, "I am going to take the test again due to an unexpected error."
"Do as you please, but it probably won't work," Yuan remarked.
"What do you mean?" she asked, her eyebrows raised in a puzzled manner.

chapters.title: Chapter 2544 Registration
paragraphs: "Because no matter how many times you test my blood, it won't work, since I am not from this world," Yuan calmly revealed to Officer Mei, without a care for the consequences.
Of course, Officer Mei did not believe a word he'd just said and thought that he was just spewing nonsense.
The next moment, she tested his blood again, completely ignoring his nonsense.
Yuan didn't say anything and silently waited for the results.
"Di! Di! Di!"
Officer Mei turned to look at the result and made a puzzled face upon seeing it.
"Inconclusive, again?"

Officer Mei could not comprehend what was causing the error. She had worked as an officer for over a decade and examined tens of thousands of people, yet she had never encountered an error like this before.
"I told you. I'm not from this world, so the system won't recognize me, no matter how many times you try," Yuan repeated calmly.
Officer Mei frowned and said, "Enough with the nonsense. Do you really expect me to believe that? Just because you're wearing some weird outfit doesn't mean you're from another world!"
Yuan shrugged.
"Then be my guest and keep trying."
Officer Mei did just that, stubbornly testing his blood several more times. However, after failing for the tenth time, she restrained him again before leaving the room without a word.
"What? That weirdo you just brought in isn't recognized by the database? How's that possible?"
When the other officers learned of the situation, none of them could believe it.
"Are you sure you did it properly?" One of them asked.
Officer Mei frowned and said, "Do you think this is my first time operating the machine or what? Either something is wrong, or that man isn't in the database!"
"That is outrageous. Everyone is registered in the database at birth."

"Some people may be unregistered if they were born in secrecy, but anyone absent from the database is considered nonexistent and would not be able to live a normal life, so they don't stay unregistered for long."
"That man looked to be an adult. Personally, I have never heard or met anyone who remained unregistered past their teenage years before."
"There is always a first for everything," said another officer.
"What should we do about him?" Officer Mei then asked, not even bothering to bring up Yuan's claim of being from another world since she felt it would make her sound foolish.
"Learn how he managed to survive so long without an identification, and then register him.
Officer Mei nodded before returning to the room.

"So, how did you make it to adulthood without an identification? Since you can't live an ordinary life without being registered, someone must have helped you, which is a felony. If you tell me now, I'll put in a good word for you, which might reduce your sentence."
Yuan raised an eyebrow and asked, "Why does everyone need to be registered?"
"Why are you asking me? I don't make the rules around here. I just follow and enforce them."
"...Well, I already explained why I don't—"
"I swear, if you say that you are from another world one more time..." Officer Mei interrupted Yuan while rubbing her eyes in an irritated manner.
Yuan shrugged, "Then I don't know what else to say."
"You little..."
"Fine. Don't tell me if you don't want me. I'm going to register you in our database now, whether you like it or not."
She grabbed him by the restraints and carried him into another room, treating him like luggage once again.
Yuan found his situation quite humorous and decided to see how things played out.
A few minutes later, inside another room, Officer Mei placed Yuan into a capsule-shaped machine and strapped him inside before closing the lid.
The next moment, Officer Mei pressed a green button on the machine, activating it. Almost immediately, liquid began to fill the capsule's interior, quickly submerging Yuan completely.
Despite being submerged in an unknown substance, Yuan did not panic and patiently held his breath.
One minute... two minutes... three minutes later...

Officer Mei tapped on the small window on the capsule and spoke loudly, "Stop holding your breath and breath it in! It won't kill you! And since it's part of the process, this won't end until you do!"
Hearing this, Yuan stopped holding his breath and started breathing, as weird and awkward as it felt.
'Oh? I can breathe in this liquid?'
As he started breathing normally, the liquid quickly filled his internal organs. Yet it was not painful, and it even felt a little comfortable.
"Di! Di! Di!"
The machine started beeping.
"What is it this time?" Officer Mei's eyebrows furrowed into a deep frown as she checked the notification on the machine.
"What the heck is going on...?" she muttered in a dumbfounded voice as her eyes slowly widened with surprise.
[Warning!]
[Individual is already registered to a system]
[If you proceed with the process, it will override their existing system]
"He's already registered in the database? That's impossible! If that were the case, why was the machine unable to identify him before?" Officer Mei exclaimed in bewilderment.
She turned to look at Yuan's handsome face through the window and wondered inwardly, 'What if it's true that he's from another world?'
However, that thought only lingered in her mind for a few seconds before she quickly shook it away.
'I must be going crazy to even believe his nonsense for a second.'
She looked at the screen again.
[Proceed with the override?]
[Yes][Cancel]
Without another thought, she pressed 'Yes'.
[Checking identification]
[Identity has been verified as 'Officer Mei']
[Checking authorization]
[Authorization has been accepted]
[Override has been authorized by 'Officer Mei']
[Override has begun]
Meanwhile, Yuan was enjoying the warmth in his body when a familiar noise suddenly snapped him out of his daze.
<Shura's System Has Detected An Anomaly>
<System's Defense Activated>
<System's Defense Failed>
<Shura's System Is Being Overridden>
<Shura's System Has Been Overridden>
<Shura's System Has Been Deleted>
<Gaia's System Has Been Activated>

chapters.title: Chapter 2545 Gaia’s System
paragraphs: 'Shura's System was replaced?!' Yuan cried inwardly after he saw the notifications.
'Gaia's System... Does this world belong to Gaia?'
Yuan immediately assumed this Gaia to be an Eternal since their name sounded like one, and the previous two systems he had used were also created by Eternals.
'Damn it... What now?' Yuan pondered with a solemn look on his face.
He could never have anticipated Shura's System being replaced in such a manner.
'I haven't even been able to contact Shura once since my reincarnation, and now my only clue to finding him is gone...' he sighed inwardly.
'This Gaia... to be able to override Shura's System, they must be much stronger than him.'
Ding!
Suddenly, another notification popped up.
<Gaia's System has sensed an anomaly in the user>
<Starting Examination>
<Anomaly Identified>
<Searching For Treatment>
<Treatment Found>
<Utilizing Level 9 Treatment>
<Error>
<User lacks the credentials for the level of treatment>
<Treatment will be postponed>
Yuan was left speechless by the notifications, struggling to comprehend what had just happened.
'An anomaly within me? Does it have something to do with the curses that are still affecting me? Or is it something else?'
Before he could give it any thought, more notifications popped up.
<Gaia's System has sensed an anomaly in the user>
<Searching For Treatment>
<Treatment Found>
<Utilizing Level 1 Treatment>
<Treatment Completed>
<A curse has been removed from the user>
<Gaia's System has sensed an anomaly in the user>
<Searching For Treatment>
<Treatment Found>
<Utilizing Level 2 Treatment>
<Error>
<User lacks the credentials for the level of treatment>
<Treatment will be postponed>
'It cured one of my curses!' Yuan cried inwardly.
Although it had been confusing at first, he was beginning to understand Gaia's System.

Based on everything that had happened so far, he could infer that Gaia's System possessed a healing function capable of curing afflictions harmful to its user. However, receiving treatment required a certain level of credentials.
As for how he could increase those credentials, that remained unknown for the time being.

He had also learned that something potentially harmful was hidden within his body—something that required an exceptionally high level of credentials to treat. Yet, he had remained completely unaware of its existence until now, only aware of the curses.
'Just how terrifying is this anomaly if treating it requires credentials several levels higher than those needed for my curses?' Yuan swallowed nervously.

His curses were already so powerful that he had struggled to remove them even with the Sacred Chalice of Purification. Yet Gaia's System had erased one of them in the blink of an eye, and without requiring him to do anything at all.
'This Gaia's System is so much more powerful and capable than the last two I had... Or should I say it's more... complete?'
Yuan's interest in this world and this Eternal named Gaia skyrocketed.
Suddenly, the liquid in the capsule began to drain, and the door opened shortly afterward.
Officer Mei grabbed his restraint and pulled him out of the capsule.
"Your registration is done," she said with an odd look on her face.
"Thanks, I guess..."
"What is it?" Yuan asked when Officer Mei remained silent, quietly staring at him.
"Nothing," she quickly said.
In truth, she wanted to question him about his existing system, but she decided against it since she had a feeling he would only waste her time with nonsensical answers.
"What now?" Yuan then asked. "Am I free to go?"
"Are you serious?" Officer Mei frowned before sneering, "You're still on the hook for breaking the law. Not only were you outside without a suit, but you weren't even regis—"
Officer Mei halted herself mid-sentence when she recalled that she had to override his system, so he technically had one.
"So what? Are you going to throw me in jail?"
"Perhaps. It's not too late to tell me the truth."
"I have not lied to you," Yuan sighed while shaking his head.
Officer Mei could tell that Yuan was being genuine by his tone and crystal-clear eyes, but his explanation was just too outrageous.
"If you're really from another world, where did you come from?"
"A place called the Nine Heavens."
"Nine Heavens? What a weird name," she remarked. "Then where is it? And how did you come to our world?"
"I can't answer your first question since I don't know. As for how I got here... I also don't know. I walked through a door, and before I knew it, I was here."
An incredulous expression appeared on Officer Mei's face as she listened to this nonsense.
"If you remove my restraints, I can prove it to you," Yuan then said.

After a bit of hesitation, Officer Mei removed his restraints. Since Yuan's aura was so weak, she wasn't worried that he might try something and was fully confident that she could take him down at any point.
"Here, look at—"
Yuan's eyes widened when he noticed that the Spatial Rings on his fingers had vanished.
"Huh? Where did they go?"
He immediately began patting down his body.
'No way! Did I drop them somewhere?' he cried inwardly.
Then, he recalled the moment he first arrived in this world.
'No... They were already gone by the time I came here! Does this mean that only my soul has traveled to this world, and my true body is still in the Nine Heavens?' he quickly came to this conclusion.
'"I must admit..." Officer Mei suddenly spoke.

"I have arrested many people in my decade-long career, and your acting is on an entirely different level—one of the best I have seen. Unfortunately, you're also one of the worst liars. Though, this works to my benefit since I would have been fooled by you if your deception was even half as good as your acting."
Yuan stared at her with raised eyebrows, wondering if there was anything he could say to convince this woman, who was a splitting image of Meixiu, that he wasn't messing with her.

chapters.title: Chapter 2546 Perfected Heavenly Refinement
paragraphs: "Enough of your farce. Follow me. I am going to check your identity again," Officer Mei said to Yuan before bringing him back to the previous room to collect his blood with the machine again.
This time, there was no error, and Officer Mei could finally see Yuan's identity.
[Name: Yuan]
[Cultivation: Third Level First Ascension]
[Physique: Perfected Heavenly Refinement]
[Credential Rank: 1]
Officer Mei's eyes widened with shock after seeing Yuan's information on the machine.
She rubbed her eyes a moment before looking again, as if hoping to see something different, but everything remained the same.
Although Yuan's age being unknown was puzzling and his low cultivation was baffling, they were nothing compared to his physique.
"Perfected Heavenly Refinement?! Impossible!" she cried out loud.
"What?" Yuan raised an eyebrow at this new term.
Officer Mei turned to look at Yuan's puzzled face and swallowed nervously.
"H-How did you achieve Perfected Heavenly Refinement?" she asked him.
"What is that?" Yuan asked, still with an eyebrow raised.
"Stop messing with me already!" she shouted in anger.
Yuan frowned. "I really am not. I have no idea what this Perfected Heavenly Refinement is."
"It is your physique!"
"Uh... Even if you ask me that, how am I supposed to explain it? And even if I could explain it, what would be the point when you do not possess the physique?"
"What nonsense are you spewing? Of course, I have the same physique," Officer Mei responded with a frown on her face.
"What?" Yuan wore a dumbfounded look after hearing her expected words.
"You... also have the Heaven Refining Physique? I thought only one person could possess it at any given moment?"

Officer Mei shook her head and sighed, "There must really be something wrong with you. Acting like you're the only one in this world with that physique when everyone in this world possesses the Heavenly Refinement physique."
"Everyone?!" Yuan exclaimed in disbelief. "I don't believe you. How can everyone possess such a powerful physique?"
Officer Mei shrugged, "Whether you believe it or not won't change reality. Whatever. Don't tell me if you don't want to."
Yuan fell silent.
'Everyone in this world possesses the Heaven Refining Physique...? What the hell is going on?'
Suddenly—
<Lockdown has ended>
<You may return to the surface>
"It ended quite swiftly this time..." Officer Mei mumbled after seeing the same notification.
Yuan looked at her and asked, "You can also see the notifications?"
He already had a feeling that would be the case, but needed confirmation.
"Isn't it obvious? Everyone registered in the database has access to Gaia's System."
Yuan then asked, "Who is Gaia? Are they the Eternal who created this world?"
"Huh? What nonsense are you spewing now? Eternal? What is that?"
'Gaia isn't an Eternal? Or maybe they're not aware of their existence...'
"Never mind..." Yuan shook his head before asking, "So, what now?"
Officer Mei narrowed her eyes at him.

A moment later, she spoke, "Since the lockdown has ended, everyone will be returning to the surface soon. As for you... Although it's a crime not to register in the database, there's clearly something wrong with you... mentally. Therefore, instead of putting you in jail, I'll recommend you for psychiatric care. Consider yourself lucky."
"Psychiatric care...?" Yuan's jaw dropped, as he could never have imagined being put in such a position.
<Officer Mei has recommended you for Psychiatric Care>
<You must visit a Psychiatrist within 14 days or face penalties>
"Done. You may leave now.
"Just like that? But I still have some questions for you," Yuan said.
"If you have any questions, ask your psychiatrist. If you linger around any longer, I'll throw you in jail."
With no other choice, Yuan left the room. By the time he stepped outside the station, the once-crowded streets had become completely empty, and the underground city suddenly looked like a ghost town.
"How do I return to the surface?" Yuan mumbled.
Ding.
<Return to the surface now?>
When Yuan saw the notification, he wondered if the system would teleport him back to the surface.
He tapped on 'Yes'.
<Initializing Teleportation>
<Teleporting in 3...2...1>
Yuan's vision blurred for an instant, and before he realized, he was back inside the building he had entered with the children before arriving at the underground shelter.
"...What now?"
He still had many questions, especially about Gaia's System.
However, he didn't know where to start.
Then, he looked at a certain notification that wouldn't disappear.
<Visit a Psychiatrist>
<Time Limit: 13 days, 23 hours, 55 minutes, 27 seconds>
"It's almost like a quest... Do I really have to visit one?" he sighed out loud, wondering what sort of penalties he'd face if he disobeyed it.
"System, where can I find a Psychiatrist?" he then asked, hoping the system could hear and answer him.
<Locating nearest Psychiatrist>
<Found Psychiatrist>
<Begin Direction Assistance?>
"Wow, this thing is pretty convenient..." Yuan stared at the notifications with awe.
"Begin."
The next moment, a neon-green line appeared on the ground before him, presumably guiding him toward his destination.
When he looked closely, it even showed him the distance and time required to reach it.
Thus, Yuan started following the system's directions.
As he started following the neon-green light, Yuan realized that the gravity in this world was no longer affecting him as much.
"This world really resembles the Earth I know, except being countless times more advanced..."
After reaching the end of the street and arriving at an intersection, a bright red 'Stop' notification appeared before him.
Then, figures began soaring past Yuan along the road.
However, they were not riding ordinary vehicles. Instead, they stood atop what appeared to be hoverboards, surfing through the sky at incredible speeds.
"Mother, why is that person's aura so weak? Isn't he an adult? Is there something wrong with him?"
A nearby child suddenly spoke aloud, prompting Yuan to turn instinctively toward the voice, where he saw a little boy pointing directly at him.
"It's rude to point!"
The boy's mother quickly pressed his arm down before turning to face Yuan with an apologetic smile.
'Even a little kid like that is a Cultivation God...' Yuan sighed inwardly.
Suddenly, he realized that he had not checked his status yet.
"Show status."
[Name: Yuan]
[Credential Rank: 1]
'Third Level First Ascension?' Yuan raised an eyebrow at his cultivation.
'Is that what God Ascension is called in this world?'
Then he saw his physique, and sure enough, it was called Perfected Heavenly Refinement.
'Credential Rank... this must be what I need to raise in order to cure my other curses... but how do I raise it?'
Ding!
<In order to raise your Credential Rank, you must contribute to society>
'Contribute to society...?'
"Hm?"
Before Yuan realized it, he had reached what appeared to be a dead end.
A tall wall stood before him, with a single entrance guarded by several people. Above the entrance, the number '10' was marked.
"How do I get past?" Yuan asked one of the guards.
The guard pointed to the machine standing nearby and said, "We will need to check your credentials."
Yuan approached the machine, which resembled the one inside the station that examined his identity, and placed his hand into the slot.
A moment later, he felt a drop of his blood being collected.
Di.
A green light appeared on the machine.
"You may pass," said the guard as he opened the door.
Yuan didn't question it and passed through the door.
<You have entered Sector 10>
Yuan continued following the green line on the ground, and after another half an hour of walking, he reached a large building that was clearly a hospital.
After staring at it for a long moment, Yuan reluctantly entered the building and approached the front desk.
"I was recommended to see a psychiatrist," he said to the woman behind the desk.
Without a word, the woman pointed to the small machine on top of the desk.
Sure enough, it was another one of those identity-reading machines.
'Do I really have to give my blood every time I need to do something in this world?' he sighed inwardly as he placed his hand into the slot, feeding it a drop of his blood.
"Take a seat. We'll call you when it's your turn," said the woman.
Yuan went to the waiting area and waited for his turn. In the meantime, he continued testing the system's capabilities.
"System, tell me about this world."
<This world is called Earth>
"Anything else?"
<User lacks the credentials>
'So even information requires credentials, huh?'
"Can you tell me about the reason we have to hide in the underground shelter?"
<User lacks the credentials>
Right as Yuan was about to ask another question—
Ding!
<Your meeting with a psychiatrist has been approved. Head to Room 221 as soon as possible>
"Already?"
Even though he had just sat down, Yuan didn't complain and immediately made his way to room 221.
Upon arriving at his destination, Yuan knocked on the closed door.
"You can enter."
A female voice quickly responded.
When Yuan opened the door and stepped into the room, he was met by another familiar face.
"Wang Xiuying?" he muttered with a dazed expression.
"Hm?" The woman who resembled Wang Xiuying raised an eyebrow at him but didn't respond.
A moment later, she gestured at the chair before her and said, "Please, take a seat."

Once he was seated, the woman said, "I am your psychiatrist, Doctor Ying. According to your referrer, Officer Mei, you believe that you are from another world. Can you tell me why you believe you are from another world?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2547 Psychiatrist
paragraphs: "I am your psychiatrist, Doctor Ying. According to your referrer, Officer Mei, you believe that you are from another world. Can you tell me why you believe you are from another world?" Doctor Ying questioned Yuan with a calm expression on her face.
"Is there really a point in this? It's not like you'll believe me..." Yuan sighed aloud.

"If you don't want to talk, then there's nothing I can do. I won't force you, either. However, until you do, your recommendation won't go away, and you will be punished after the time limit," said Doctor Ying.
"Out of curiosity, what is the punishment?" Yuan inquired.
"You'll either go to jail or be forced to enlist in the military," she calmly replied.
Yuan fell silent. As absurd as his situation was, there was nothing he could do but go with the flow for now.
After all, he had no idea where he was—or when he would be able to return to the Nine Heavens.

'All of this is so ridiculous that it feels like I am dreaming, but it also feels too realistic to be one. Am I trapped inside an illusion? One so powerful that I cannot tell what's real or fake?' Yuan wondered inwardly.
If he were truly in an illusion, his best solution was to hope for Shiva to wake him up.
"Are you ready to talk, or would you like to reschedule your appointment?" Doctor Ying asked after Yuan remained silent for an entire minute.
Yuan sighed before responding, "I will speak."
"Good. Then, to start, tell me about the world you came from," she said, hoping to gauge the extent of his condition.

"I came from a place called the Nine Heavens. It is a world that was once whole but was divided into nine separate realms after a certain incident," Yuan began, explaining the origins of the Nine Heavens.
"However, I was born on Earth, one that is different from this one, which is also part of the Nine Heavens..."
"Can you tell me more about the Nine Heavens—particularly this other 'Earth'?" Doctor Ying asked. "For example, what was life like there? How is it different from this world?"
After taking a deep breath, Yuan explained everything in detail to her.
Doctor Ying remained relatively calm at first, but the more she listened to Yuan, the more she realized just how serious his condition was.

'His level of imagination is off the charts!' she cried inwardly. 'I have spoken with many patients before, but none of them are as delusional as this one! I'm surprised that he even made it to adulthood!'
Once she was satisfied, Doctor Ying said, "Alright, I have a good idea of your condition."
She retrieved a machine from the back and said, "I am going to check for any abnormal status now."
Yuan raised an eyebrow, wondering if she believed that his 'illness' could be cured through the system.
"Step inside," she said, beckoning him to enter the capsule-shaped machine.
Although it resembled the one that gave him Gaia's System at first, it had a slightly different shape and a completely different color.
Without a word, Yuan entered the capsule and waited for Doctor Ying to do her thing.
She closed the door on him and started the machine shortly after without any explanation.
Soon, an unknown liquid began to fill the interior, submerging Yuan in seconds.
Yuan didn't bother holding his breath this time and breathed normally.
Meanwhile, Doctor Ying examined the results.
[Name: Yuan]
[Cultivation: Third Level First Ascension]
[Physique: Perfected Heavenly Refinement]
[Credential Rank: 1]
"Perfected Heavenly Refinement?!" Doctor Ying exclaimed after seeing his status.

Although everyone in this world possessed the Heavenly Refinement physique, it existed in several ranks. To Doctor Ying's knowledge, Perfected Heavenly Refinement was the highest attainable rank—and one that is only theoretically possible.
This meant that nobody has ever achieved Perfected Heavenly Refinement... at least until now.
"N-No way... There must be something wrong with the machine... How can someone with such a low cultivation achieve the legendary Perfected Heavenly Refinement?"
Then, she looked down a little more, examining Yuan's hidden status that can only be seen by those with enough credentials.
[Anomalies: Level 2 Curse, Level 3 Curse, Level 4 Curse, Level 5 Curse, Level 6 Curse, Level 7 Curse, Level 8 Curse, Level 9 Curse, ???, ???, ???]
Doctor Ying's eyes widened at the anomalies within Yuan, her jaw nearly touching the floor in shock.

"What the heck is up with him?! How can a single person have so many anomalies?! There are even some that I do not have the credentials to see!" she cried out loud, looking like she was witnessing a ghost.

As a doctor and a psychiatrist, Doctor Ying's Credential Rank was naturally higher than that of the average person. Yet, even with her Rank 5 Credentials, she was unable to access all of Yuan's information.
'This guy... how is he even still alive?!'
More importantly, she did not see the anomaly that would normally appear in mentally unstable individuals, as Gaia's System was capable of detecting such conditions as well.

'Does this mean he is not insane? Is he actually telling the truth? No... This only proves that he is not mentally unstable. It tells me nothing about whether he is lying or telling the truth...' Doctor Ying pondered with a serious expression.
She looked into the machine and saw Yuan calmly staring back with a smile.
'Just who is this man...?'

Some time later, Doctor Ying let Yuan out of the machine and said to him, "I have confirmed that you are not mentally unstable, but that doesn't mean you're not an attention seeker lying to seek attention."
"So, what now?" Yuan asked.

"Do whatever you want, but if you continue telling people you came from another world, you can expect things to get ugly really fast. Hell, you're extremely lucky to have encountered Officer Mei and not someone else."
Yuan raised an eyebrow and asked, "Do you know her? Officer Mei?"
Doctor Ying nodded and said, "We're childhood friends."

chapters.title: Chapter 2548 Credential Rank
paragraphs: "What a coincidence..." Yuan muttered aloud.
"Anyway, do you mind if I ask you a few questions regarding Gaia's System? Believe it or not, but I just registered, and I have no clue how it functions."
"...What kind of questions?"
"For starters, how do I increase my Credential Rank?"
"You contribute to society, and pretty much everyone can achieve Rank 3 just by living an ordinary life. However, if you do something bad or get arrested, your credentials will drop."
"I am trying to reach Rank 9. How long do you think it would take?" Yuan then asked.
"Credential Rank 9?" Doctor Ying stared at him with a dumbfounded face.
'Is he really fine in the head...?' she couldn't help but wonder inwardly.

Doctor Ying shook her head and said, "Forget about Rank 9. Most people cannot even reach Rank 5. As I told you earlier, an ordinary person can attain Rank 3 simply by living a normal life and staying out of trouble. However, to reach Rank 4 or Rank 5, you would need a high-credential profession, such as becoming a police officer or a doctor."

She continued, "If you wish to rise beyond Rank 5, you will need to join the military, enter the special forces, or become a politician. That said, most people who reach Rank 6 or higher are born into privileged circumstances."
"Is that really the only way? Join the military?"

"Don't tell me you're really thinking about it? Forget about it. With your low cultivation and lack of talents—" Doctor Ying suddenly stopped mid-sentence when she recalled that he somehow had the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique.
"Hey, let me ask you a question of my own first. How did you acquire the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique?"
"Officer Mei asked me the same thing. Why do you want to know? Is it something impressive?" Yuan asked.

Considering that even children in this world were Cultivation Gods, Yuan would not have been surprised if his physique was nothing special—especially after being told that everyone possessed the same physique.
However, seeing that both Officer Mei and Doctor Ying were interested in his physique, he began to think it might be special even by this world's standards.
"Are you asking me that because you seriously have no idea?" Doctor Ying narrowed her eyes at him, looking doubtful.
"I'm getting tired of repeating myself," Yuan sighed while shaking his head.
After a moment of silence, Doctor Ying spoke. "Perfected Heavenly Refinement is the highest attainable rank. As far as I am aware, nobody other than you has ever achieved it."
"How many ranks are there?" Yuan then asked.

"Eight. The Heavenly Refinement physique can be refined a total of eight times. However, Perfected Heavenly Refinement is not included among those eight ranks. If we count it, then it would be the ninth rank."
'Nine times, huh? I don't recall evolving my physique that many times... Did I skip a few steps? Or are our physiques completely different, and this is merely a misunderstanding?'
"How do you guys train your physiques?" he asked a moment later.
"Whatever we're doing, it's clearly not as efficient as your methods, to reach the ninth rank with that level of cultivation..." Doctor Ying sighed.
"So, are you going to tell me or not? I won't blame you if you don't want to."

"Why am I not surprised?" Doctor Ying shrugged. "Anyway, we're done here, so please leave. I still have patients to see after you."
"Alright..."

'What should I do now? It's been a long time since I've felt this lost...' he sighed inwardly.

"This situation feels like I am inside the Stairway to Heaven, undergoing one of its trials—"
Yuan's eyes suddenly widened as a thought flashed through his mind.
"Wait a second..."
Then, he recalled a certain line from the technique he'd acquired from the mysterious being sealed within the cavern.
"I think I know what to do now..." he mumbled.

"I have no idea what you're talking about," she shrugged.

"What do you want from me?" he then asked.
"The truth," she calmly replied.
"I already told you the truth. You just don't want to believe me."
"How can anyone sane believe your nonsense?"
Yuan sighed, "Forget it."

"Huh?" Officer Mei raised her eyebrows at his unexpected question.
"You... want to join the military? This is so random. Why?" she asked, her interest piqued.
"I want to—need to raise my Credential Rank," he answered without hesitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 2549 Officer Mei
paragraphs: "How ridiculous," Officer Mei sneered after hearing Yuan's reason for wanting to join the military.
"Do you think anyone can just join the military? Even if we ignored your laughably low cultivation, you still need at least Rank 3 Credentials to apply, as well as having no arrest record."
"No arrest record?" Yuan raised his eyebrows, and he asked, "So I can't apply because you arrested me?"
"Although I did technically arrest you, unless you went to jail or did something heinous, there won't be any records, so you're still clean for now."
"Anyway, I don't know what nonsense you have planned, but give up on joining the military. It's not a playground."
"I am not going there to play," Yuan replied with a serious expression.
Officer Mei stared into his calm, unwavering eyes with a pondering expression.
After a moment of silence, she sighed, "Wait here for me. If you run away, I'll consider it fleeing from an officer."
Without offering any explanation, Officer Mei walked away, disappearing into the hospital.
While Yuan waited for her to return, Officer Mei went to look for Doctor Ying.
"Hm? Why are you here?" Doctor Ying asked, not expecting her visit so soon.
"I wanted to talk to you about the weirdo I recommended to you," Officer Mei said.

Doctor Ying rubbed her eyes and sighed aloud, "I had a feeling you would come ask me about him since you recommended him to me, but I didn't expect you to come here almost immediately after our session ended. Did you stalk him or something?"
"What? Of course not. It's just a coincidence, and I am here for my yearly checkup."
"Is that so? Well, either way, he's protected by patient confidentiality, so I cannot tell you about our session, even if you're a police officer and my childhood friend, Mei."
"I don't care about your session with him. I just want to know your opinion on his physique," Officer Mei quickly replied.
Doctor Ying fell silent, her eyes narrowing slightly.

Seeing her reaction, Officer Mei sighed, "Judging by your reaction, I guess his physique is truly the Perfected Heavenly Refinement. I thought the machine back at the station was bugged or something, so I sent him here to confirm."

"You're really using the hospital's resources as you please, huh?" Doctor Ying shook her head. "Once news of the Perfected Heavenly Refinement being achieved spreads... I don't even want to imagine what kind of life he'll have—or not have."
"Not only does he lack power and credentials, but his origin is unknown, too..." Officer Mei remarked.
After a brief pause, she asked, "Hey, Ying, do you think he's actually from another world? I'm asking for your personal opinion.
"It's definitely quite an outlandish claim, but I couldn't detect any lies within his tone or eyes."
"Are you saying that you believe him?"
"I'm saying that he's either a highly skilled manipulator, severely delusional, or... actually telling the truth."
"I see..."
"So what are you going to do with him?"
"Nothing."
"Really? Even though you went out of your way to do all of this?"
"I merely want to satisfy my curiosity. That's all there is to it," said Officer Mei before walking for the exit.
"Let's go out for a drink later. It's been a while since we went out to have fun," Officer Mei said as she reached the door.
"If you're that bored, get a boyfriend," Doctor Ying teased with a playful smile.
Officer Mei merely shook her head in silence before leaving the room. However, instead of going back outside for Yuan, she called someone.
"System, call my mother."
<Calling 'Mother'>
<Connected>
Although the call connected, neither Officer Mei nor her mother spoke. For several long moments, the line remained completely silent.
"What is it?"
Eventually, a voice resounded, sounding somewhat surprised.
"Mother, when are you not busy? I need your assistance with something."
"Stop being vague and tell me what this is about."
"Well, it's like this..." Officer Mei began explaining the situation to her.
Some time later, Officer Mei ended the call, left the hospital, and returned to find Yuan sitting quietly on the staircase, staring up at the blue sky.
"Hey, you want to join the military, right? I can help you," Officer Mei started the conversation with some unexpected words.
"What's with the change of heart?" Yuan asked with a raised eyebrow.
"If you don't want my help, that's fine."
"I didn't say that," Yuan quickly replied.
"Stop asking pointless questions and follow me," Officer Mei said.
'Is it because she resembles Meixiu that I cannot help but trust her?' Yuan wondered inwardly as he followed her.
A few moments later, Officer Mei stopped in front of a square platform around the corner from the hospital and stepped onto it.
"What's this?" Yuan asked out of curiosity.
"You'll find out in a second. Just step on the platform," she replied.
Once Yuan stepped onto the platform beside her, Officer Mei muttered, "System, teleport us to..."
After providing an address, both Yuan and Officer Mei vanished from the platform outside the hospital.
Yuan's vision flickered, and before he realized, he found himself standing in a residential area.
'So these are teleporters, huh?'

As Yuan wondered how they functioned without a teleportation array, Officer Mei stepped off the platform and called out to him, "What are you waiting for? You'll block the teleporter if you don't leave."
"Oh."
Hearing that, Yuan quickly stepped off the platform and continued following her.
Some time later, they arrived before a large villa.
"Is this your home?" Yuan questioned.
"It is."
"You don't mind bringing a complete stranger like me home?"
"It is not like you can do anything to me," Officer Mei said with a casual shrug. "If you dare try anything, all it would take is a single flick of my finger to kill you."
"And what are we doing here? I thought you were going to help me enter the military."
"I know someone from the military, and they will be here in a bit to assess your qualifications," she explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 2550 Officer Mei(2)
paragraphs: "Now then, before that person arrives, I want to see what you are capable of. I do not want to embarrass myself by recommending you," Officer Mei said as they entered the building. "If you are nowhere near good enough, I will simply cancel the appointment and save us all some time."
"You want to spar with me?" Yuan looked at her with a slightly surprised face.
"That's what I said, no? Or is there a reason you don't want to spar with me? Are you not confident in your abilities?" Officer Mei remarked with a provocative smile.
Yuan returned the smile and said, "Alright. Let's do it."
"Come with me to the training room."
Yuan nodded and followed her into another room.
Although the villa itself was quite large, the training room was somehow several times bigger than the entire building, almost as though it existed within its own separate dimension.

"Don't worry, I will try to match your strength to make things fair," Officer Mei said as they walked to the center of the spacious room. "That being said, your cultivation is a bit too low, and I might have trouble suppressing my strength to such an extent."
"I don't mind even if you use a little more strength," Yuan calmly replied.
Officer Mei narrowed her eyes at him and asked, "Are you really going to fight in that outfit? I know it's unique, but it'll only hinder your own movements."
"I'm used to it, and I don't have a suit like yours."
"Right... because you're from another world..." she mumbled with a skeptical expression.
Yuan took a moment to stretch his body before beckoning to Officer Mei.
"Whenever you are ready," he said aloud.
In the very next instant, Officer Mei vanished from her spot like a ghost.

Although her speed caught him off guard, Yuan was still able to follow her movements. He swiftly raised his right hand beside his head, blocking Officer Mei's leg strike just as it swept toward his face a split second later.
"Oh? You actually managed to block that? I intended on ending it with one strike, too." Officer Mei remarked after distancing herself from him. "You're better than I expected.
"I could say the same for you..." Yuan responded, looking at the arm he had used to block her attack and feeling a slight numbness in it.
However, that numbness quickly faded when Yuan clenched his fist tightly.
"Let's continue."
This time, Yuan made the first move.
'He's fast!'
Officer Mei cried inwardly when she could barely follow Yuan's movements, nearly getting hit in the gut.
Yet Officer Mei did not panic, merely adjusting her strength as they continued to exchange strikes.
'This guy is growing increasingly more powerful with each passing moment!'
It quickly became clear to Officer Mei that Yuan's low cultivation was extremely deceptive, as he was displaying prowess that was beyond what someone at such a level should be capable of.
"Is something wrong?" Yuan suddenly asked as he continued his assault. "You are slowing down, Officer! Meanwhile, I am not even warmed up!"
Officer Mei gritted her teeth at his blatant provocation and began unleashing more of her strength, increasing the speed and intensity of her attacks at a more noticeable rate.
"That's more like it!" Yuan laughed excitedly, as it had been a while since he could go all out against a fellow human without worrying about his opponent being too weak.
While their fight was intense enough to shake the building, neither of them was expending any energy, as their cultivation was still suppressed.
'How is he still keeping up?! I am already using the strength of a Third Ascension cultivator!' Officer Mei cried inwardly, feeling dazed by Yuan's unfathomable strength.
'Is this the power of the Perfected Heavenly Refinement?!'
A nervous smile tugged at Officer Mei's lips as she realized just how ridiculous—and dangerous this discovery was.
"A-Alright, let's stop here." Officer Mei eventually said, halting their spar.
"Are you sure? I was barely just getting started," Yuan said with a disappointed look on his face, clearly not satisfied with how suddenly it ended.
"I just wanted to see if you would be a waste of time. If you want to show off, do so during the real assessment," she sighed.
"Speaking of the assessment... where is she? She should have arrived by now—"
Officer Mei turned toward the exit, only to abruptly freeze as her eyes widened in shock.
"Hm?"
Yuan followed her gaze and was surprised to see a beautiful woman standing quietly by the entrance, her presence almost nonexistent, like a ghost.
"M-Mother! When did you arrive?" Officer Mei spoke aloud after snapping out of her daze.
"I have been here for a while," her mother calmly replied.
"In that case, why didn't you say something?"
However, her mother did not respond. Her gaze was fixed on Yuan, just as his was fixed on her.
"Meifeng..." Yuan muttered in a low voice.
Although Yuan appeared surprised, he was not surprised in the slightest that Officer Mei—who resembled Meixiu—would have a mother who looked just like Meixiu's real mother, Meifeng.
Without a word, the woman approached Yuan with calm and purposeful steps.

"So you are the one who claims to be from another world, huh? I came here thinking that my foolish daughter was being scammed, but now that I have seen you with my own eyes, you certainly seem... for lack of a better word, otherworldly."
"I'm Yuan," he introduced himself. "Are you the one who will help me join the military?"

"Not exactly," she replied. "I am here to assess your qualifications. And, if I take everything at face value, you have already failed. Not only is your cultivation weaker than that of most children, but your credential is only at Rank 1."
"With that being said, you have displayed prowess far beyond your cultivation's capabilities, as well as possessing the Perfected Heavenly Refinement..."
The woman fell silent for a moment before continuing, "Anyway, recover your stamina for now. I am going to have a conversation with my daughter first."

"I'm Yuan," he introduced himself.
"Are you the one who will help me join the military?"
"Not exactly," she replied.
"I am here to assess your qualifications.
And, if I take everything at face value, you have already failed.
Not only is your cultivation weaker than that of most children, but your credential is only at Rank 1."
"With that being said, you have displayed prowess far beyond your cultivation's capabilities, as well as possessing the Perfected Heavenly Refinement..."
The woman fell silent for a moment before continuing, "Anyway, recover your stamina for now.
I am going to have a conversation with my daughter first."
